title: Senior Solutions Architect , Nonprofit Financial Institutions and Credit Unions
descriptionHtml:
Are you the kind of Senior Solutions Architect who thrives when paired to a territory of strategic customers and given the runway to become their most-trusted AWS technical advisor? Do you bring both deep AWS technical breadth and the sensibility to operate inside a mission-driven financial-services organization that treats every technology decision as an extension of its values? AWS is hiring a Senior Solutions Architect to serve as the dedicated SA partner for our Financial Institutions and Credit Unions territory in the AWS U.S. Nonprofits NFICU sub-vertical with $12M+ combined Annualized Revenue across 5 active AWS engagement pillars.

In this role, you will d the broader territory account team (including AWS Professional Services, Customer Solutions, and AWS executive sponsors) to lead the territory AWS technical strategy across an integrated multi-pillar engagement: GenAI Full-Stack, Cloud Migration, Professional Services, and Amazon Connect. You will be the territory customer's primary AWS technical-architect-of-record, the Account Executive's technical co-pilot, and the inside-AWS voice that translates customer's mission, regulatory environment, and operating model into AWS architectural decisions that hold up over the long term.

You will join the AWS WWPS U.S. Nonprofits Solutions Architecture organization — a team that has invested heavily in data-driven SA management, Kiro CLI / agentic-AI tooling for territory and account work, the GenAI Innovation Center (GenAIIC) accelerator mechanism for moving customer PoCs to production, and a strong Sales-SA partnership culture that treats AE quota success and SA technical-advisor outcomes as one shared mission.

The right candidate brings 5+ years of customer-facing technical-advisor or Solutions Architect experience, deep multi-service AWS technical breadth with substantive depth in GenAI on AWS (Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore, Amazon Q, Amazon SageMaker), and the judgment and customer-advisor altitude to operate as the technical lead on multi-million-dollar customer relationships. Prior financial services technical experience — fraternal benefit society, life-insurance, wealth-management, or comparable regulated FinServ-adjacent context — is a strong plus, as is direct experience with security-architecture and AI-platform engagements in regulated environments.

If you want to bring your technical depth, customer-advisor instincts, and trusted-advisor patience to a single nonprofit financial-services customer whose mission of helping members live generously aligns with the long-arc patient work that named-account SAs do best, we want to hear from you.



Key job responsibilities
As the Senior Solutions Architect you will:

Own the customer's AWS architectural roadmap end-to-end — discovery → reference architecture → proof-of-concept design → production launch → operational handoff to Customer Solutions Manager (CSM). Author and publish the Workload Solution Document, Architecture Decision Records, and security-and-compliance artifacts that the customer adopts as the canonical AWS-side technical record.

Apply the AWS GenAI Innovation Center (GenAIIC) + AI Development Life-Cycle (AIDLC) accelerator mechanism to move customer GenAI proof-of-concept work into production-launched outcomes.

Partner deeply with AWS Professional Services on customer active ProServe engagements — providing pre-SOW architectural input, mid-engagement technical guidance, and post-engagement production-readiness review.

Translate customer mission, regulatory environment, and operating model into AWS architectural decisions

Operate the Sales-SA partnership cadence with the territory Account Executive — weekly account-team standups, monthly business reviews, quarterly strategic-planning cycles, and ad-hoc executive-engagement support. Mirror the Sales-SA operating model that's already working on the Membership and broader NFICU sub-verticals.

Drive opportunity-pipeline integrity on customer active engagements — keep the multi-pillar opportunity set forecast-honest, keep stale opps moving or honestly retired, and keep the AE bench fed with SA-led architectural advancement actions every week.

Adopt and promote the NPO SA org's Kiro CLI + MCP toolchain for account-management automation — Kiro CLI for customer-engagement preparation, AWSentral / Outlook / TFC-Hub MCP servers for opportunity / activity / TFC tracking. Reduce administrative overhead so technical-advisor hours go to customer outcomes.

Contribute to the AWS NPO Technical Field Community (TFC) — participate in the bi-weekly Kiro demo-build program, the SA-AE mock customer call program, and the GenAI Accelerator Initiative. Where customer engagements yield reusable patterns (e.g., financial-services GenAI architectures), lift those patterns into TFC content that benefits the broader NPO SA bench.

Travel approximately 25-35% for in-person executive briefings, customer workshops, on-site architecture reviews, and joint working sessions, plus AWS / nonprofit industry events such as AWS Imagine for Nonprofits.

A day in the life
A typical week as a territory SA might include a Monday morning standup with the territory Account Executive to review the week's customer-engagement actions; a Tuesday architecture-review session with the customer enterprise architecture team to scope a new agentic-AI use case on Bedrock AgentCore; a Wednesday technical-deep-dive with customer CISO team on the security projects and the AWS Professional Services delivery plans; a Thursday-morning block of Kiro-CLI-automated account-management work that surfaces the multi-pillar opportunity advancement actions; a Thursday-afternoon working session with the AWS Bedrock service team to align customer GenAI roadmap with the latest service capabilities; and a Friday close-of-week cadence with NFICU Sales Manager and SA Manager on customers overall account trajectory and any executive-engagement actions for the next week. Across the month you also block time for in-person trips to customer locations, Workload Solution Document writing on the SCB Financial AI Platform expansion, GenAIIC partner working sessions, and TFC contributions that scale your impact beyond territory accounts into the broader NPO SA org.

About the team
You will join the AWS Worldwide Public Sector U.S. Nonprofits (NPO) Solutions Architecture organization — the team responsible for helping mission-driven nonprofit institutions across the United States use AWS to expand their impact on the communities they serve. Our customers are the country's largest membership associations, federally-aligned nonprofit financial institutions, credit unions, faith-based organizations, healthcare and education foundations, public-broadcasting organizations, environmental and humanitarian nonprofits, and the social-services agencies that operate at the heart of the U.S. social safety net. The technical decisions our customers make — about cloud migration, GenAI adoption, contact-center modernization, data strategy, and security — directly affect the mission outcomes they deliver: members served, donors connected, beneficiaries reached, and lives changed. We treat that responsibility seriously.

You will be a member of the Nonprofits Financial Institutions and Credit Unions (NFICU) sub-vertical SA team within the NPO SA organization. NFICU is the sub-vertical that supports nonprofit financial services foundations, fraternal benefit societies, top U.S. credit unions, and adjacent FinServ-aligned NPO accounts.

How we work is part of what makes this team distinctive. We've invested heavily in data-driven SA management. We've built and adopted the AWS NPO GenAI Accelerator mechanism — a working-group-led initiative that integrates the AWS GenAI Innovation Center (GenAIIC) and AI Development Life-Cycle (AIDLC) frameworks into a repeatable customer-engagement playbook for moving nonprofit GenAI proof-of-concept work into production launches. We run an agentic-AI tooling culture — Kiro CLI, Quick Desktop, and MCP servers (AWSentral, Outlook, TFC Hub) are everyday tools the team uses for territory and named-account management, opportunity progression, customer-engagement automation, and force-multiplied SA hours. We host the AWS Imagine for Nonprofits flagship conference annually and contribute org-wide to its agenda, technical content, and customer round-tables. And we're deeply invested in the AWS Technical Field Community (TFC) — running an SA-AE mock customer call program for SA development, a bi-weekly Kiro demo-build program for SA org-wide capability development, and structured mentoring relationships.

The result is a team where customer obsession isn't a slogan — it's expressed in the way SAs partner with AEs to advance customer outcomes, the way the leadership bench invests in talent growth, the way technical depth and operational rigor are weighted equally, and the way every SA on the bench is given the tools, mentoring infrastructure, and trusted-advisor mandate to do their best work for nonprofit customers whose missions matter. If you want to bring your technical advisor instincts to a single strategic financial-services nonprofit customer whose mission of helping members live generously aligns with the long-arc patient work that named-account SAs do best, this is that team.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
- Knowledge of SAP systems (like SAP Business Suite, S/4HANA, SAP Business Warehouse, SAP HANA, SAP Business Objects, etc.) and their architecture and infrastructure needs
- Experience working with end user or developer communities
- Experience managing relationships with SAP customers and partners
- Experience in SAP S/4HANA, SAP Cloud Platform, SAP Cloud ERP and Cloud ERP Private
- Experience in SAP clean core design concepts, including design and build using non-SAP technologies in domains such as Generative / Agentic AI, and data & analytics

title: Sr. Construction Manager , CLT100
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Data Center Construction Manager, you will be part of a creative, diverse team tasked with solving fascinating problems in constructing Amazon Data Centers. Our data centers are industry-leading examples of energy-efficient, cost-effective designs. You will work alongside partner teams such as Operations, Networking, Controls, Security, and Commissioning to build Data Centers that directly support our Customers.

As our Data Center Construction Manager, you will build some of the most interesting electrical and mechanical systems in the world. You will be on the construction site daily, interacting with the construction trades as Amazon's owner's representative. You will be directly responsible for driving cost, schedule, and quality while managing construction vendors and contractors building data centers.

At Amazon, we are all Owners and leverage unique opportunities presented to us by owning everything from design review to construction bidding to construction execution and final hand-off to our customers. We are a diverse, upbeat, creative team of engineers and managers working daily to develop innovative data centers for our Customers.






Key job responsibilities
The Data Center Construction Manager will be responsible for construction project management and oversight of construction-related activities as they relate to new builds or general capital projects. This includes ownership of the project scope, quality, schedule, and budget.

Some of the typical daily tasks of the Construction Manager:

-Direct interface with construction general contractors during the bidding, award, execution, and project closeout/punch list phases.

-Conduct negotiations with general contractors and evaluate bids/proposals with detail and accuracy.

-Create construction project scope and requests for proposals.

-Perform financial analysis of construction.

-Manage construction projects for specific initiatives aimed at increasing the resiliency of our data centers.

-Conduct constructability reviews of electrical and mechanical designs associated with the construction of new data centers or optimization of existing data centers.

-Manage construction documents including submittal review, RFIs, change orders, and invoicing.

-Ensure construction project quality control.
Record and report key construction metrics to team members and management.

-Drive teams to perform troubleshooting and root-cause failure analysis associated with equipment failures.

-Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.

A day in the life
Manage the day to day responsibilities of the CM team, engage with other internal AWS managers and team members. New Carlisle, Indiana will be the permanent reporting location.


About the team
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

- Experience constructing electrical engineering systems including large scale power distribution/generation gear and mechanical engineering systems including cooling systems
- Experience in construction management or construction program management of large, complex projects involving large-scale mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) plants
- Experience in construction of data center delivery (design, commissioning and construction), mission critical facilities, or equivalent industrial/manufacturing facility builds

As Amazon has rapidly grown and diversified, the opportunity for applying machine learning has exploded. We are developing state-of-the-art machine learning solutions to accelerate the Amazon India growth story. Amazon India is an exciting place to be at for a machine learning practitioner. We have the eagerness of a fresh startup to absorb machine learning solutions, and the scale of a mature firm to help support their development at the same time. Establish scalable, efficient, automated processes for large scale data analyses, model development, model validation and model maintenance
Work proactively with engineering teams and product managers to evangelize new algorithms and drive the implementation of large-scale complex ML models in production
Leading projects and mentoring other scientists, engineers in the use of ML techniques

International Machine Learning Team is responsible for building novel ML solutions that attack India first (and other Emerging Markets across MENA and LatAm) problems and impact the bottom-line and top-line of India business. title: Operations Manager

title: Sr Pre-Construction Manager, GES NA, Design and Construction
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Preconstruction Manager within Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Design & Construction (D&C), you are Amazon's senior owner's representative during the preconstruction phase — responsible for autonomously managing complex, cross-functional industrial building projects from site selection through design completion, permitting, and contract execution across your assigned region. Preconstruction services refers to the planning of a construction project before actual construction begins.

You will partner with internal and external stakeholders to ensure scope, budget, and schedule definition are established, including timely receipt of building and site permits. You are responsible as the senior project manager to lead planning, design, and preconstruction projects — including new built-to-suit industrial buildings, tenant improvements, extensions of existing facilities, and renovation projects — serving major business customers within your region.

You execute deliverables with limited oversight, using advanced professional concepts to resolve complex issues in creative and effective ways. You deliver a mix of tactical and strategic initiatives (60% tactical / 40% strategic) that impact multiple teams and/or geographies in support of significant business objectives. You own project budgets, oversee design management, select external vendor partners, and lead project procurement — and you are accountable for the full performance of your external project teams. You show outstanding judgment when driving project escalations and make difficult trade-off decisions between short-term and long-term needs, defending those decisions to internal stakeholders.

Beyond project delivery, you guide preconstruction managers in best practices in stakeholder management and project delivery, contribute to developing Amazon's internal and external construction networks, and are learning to force multiply — elevating the performance of the teams and partners around you. You write effective narratives and present complex decisions and trade-offs to Directors and VPs. You actively recruit, mentor, and develop other preconstruction managers.

This role requires 60% regional travel on a yearly basis. When not traveling, you must have availability to work from a corporate office. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of one of the corporate office locations listed. Relocation assistance may be provided.

Key job responsibilities
Safety & Compliance
- Own and enforce Amazon's safety programs and standards across all internal and external project teams during the planning and preconstruction phases; set the standard for safety culture on complex projects
- Lead coordination with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) to ensure regulatory compliance, smooth permitting execution, and timely approvals
- Review noise, traffic, and environmental studies; understand and apply zoning, planning, fire code, and building code requirements for assigned projects
- Proactively identify and eliminate compliance risks before they become project roadblocks

Preconstruction & Project Management
- Autonomously manage complex, cross-functional industrial preconstruction projects from site selection through design completion, permitting, and contract execution; contribute to significantly complex projects as part of a team
- Lead site selection and validation, scope development, and design management — overseeing design teams in developing site plans and composite floor plans in compliance with Amazon's design standards and operational requirements
- Oversee design management end-to-end, including design evaluations, design conformance reviews, and value engineering assessments
- Manage multiple concurrent large industrial projects across various locations simultaneously, leading a region or program with limited management oversight
- Keep scope under control and accelerate progress by driving crisp, timely decisions, identifying and clearing blockers, and managing escalations with excellent judgment
- Identify and resolve upstream issues proactively to support a clean handoff to the Construction Manager; remain a key support resource and authority on project issues for the construction team throughout the project lifecycle
- Monitor project performance metrics, anticipate roadblocks and risks, manage escalations, and ensure corrective actions are taken
- Resolve complex issues and find a path forward in difficult situations; make and defend trade-off decisions between short-term and long-term needs
- Assess project performance through Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for safety, quality, cost, schedule, and sustainability; deliver solutions that meet standards for customer satisfaction, efficiency, stability, and operational excellence
- Maintain a broad perspective — understand how project components drive successful programs, business portfolios, and not just individual projects

Budget, Schedule & Contract Management
- Own project budgets and oversee spend approvals across all assigned preconstruction projects
- Perform conceptual estimating and pricing reviews for scope inclusions and exclusions; lead negotiations on the cost of work with developers, general contractors, and design consultants
- Lead external partner selection, contract negotiations, and project procurement functions; ensure contracts are fit for purpose, cost-effective, and incorporate appropriate service level agreements
- Review and analyze design and construction contracts, related exhibits, and lease agreements; provide detailed analysis and approvals of technical matters and site-specific deal structures and terms
- Review additional reports including noise and traffic studies and environmental assessments
- Partner with the Transaction team and developers to optimize schedule and strategy for entitlements and long-lead procurement
- Identify and solve factors that may impede a successful permitted project handover to Amazon stakeholders; make trade-offs between short-term and long-term needs

Stakeholder & Vendor Management
- Work with internal and external teams — including Real Estate, Design Engineering, Entitlements, Construction, Finance, Launch/Startup, architects, engineers, permitting agencies, developers, and landlords — to secure resources, scope infrastructure builds, set priorities and milestones, and drive delivery to meet deadlines
- Drive results through communicating, weighing risks, making decisions, leading, and influencing; serve as an authority on project issues across diverse audiences
- Select external vendor partners and manage delivery from external service partners to drive delivery with efficient use of resources and technology
- Lead large cross-functional teams to complete preconstruction projects; skillfully motivate and focus people of all levels to deliver complex projects
- Drive significant communication across departments, from front-line to executive-level managers; achieve high-level alignment and consensus with internal and external stakeholders across diverse teams (legal, regulatory, operations, engineering, finance, external industry groups)
- Act as the primary escalation point for project team members; own and track issues to ensure they are addressed, documented, and resolved
- Support crucial relationships and lead negotiations of agreements with customers, suppliers, and external partners
- Contribute to developing Amazon's internal and external construction networks

Communication & Reporting
- Write effective narratives and present complex decisions, trade-offs, and potential solutions to Directors and VPs
- Translate technical documents and information into end-to-end stories providing detailed risk analysis for leaders and customers
- Communicate budgets, schedules, project status, and priorities clearly to internal teams and external partners
- Run preconstruction meetings effectively — putting the right people in the room, driving detailed discussions, and achieving high-level alignment and consensus
- Utilize Amazon's information systems to record and update schedule, budget, and other key project developments
- Represent Amazon's interests in weekly Architect, Owner, and Contractor (AOC) meetings; provide input on root causes and corrective actions

Process Improvement, Best Practices & People Development
- Drive continuous improvement and create sustainable, repeatable processes and playbooks for the team and region
- Contribute to process improvement ideas; develop tools and procedures that improve project efficiency and delivery across the organization
- Drive efficiencies, streamline workflows, and mitigate excess process and risk
- Learn to force multiply — drive adoption of best practices and elevate the performance of teams and partners
- Recommend improvements to the way projects are scoped, permitted, and executed across the region or organization
- Guide preconstruction managers in best practices in stakeholder management and project delivery; frequently serve as an expert resource on complicated technical, jurisdictional, or regulatory issues
- Actively recruit, mentor, and develop other preconstruction managers within your organization and location
- Assist leadership in building internal and external talent networks
- Participate in the interview process and help train new team members
- Support Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion as fundamentally right for all employees by fostering a culture where inclusion is the norm
- Insist on the highest standards from self and others; drive accountability for results

A day in the life
Each day, you represent GES NA Design & Construction as Amazon's senior owner during the preconstruction phase — executing autonomously, leading with no authority, and influencing the best project decisions across your region. You are 60% tactical and 40% strategic, planning your projects with limited management oversight and frequently called upon as an expert resource. Your day may include:
- Leading design reviews and providing strategic direction to architects, engineers, and design consultants on complex projects
- Negotiating contract terms with developers, general contractors, and consultants while driving adherence to schedules and budgets
- Presenting project status, risks, and trade-off decisions to senior leadership (Directors and VPs)
- Coordinating with AHJ on permitting status, zoning, fire code, and building code requirements
- Monitoring project performance metrics and driving corrective actions with external partners
- Partnering with Real Estate and Transaction teams on entitlement strategy and long-lead procurement
- Mentoring PCMs and contributing to team development and best practices
- Developing or updating process playbooks based on lessons learned from current projects
- Leveraging project management principles and analytics to identify, avoid, or correct issues before they become roadblocks

About the team
At Amazon, the GES North America Design & Construction team is a diverse group of engineers, construction managers, and preconstruction professionals who deliver the physical infrastructure behind Amazon's logistics network. We are employee owners who take pride in delivering high-quality, innovative facilities — on time and on budget — for our internal customers and the communities we serve. We are committed to being Earth's best employer and to building a more sustainable future through every project we deliver.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of project management, real estate development, architecture/design experience
- Bachelor's degree
- 7+ years of experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, Development Manager, Owner's Project Management Representative, or in a related commercial development or construction discipline
- 7+ years of project management experience from design phase through implementation and operation, including negotiating construction, procurement, and labor contracts
- Experience within packaging, processing, or logistical facilities with complex equipment, or comparable experience
- Position includes travel up to 60% (Nationwide). Travel involves air travel to regional airports and driving to site locations. A valid driver's license is required due to project assignments in areas with limited public transportation and rideshare options.

Preferred qualifications

- Advanced degree or certification in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or Business Administration
- Experience operating across at least two disciplines within the construction industry (e.g., General Contracting, Owner's Representation, Commercial Development, Engineering & Design, or Owner's Project Management)
- Demonstrated capability in planning, design review, implementation, and project management/control of new structures and enhancement of existing facilities
- Experience managing multi-disciplinary design incorporating industrial automation, robotics, or similar
- Strong influencing and negotiating skills; demonstrated ability to lead with no authority and build consensus across diverse stakeholder groups
- Demonstrated success communicating complex decisions and trade-offs to senior leadership (Director/VP level)
- Experience developing and implementing preconstruction processes, playbooks, or best practice frameworks
- Experience mentoring and developing junior preconstruction professionals
- Knowledge of Building Information Modeling (BIM)
- CMIT/CMAA or PMP certification or equivalent

title: Data Engineer I, Fire TV
descriptionHtml:
Fire TV, Advertising and Appstore is reshaping the way millions of people discover, engage with, and enjoy entertainment every day. The FAA Decision Science organization is looking for a Data Engineer who is excited to build the data infrastructure powering analytics, experimentation, forecasting, and business decision-making for one of Amazon's fastest-growing product families.

This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer who is early in their career and eager to develop strong data engineering fundamentals in a high-impact environment. You will contribute to foundational data systems used by Data Science, Business Intelligence, Product, Finance, Advertising, and Engineering teams to make high-quality business decisions.

You will build and operate data pipelines, data models, and data quality mechanisms supporting Fire TV engagement, lifecycle analytics, Ads monetization, Appstore performance, executive reporting, experimentation, and AI-enabled analytics. The ideal candidate has solid technical foundations, a willingness to learn, an eye for operational reliability, and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teammates to translate requirements into working data solutions.

Key job responsibilities
Contribute to the design, development, testing, and deployment of data pipelines and datasets within a defined domain, including the data foundations for GenAI and agentic analytics, working alongside senior engineers

Build and maintain ETL/ELT workflows using SQL, Python, and AWS services

Support data infrastructure operations, including monitoring, alerting, and data quality controls

Investigate and resolve data quality issues, escalating complex problems or architectural trade-offs when appropriate

Partner with Data Science, Business Intelligence, Product, and Engineering stakeholders to understand requirements and implement reliable data solutions

Contribute to conversational and self-service analytics data products

Support compliance, privacy, retention, and governance requirements for data you own or contribute to

Clearly document your solutions to ensure ease of use and maintainability by others

Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and team planning

Participate in on-call and product support for business-critical pipelines and datasets

Build and curate datasets and documentation that AI assisted analytics tools consume

Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate how you build, test, and debug pipelines

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of data engineering experience
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience with SQL
- Experience with one or more query language (e.g., SQL, PL/SQL, DDL, MDX, HiveQL, SparkSQL, Scala)
- Experience with one or more scripting language (e.g., Python, KornShell)
- Knowledge of database, data warehouse, or data lake solutions

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR
- Knowledge of basics of designing and implementing a data schema like normalization, relational model vs dimensional model
- Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
- Experience with privacy, compliance, retention, or data governance programs
- Experience using AI to accelerate development work

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Leo Ground Systems Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and under-served communities around the world. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help us build this service from the ground up.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
• Design, develop, deploy, and support software that keeps a globally deployed fleet of ground terminals healthy and available.
• Build and scale data pipelines and monitoring that enable condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, and automated remediation.
• Develop automation for the integration, test, calibration, and release of ground systems software.
• Own the full software development lifecycle, including design, testing, deployment, mission integration, and operational support.


A day in the life
In this role as a Software Development Engineer, you will design, implement, optimize, and operate systems critical to the uptime and performance of Leo ground terminals. Your contributions will have a direct impact on customers around the world.

About the team
The Leo Ground Systems Engineering team is responsible for the development, deployment, and long-term performance optimization of the Leo satellite Gateway and Telemetry, Tracking, and Command (TT&C) terminals located around the world. These terminals include full-motion parabolic antennas, radio frequency spectrum monitoring, terminal monitoring and control, and fault management systems. These software-driven distributed systems form the communications backbone for the Leo constellation and must provide the world-class reliability, uptime, and performance our customers expect from Amazon.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with distributed systems and a mix of hardware/software troubleshooting
- Experience building data pipelines or services on AWS (e.g., DynamoDB, record streaming, data lakes) with Python

This role will own identify and own forecasting modelling improvements, defines multi-year road map of evolving forecasting infrastructure, owns network forecast accuracy to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and customer experience. title: Data Center Engineering Operations Technician (m/f/d), Data Center Engineering Operations
descriptionHtml:
The Data Center Engineering Operations Technician (EOT) is responsible for delivery of best practice systems and problem resolution on all data center electrical and mechanical infrastructure (UPS, MV electrical systems, generators, cooling systems etc.) within the data center environment in a specific location. The role requires a highly driven, self-managed individual who demonstrates initiative and proactively seeks solutions to complex technical problems. This position requires frequent site interventions, critical switching activities, along with troubleshooting and fixing infrastructure issues. The role would suit someone who enjoys working in a ‘hands on’ capacity on Mechanical and Electrical (M&E) infrastructure such as diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, fire detection systems and building automation systems. You will report to the Data Center Engineering Operations Manager.



A day in the life
The successful candidate will be accountable for:

· Setting and maintaining the highest standards for safety and actively promoting a world-class safety culture in all aspects of operational procedure
· Driving continuous improvement efforts on infrastructure through standardization of procedures and policies, while delivering performance against agreed metrics
· Enabling the operations organization to delivering 100% up-time on all customer supporting infrastructure
· Collaborating effectively with internal & external stakeholders to deliver operational excellence for all AWS customers
· Responsible for ensuring that the preventive maintenance of site-critical facility infrastructure is planned and executed to the highest standards, in accordance to AWS procedures
· In charge of facility monitoring & supervision (via BMS, PMS, Walkthrough...etc.)
· Participation in the successful delivery of build-out and retrofit of Data Center infrastructure
· Ensuring organizational capability to react & respond appropriately to any potential customer-impacting event on any component of electrical or mechanical infrastructure.
· Reviewing incident reports, documenting periodic trend summaries, and providing updates and recommended actions to management
· Draft, update & maintain method statements, standard operating procedures, emergency response procedures, preventive maintenance programs, and all technical documentation pertaining to DCEO

Physical Requirements:
· Work on a 24x7 schedule (where applicable)
· Work at heights and from ladders.
· Perform physical tasks during the shift
· Work in a noisy environment with ear protection

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

- Knowledge of key electrical competencies and theory

title: Cluster Operations Leader, ADC Data Center Ops
descriptionHtml:
Do you like helping U.S. government agencies implement innovative cloud computing solutions and solve technical problems? Are you committed to fundamentally transforming the way national security and defense mission agencies partner with industry to meet mission requirements? Do you have experience managing large, complex programs? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a seasoned, proven leader to join the Data Center Community organization for the Amazon Dedicated Cloud business.

This organization operates rapidly-scaling, high-availability data centers supporting the U.S government. They execute server and network device installations, IT hardware repairs, and data center mechanical and electrical system operations and maintenance on a 24x7 basis. The Sr. Manager of Operations must be technically adept, operationally agile, and completely committed to availability. The Sr. Manager will be responsible for ensuring standards for operational performance in the areas of safety, security, availability, capacity, people/ID&E, and cost of all data centers in a specific region.

The right candidate will need to stay on top of the long-term strategy as well as the operating details of his/her organization to ensure urgent tactical issues are addressed and their teams are taking steps to head off customer impacting risks and issues. We seek a proven leader with operational strength and experience building and leading large geographically dispersed teams.

Must be willing to travel to data centers in Culpeper, Warrenton and Alexandria.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph. This position requires the candidate to opt into a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
- Operation and maintenance of data center mechanical, electrical, and controls systems to include preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, emergency maintenance, and change management.
- Oversight of teams responsible for installation, repair, and decommissioning of data center hardware and network devices.
- Leading, managing, coaching, and developing the data center cluster operations management teams.
- Performance management of key vendors and maintenance vendors in line with management goals.
- Executing the infrastructure operations support component of new cluster launches, new data center launches, and existing data center expansions.
- Proposing and complying with agreed operational performance goals relating to safety, security, availability, capacity, people/ID&E, and cost.
- Supporting the physical security safeguarding of the people, assets, and customer data in data centers.
- Operations budgeting and management of capital expenditures and operating expenses in line with management targets.
- Contributing to continuous improvement of operational processes, procedures, methods, and tools including those related to safety, security, and availability incident/event response, management, recovery, and resolution.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

title: Data Engineer, Ring Agent Platforms
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Data Engineer to design, build, and operate the data pipelines, models, and platform infrastructure that power Ring's analytics, science, and AI initiatives. You will own the end-to-end data lifecycle — ingestion, transformation, modeling, quality enforcement, and delivery — ensuring that analysts, scientists, and AI systems have access to reliable, well-structured data at scale.

You will use AI development IDEs and generative AI tooling daily to accelerate your work, and you will build multi-agent solutions that automate common data engineering tasks — pipeline generation, data quality enforcement, testing, and operational response. The goal is to turn repeatable patterns into agent-driven workflows that raise velocity and consistency across the team.

You will also contribute to the shared data platform when needed — improving developer tooling, maintaining infrastructure, and supporting the services that the broader data org depends on.

About the team
The Data and Agents Organization spans data engineering, business intelligence, applied science, and agentic AI. The org is structured into three primary groups: one focused on core data platforms, tooling, and pipeline infrastructure; another focused on AI/ML models, business analytics, shared data models, product analytics, and strategic science initiatives; and a third focused on building a multi-agent AI platform that enables teams to compose, deploy, and orchestrate autonomous AI agents at scale. Capacity is balanced across direct business support, strategic new development, and operational health.

- Experience in Hive/Spark/Hbase/Yarn, or experience with programming/scripting (Batch, VB, PowerShell, Java, C#, Chef, Perl, Ruby and/or PHP) and experience in any Bigdata architecture
- Demonstrated use of generative AI tools (e.g., agentic coding assistants, AI-powered IDEs) in a professional or project setting

- Experience with cloud-native data services including data warehouses, object storage, event streaming, and serverless compute
- Proficiency in Python and SQL

title: Area Manager
descriptionHtml:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. As an Area Manager, you’ll make sure your site is running as smoothly as it should so that we can meet customer demand. You will be leading a team that helps keep our operations safe, efficient, and of a high quality and taking on a number of projects across our network to drive productivity.

The applicable collective agreement (CCNL) for this role is Logistica, Trasporto Merci e Spedizione. The position is classified at Level 1 or above, depending on the candidate’s skills, competences and experience.

Key job responsibilities
- Create, oversee, and drive a culture of safety and wellbeing
- Analyse and implement changes to keep quality and productivity at a consistently high level
- Oversee projects to streamline processes, optimise productivity and increase quality of service for customers within your area of responsibility
- Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
- Work collaboratively with management-level colleagues to standardise shift practices

A day in the life
You’ll work on a shift pattern at one of our sites, making sure it is as productive as it can be. Your main focus will be to own and drive a culture of safety and uphold quality and shift performance standards. You’ll also oversee process improvements within your area and drive implementation. A typical day is varied, including everything from routine team management and daily operational responsibilities to process improvement and wide-scale operational contingency tasks. You’ll also be a role model and mentor to new managers.

About the team
Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we’re always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

The CF team are the first people in the chain that helps customers get products at the speed we’re known for. We’re based in Fulfilment Centres, which are at the heart of Amazon’s fast-paced Operations network. Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile’ because it’s where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock.

Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Relevant experience in people management
- Relevant experience of communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including your peers and leadership
- Relevant experience in using data or anecdotal evidence to influence business decisions
- Advanced proficiency in verbal and written English and local language

Preferred qualifications

- Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we’d love to hear from you.
- Experience working with Lean, Six Sigma and Kaizen techniques
- Experience working in another logistics environment
- Relevant experience working with the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in a professional environment

descriptionHtml:

Are you ready to influence senior leaders worldwide while driving critical safety initiatives? We're seeking a hands-on data-driven owner to lead our worldwide Delivery Service Partner (DSP) Safety programs.

As the owner of DSP safety programs, you will work backwards from safety outcomes and customer experiences to deliver safety programs. You will create a virtuous cycle to generate and implement new ideas, launch and scale the programs globally, evaluate effectiveness, and optimize and streamline the programs. You will ensure the teams are focus on delivering the right things with high quality, under budget, and on-time.

We are a matrix organization, so it's important you can influencing multiple organizations and leaders without authority. Our space is complex and we support over 20 countries with multiple modes of transportation and ways of delivery. The ideal candidate can translate complexity into simplicity and focus teams on the most important things.
You will be responsible for hiring and developing the team of leaders to deliver on your vision. This role requires you to operate at multiple altitudes - from influencing VP-level strategy to rolling up your sleeves to dive deep into data, metrics, and customer anecdotes. You'll need to be comfortable both presenting to executives and doing the hands-on work of analyzing root causes, building mechanisms, and implementing solutions. You'll drive innovation through new programs and scalable mechanisms while being accountable for global safety outcomes.

The ideal candidate brings strategic thinking balanced with hands-on execution capability, proven ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority, and top-notch analytical skills to uncover patterns in complex data sets. You should have a track record of simplifying complex processes, driving operational efficiency, and excellence in written and verbal communication. Success in this role requires demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives in matrix organizations, anticipate and remove roadblocks while maintaining program momentum, and inspire diverse teams toward common goals.

Key job responsibilities
Główne obowiązki

Jako stażysta w dziale operacji Amazon będziesz mieć możliwość wykorzystania swoich umiejętności analitycznych w ważnych projektach, które poprawiają funkcjonalność i jakość usług centrów logistycznych, centrów sortowania i stacji dostaw.
Kluczowe obowiązki stanowiska:

* Realizowanie projektów o wysokim priorytecie zgodnie z najwyższymi standardami oraz wykazywanie się umiejętnością osiągania wyników

* Analizowanie danych w celu identyfikacji wyzwań operacyjnych i możliwości poprawy

* Proponowanie i testowanie rozwiązań oraz współpraca z zespołem przy wdrażaniu tych najbardziej skutecznych

* Rozwijanie umiejętności komunikacyjnych i pracy zespołowej poprzez współpracę z przełożonymi, interesariuszami i pracownikami pierwszej linii.

* Przemieszczanie się po budynku w celu współpracy z różnymi zespołami. Obejmuje to aktywne zdobywanie wiedzy poprzez udział w takich działaniach, jak wstępne odprawy, spotkania dotyczące przepływu pracy oraz dyskusje z kierownictwem i współpracownikami.

* Niezbędnym elementem tego stanowiska jest umiejętność poruszania się po miejscu pracy i przemieszczania się między różnymi obszarami.

* Wykazywanie elastyczności w zakresie pracy w różnych harmonogramach i systemach zmianowych stosownie do potrzeb.

* Potencjalna relokacja do wyznaczonego miejsca pracy.



A day in the life
Dzień z życia stażysty
Nasze staże to okazja do zdobycia wiedzy, która pozwoli Ci jako naszemu przyszłemu przełożonemu przekonać się, w jaki sposób zarządzamy zespołami pracowników i rozwijamy ich kompetencje. Poznasz dynamiczny i złożony świat naszych centrów logistycznych, centrów sortowania oraz stacji dostaw i zobaczysz, w jaki sposób nasi kierownicy motywują swoje zespoły do spełniania oczekiwań klientów.

Dzięki temu stażowi znajdziesz się w samym centrum naszych działań, co pozwoli Ci prześledzić drogę zamówienia klienta. Zyskasz realistyczny obraz pracy w pełnym wymiarze czasu, która czeka na Ciebie w naszej organizacji.

Dowiesz się, w jaki sposób nasi przełożeni tworzą bezpieczne i produktywne środowisko pracy, w pełni wykorzystując potencjał swoich zespołów dzięki skutecznym strategiom angażowania pracowników i zarządzania wynikami pracy. To szansa na rozwinięcie umiejętności, które pomogą Ci rozpocząć satysfakcjonującą karierę w Amazon.


About the team
O zespole
Społeczność stażystów:

* Jako stażysta Amazon będziesz częścią dynamicznej, wspierającej społeczności, która pomoże Ci się rozwijać. Będziesz współpracować ze stażystami z całego świata, nawiązywać kontakty i uczestniczyć w wydarzeniach towarzyskich, aby poszerzyć swoje horyzonty. Możesz również dołączyć do specjalistycznych grup zajmujących się takimi obszarami, jak zrównoważony rozwój, co pozwoli Ci rozwijać różnorodne zainteresowania.

Wsparcie:

Sesje szkoleniowe:

* Dzięki specjalnym sesjom szkoleniowym jeszcze bardziej rozwiniesz swoje umiejętności, uzyskując dostęp do najnowocześniejszych platform szkoleniowych Amazon i wiedzy liderów branży. Te ustrukturyzowane możliwości rozwoju przygotują cię do kolejnego kroku w karierze.

Możliwości:

title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners AWS Sovereign Cloud AWS International Product and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You'll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.

Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we're looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers' creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level services, Networking, Serverless, and more. This is not a sales role but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and 'voice of the customer' to organizations ranging from start-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises. The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer's environment for troubleshooting customer support issues; rather, you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution.

More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer's environment and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents trade-offs support and risk management. You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices and proactively keep your customers' AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation come join us!

About the team
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- 3+ years of technical engineering experience
- Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
- Bachelor's degree

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
- Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

title: OISL MFG Technician, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,000+ satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to underserved communities around the world. Amazon Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

We are looking for talented technicians to help full-scale production of the Leo satellites. The success of Leo depends on the quality, reliability, cost, manufacturability, throughput, and security of the products that you deliver. If you seek a fast-paced, dynamic environment; if you thrive on solving difficult problems where resolutions have high impact; and if you love the challenge of building something from scratch, then this role will be an ideal next career step. To be successful you need to be highly motivated and detail oriented while showing the highest standards of execution.


Key job responsibilities
- Follow work instructions and safety procedures
- Assemble and test with emphasis to detail, an assortment of LRUs, electrical-mechanical assemblies, avionics, or other complex aerospace builds
- Participate in process improvements, maintain floor stock inventory
- You will independently execute and prioritize work to meet company deliverables
- Execute test procedures for component and system level testing maintenance
- Champion safety requirements in all designated zones and work locations
- Ensure lab equipment is maintained and calibrated
- Supports some preventative maintenance activities on test equipment and data acquisition systems
- Receive shipments and coordinate deliveries with recipients (Using pallet jacks, kit carts, etc)
- Your work may include contributing to improving SOPs and safety procedures

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Candidates must be 18 years or older with the ability to understand and adhere to all job requirements and safety guidelines.

The starting pay for this role in Washington State is up to $33.50 / hour and employees are eligible for incremental raises based on tenure. This information is provided per the Washington State Pay Transparency Act. Base pay information is based on market location. Applicants should apply via Amazon’s internal or external careers site.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years in a high traceability manufacturing environment, or relevant trade school certification
- 1+ years using hand tools and/or precision measuring instruments (i.e., Calipers, multi-meters, torque wrenches)
- 1+ years working with test tools and test methods that adequately validate the system
- Experience reading, interpreting and working from engineering documentation and/or drawings

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in the aerospace industry, automotive industry, medical device industry, aviation, military or other high-reliability operating environment
- Experience in a fast-paced production environment
- Experience working with FOD, ESD sensitive hardware and clean room requirements
- Experience with forklifts, cranes and heavy equipment (including previous certifications)
- A demonstrated ability in reading/understanding technical drawings, work instructions and standard operating procedures
- Some basic knowledge of electrical, optical and mechanical systems, antennas, functional testing and/or satellite components
- Ability to use multiple types of precision measuring instruments
- Ability to work effectively in a team environment
- Ability to rapidly change roles/responsibilities while working in a high-paced, challenging work environment

title: Sr Forward Deployed Engineer, AWS Forward Deployed Engineering
descriptionHtml:
A Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDEs write production-grade software and own outcomes end-to-end, from prototype through enterprise-scale deployment combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes. They create reusable architectures, patterns, and engineering mechanisms that scale the entire FDE practice.

Key job responsibilities
Lead technical delivery across customer engagements
- Own the technical strategy and execution for complex, multi-workstream customer AI programs. Make architecture decisions that span multiple services and organizational boundaries. Align technical approach with the customer's long-term technology strategy. Requires 30–50% travel.

Architect and build production AI systems at scale
- Design the foundational architectures — multi-agent orchestration, enterprise retrieval systems, decision intelligence platforms — for the most complex customer engagements. Drive clarity where neither the business problem nor technology approach is fully defined. Build production systems that handle enterprise-scale traffic and reliability requirements.

Own production excellence across workstreams
- Define operational standards, evaluation frameworks, and production readiness criteria for AI systems across your engagement scope. Establish mechanisms (testing strategies, observability standards, incident response playbooks) that ensure AI systems remain healthy. Drive operational improvements that raise the bar for the team.

Scale the team's effectiveness
- Define engineering patterns, contribute to the interview and hiring process, and mentor junior FDEs into independent contributors. Coach others on system design, customer engagement, and production operations. Drive engineering excellence standards within your scope.

Accelerate customer transformation
- Identify systemic opportunities to expand AI adoption across the customer organization. Create accelerators and reusable platforms that reduce time-to-value from months to weeks. Feed learnings back into AWS services and the FDE practice.

title: GPV Lab Metrology Technician , PQ (Program)
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth, providing safe and authentic products to our customers by safeguarding Amazon’s global marketplaces. Amazon's Perfect Order Experience team works to ensure that buyers receive authentic products in the condition and with the functionality they are expecting. We design and implement policies, tools, and technology innovations to protect the buying experience on Amazon. Our greatest challenge is protecting buyer trust without unjustly harming good selling partners. To strike the right balance, we invest in mechanisms which allow us to accurately identify and mitigate risk, and to quickly correct and learn from our mistakes. This strategy includes continuously evolving enforcement policies, iterating our Machine Learning risk models, and exercising high‐judgement decision‐making where we cannot apply automation.

The Global Product Verification (GPV) team supports the Perfect Order Experience (POE) organization goals and objectives by acting as a reliable product authentication and verification service for third-party products sold on Amazon by authenticating risky offers and establishing ground truth. As GPVs’ Lab Metrology Technician you will support expanding and scaling the use of metrology-based applications and techniques, e.g. X-Ray, Digital Multimeter, Spectrometer, Load testers, etc. to aid in establishing authenticity of products. You will use a combination of scientific methods and technical skills to test and evaluate products, and leverage your thorough understanding of industry regulations and guidelines. You will collaborate directly with GPVs investigations team to develop new metrology-based product analysis tools and mechanisms including leveraging AI to drive efficiencies and scale. In addition you will work closely with GPV leadership in driving the strategic vision for metrology to support POE’s long-term goals and objectives, including regional expansion efforts.

In addition to above the Lab Metrology Technician is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, precision, and reliability of all measurement instruments, acting as a crucial quality assurance authority on behalf of GPV and POE. This includes maintaining measurement standards, enforcing strict calibration schedules, adhering to regulatory protocols (like ISO/IEC 17025, cGMP, and FDA), and managing documentation for all measurements and equipment, including all safety and compliance requirements. In addition to technical skills, the Lab Metrology Technician must have strong problem-solving and analytical abilities and be able to work independently but most importantly, collaboratively with team of investigators.


Key job responsibilities
* Overseeing all metrology-based tools and systems enabling investigators to conduct product analysis at scale
* Maintaining and calibrating laboratory equipment, and ensuring the laboratory is clean and organized
* Interpreting, analyzing, and communicating results to relevant stakeholders
* Providing weekly/monthly reporting (KPIs) of impact and output of lab
* Following standard operating procedures and good laboratory practices
* Participating in internal and external audits, and maintaining a thorough understanding of regulatory requirements
* Generating and updating standard operating procedures and test methods
* Troubleshooting laboratory issues and recommending solutions
* Providing support to other team members as needed
* Maintaining accurate and detailed records of all testing performed

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience working cross-functionally and across regions
- Experience in oral and written communication
- Experience in trust and safety compliance or risk
- Experience using Excel and SQL

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of professional experience
- 4+ years of hardware development, test lab, or hands-on engineering environment experience
- Master's degree in engineering, physics, or equivalent
- ASQ’s Certified Calibration Technician (CCT) or Coordinate Metrology Society (CMS) Level-One/Level-Two
- Proficiency with laboratory information management systems (LIMS).

title: Test Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

As a FLS Test Engineer at Leo, you will be directly responsible for testing, qualifying and troubleshooting integrated satellites for the Kuiper broadband internet network. You will utilize innovative solutions and leading-edge technology to solve difficult manufacturing and engineering problems on a daily basis, at both a systems and specialized level. You will be a critical lynchpin between the engineering, operations, tooling, supply chain and quality teams, and help lead production on the assembly line as well as new production introduction. You will provide vital manufacturability input to the design engineering teams for both new and existing hardware. Finally, you will be responsible for standing up new processes, equipment, and assembly lines to support Kuiper’s rapid build ramp, making data-driven decisions at each step in the process.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.



Key job responsibilities
• Plan, develop, document and execute test operations to validate satellite systems for flight to meet Kuiper production build rates.
• Bring-up, test and troubleshoot integrated satellite assemblies
• Lead acceptance and qualification test (environmental, functional and performance) campaigns for development satellite system designs.
• Analyze test failures to ensure defects are fully understood and provide design recommendations for the product to increase performance, reliability, and yield.
• Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical and RF performance problems on the fly, working with an integrated cross-functional team of electrical, mechanical, software and manufacturing engineers.
• Specify, procure and set up test cell layouts for the production floor.
• Write technical specifications for system assembly and test from scratch.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, or equivalent
- 2+ years of test experience with embedded systems, integrated systems, or flight hardware.
- 1+ years in a Space/Aerospace/Military/Automotive hardware testing environment
- Experience with test automation frameworks or scripting

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of experience testing and troubleshooting integrated systems.
- 1+ years of programming experience
- Experience working with the Linux environment
- Experience commissioning and troubleshooting test equipment. Demonstrated ability to scale production rate capability.
- Experience with complex products in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
- Experience with anomaly tracking systems or formal failure investigation processes.
- Excellent communication and leadership skills.
- Strong organizational, analytical, root cause analysis and problem-solving skills.
