title: Senior Program Manager, Bespoke Solutions
descriptionHtml:
The Bespoke Solutions Teams is looking for an experienced Senior Program Manager to own contractor operations, vendor management, and lab/manufacturing coordination for a high-assurance hardware program within AWS Infrastructure Services — the team building security and encryption devices for government customers.

This is a hands-on operational leadership role. You will consolidate contractor hiring and management, own vendor and license agreements, and serve as the operational backbone that lets our senior engineers stay focused on delivery. You will be the connective tissue across engineering, supply chain, security, and external manufacturing partners — removing friction and reducing key-person dependencies on a fast-moving classified program.

You will own the end-to-end contractor lifecycle, manage vendor and license agreements, coordinate contract manufacturing (including onboarding a new contract manufacturer), and serve as the lab owner. Your success is measured by smooth operational execution, reduced administrative load on engineering leads, and reliable delivery of contractor and manufacturing support as the program scales toward production.

If Arlington, VA (Arlington HQ2):

This role will sit in our new headquarters in Northern Virginia, where Amazon will invest $2.5 billion dollars, occupy 4 million square feet of energy efficient office space, and create at least 25,000 new full-time jobs. Our employees and the neighboring community will also benefit from the associated investments from the Commonwealth including infrastructure updates, public transportation improvements, and new access to Reagan National Airport.

By working together on behalf of our customers, we are building the future one innovative product, service, and idea at a time. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

This position requires that the candidate selected must be a US Citizen and currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
Contractor & Resource Management

- Consolidate contractor hiring and management responsibilities.
- Own the end-to-end contractor lifecycle — sourcing, onboarding, performance tracking, and off-boarding
- Reduce key-person dependencies by establishing repeatable contractor management processes

Vendor, License & Lab Ownership

- Manage vendor and license agreements
- Take ownership of the unclassified lab and similar work-streams
- Serve as the lab owner

Contract Manufacturing

- Own contract manufacturing for the program, including onboarding a new contract manufacturer
- Handle associated administrative tasks including purchasing coordination.
- Partner with supply chain and manufacturing teams to keep prototype and production builds on schedule

Cross-Organization Coordination

- Partner with engineering, systems engineering, security, and leadership to keep operational execution tight
- Serve as primary operational liaison for contractor, vendor, and manufacturing matters
- Provide program status, risk, and resourcing visibility to engineering leads and program leadership

A day in the life
You will join a team within AWS Infrastructure Services that designs, develops, and delivers high-assurance security and encryption hardware for highly regulated government use cases. The team executes against a multi-year roadmap spanning hardware, firmware, programmable logic, and systems engineering — with a growing contractor base and expanding manufacturing footprint. This Program Manager role is the operational anchor that keeps contractor, vendor, and manufacturing execution running smoothly as the program scales from prototype into production.

About the team
About AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Why AWS?

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
- 7+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience managing contractors, vendors, and/or external manufacturing partners
- Experience managing vendor and license agreements and purchasing/procurement coordination
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of Top Secret with SCI eligibility or above

- Experience in a hardware, FPGA, or manufacturing program environment

title: Area Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

title: Finance Manager, Advanced Robotics Finance
descriptionHtml:
The Advanced Robotics Finance team seeks a Finance Manager to partner with the Engineering, Procurement and Accounting teams of the Advanced Robotics organization. The organization is a vertically integrated program spanning foundational AI, hardware engineering, procurement, and manufacturing at scale, with multi-billion-dollar capital investment and ambitious commercial milestones over the next three years.

This role will own financial strategy and governance for Advanced Robotics Capital Investment, drive capital optimization, controllership and provide early warning systems for supply chain disruption risks. The work will directly impact investment decisions, ensure financial discipline across long lead equipment, hardware & raw material procurement, inventory & working capital management, and also influence building appropriate tech tools and solutions for a vertically integrated program.

This is an opportunity to shape both the fixed and working capital management from inception rather than inherit one. The role will partner with engineering, equipment design, procurement, and operations leaders to model landed costs, govern purchase commitments, and optimize supplier relationships. The insights provided will influence make-vs-buy decisions, capital allocation, and risk mitigation strategies for our rapidly scaling robotics infrastructure. from day one.
The successful candidate will be comfortable operating with limited direction, deal with ambiguity, and partner with the aforementioned leaders with an entrepreneurial approach.

Key job responsibilities
1. Own the full capital governance lifecycle across sites including appropriation requests, capital project register, and Capital Work in Process (“CWIP”) to placed-in-service asset transition governance, depreciation schedules, and accurate recording of asset disposals.
2. Own long-lead equipment planning partnerships and associated financial governance, track commitments and financial exposure on equipment orders.
3. Own lease agreements, tenant improvement allowances, and real estate financial commitments across all sites, coordinating with legal, tax, and corporate real estate on multi-jurisdiction implications across Texas, California, Massachusetts, New York, and Washington.
5. Own raw material, WIP, and finished goods inventory financial oversight including min/max inventory level modeling, freight cost forecasting, and variance reporting against BOM logistics cost assumptions; coordinate with Amazon's existing fulfillment, logistics, and supply chain infrastructure.
7. Leverage AI and automate obsolescence/excess inventory risk flagging, landed cost models across a dynamic supplier base, purchase commitment exposure, and supplier financial health monitoring.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field
- 5+ years of finance experience, with at least 3 years in supply chain, procurement, or operations finance.
- 3+ years of finance experience in Capital Asset management, Capital spending against plan, budget tracking and reporting.

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or CPA
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results
- 6+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience
- Knowledge of SQL/ETL
- Knowledge of one or multiple accounting frameworks (including US GAAP, IFRS, or local GAAP frameworks), with the ability to apply them in day-to-day financial activities

descriptionHtml:
Amazon's EMEA Direct Tax Reporting & Compliance team is scaling fast - and we're building the next generation of tax operations with AI-driven automation - not spreadsheets. Join us in Warsaw as a Tax Manager and help drive direct tax compliance for Amazon's portfolio in Europe, with a primary focus on Poland.

You'll own tax reporting and compliance for a portfolio of Amazon's EMEA legal entities, working directly with cross-functional partners across Accounting, Legal, and Transfer Pricing. You'll be part of a team actively deploying GenAI and automation tools to modernize how tax compliance gets done at scale. You'll gain exposure to high-complexity, high-visibility work: statutory filings, tax authority correspondence, audits, and cross-border restructuring projects

The successful candidate will be a highly organized self-starter with strong problem-solving and communication skills, a sharp attention to detail, and the ability to operate independently while working proactively across multiple functional teams in a deadline-driven environment. Beyond managing the compliance portfolio, this person is genuinely motivated to make things better - identifying inefficiencies, driving automation, and continuously raising the bar on how the work gets done. Experience leveraging technology and AI tools to deliver those improvements is highly valued.

Key job responsibilities
Working within the EMEA Foreign Reporting & Compliance team, Tax Manager will:
- Manage income tax compliance, including corporate income tax returns and income tax payments across the assigned portfolio
- Support income tax accounting and reporting under US GAAP and local GAAP and review international aspects of Amazon's worldwide income tax provision
- Manage relationships with external tax advisors and support tax controversy teams on audits
- Own process improvement initiatives - identify automation and simplification opportunities, drive reduction in in manual effort, and develop standard procedures for compliance and reporting processes
- Partner cross-functionally with Direct Tax Technology and Tax Transformation teams to resolve systemic issues and automate recurring calculations and corporate tax requirements
- Participate in special projects, including tax due diligence and integration support for M&A
- Research and document technical tax and tax accounting issues across the assigned portfolio; work with external advisors to assess the impact of new laws and regulations on Amazon's structure and business

About the team
The Amazon Tax department is a fast-paced, collaborative, high-ownership environment. The EMEA Foreign Reporting & Compliance team manages the worldwide tax-related filings and local tax reporting compliance of Amazon's foreign entities - a portfolio growing in scale and complexity as the business expands across the region.

We pair deep tax technical expertise with a strong focus on process improvement and automation, including AI, to modernize tax compliance. Team members collaborate closely with Accounting, Legal, and Transfer Pricing across multiple countries, and own their portfolio of entities and jurisdictions from day one.

Basic qualifications

- Experience a compliance focused tax role in a multinational and/or professional organization
- Experience with accounting concepts and tax regulations, laws and standards
- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Polish
- Strong tax operational background with a track record of managing complex, multi-jurisdiction compliance portfolios

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree
- Polish Certified Tax Advisor (Doradca Podatkowy)
- Technical aptitude to independently build and maintain solutions — not only to identify what needs to be done, but to design and implement it; comfortable working at the intersection of tax and technology

title: Credit Risk Manager, Amazon Payments
descriptionHtml:
Are you looking for a new challenge in a fast-paced, innovative company? Come make history with Amazon's Brazil team! We are seeking a hands-on and analytically strong Credit Risk Individual Contributor to support the execution of our credit initiatives in Brazil and help create access to affordable payment methods. You will own the development and optimization of credit policies, working closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to manage and improve our digital credit products.

The ideal candidate possesses solid credit risk management experience, strong analytical skills, and a proven track record executing credit strategies end-to-end. You must be able to thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop, implement, and monitor credit policies across the customer lifecycle (acquisition, activation, limit management, and maintenance), ensuring alignment with risk appetite and business goals.

- Analyze portfolio performance leveraging data-driven insights to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for optimization across key metrics (approval rates, FPD, loss rates, Incremental profitability and vintage curves).

- Design and execute A/B tests and champion/challenger experiments to continuously improve underwriting rules, decision models, and segmentation strategies.

- Support collections and recovery strategy execution, including segmentation logic, collection rules, and performance tracking of internal and external collection efforts.

- Build and maintain risk dashboards and reporting cadences, translating complex data into actionable narratives for senior leadership and stakeholders.

- Partner with Data Science, Product, Engineering, and Finance teams to embed risk controls into customer journeys, ensuring scalable and automated decision-making.

- Identify signs of macroeconomic deterioration or improvement that may impact portfolio performance and propose strategies with clear trade-off analysis.

- Support the development of credit risk frameworks, including risk appetite definition, governance documentation, and policy governance routines.

About the team
Brazil Payments is part of the International Emerging Stores Payments team and focuses on supporting the launch of new payment and financial products to our customers in Brazil.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Solid experience in credit risk, credit policy, or portfolio management in financial services, fintech, or banking.

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of analytics & statistical tools such as SAS, PowerBI, SQL & ETL DW concepts
- Deep expertise in credit underwriting, collections strategy and fraud prevention across consumer lending products in Latin American markets, particularly Brazil.
- Proven track record designing and implementing credit risk frameworks that balanced growth targets with loss mitigation in high-growth environments.
- Proven ability to analyze large datasets and translate findings into actionable credit strategies
- Familiarity with machine learning models applied to credit scoring or segmentation
- Knowledge of Brazilian credit bureau data (Serasa, SPC, Boa Vista)

title: Commissioning Project Engineer, AWS Commissioning, AMER-West
descriptionHtml:
A Commissioning Project Engineer (CxPE) supports the delivery of data center capacity through managing project milestone auditing, calibration, and commissioning execution for new construction and Capital Improvement Projects (CIPP).

This position is part of a career development program, which aims to develop the CxPE into a Commissioning Engineer (CxE) through a three-phase mentoring program.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Physical Requirements
- Walk job sites in uneven terrain
- Work at heights and from ladders
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl
- Lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more
- Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
- Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration with potential for night and weekends
- Perform physical tasks throughout the day without becoming overly tired
- Ability to manipulate small wires and objects easily
- Work in a noisy environment
- Work in environments that are colder or hotter than a normal office environment

Additional Job Requirements
- Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 80% of the year.
- Required to provide personal transportation for meetings and job visits away from the office; reimbursed.

U.S Citizenship Required

Key job responsibilities
The key responsibility of a Project Engineer is to develop a detailed understanding of AWS critical infrastructure. You will learn the fundamentals related to managing a commissioning project within AWS. As part of this process you will work with different team members who will introduce you to the internal project management tools. You will then progress to the on the job phase where you will participate in the on-site commissioning activities. During the phase of you will support the Lead Commissioning Engineers (CxE) with managing a project from beginning to end.

- Manage the creation of projects within internal Amazon systems.
- Manage the administrative task related to the commissioning process.
- Support the Request for Quote process, ensuring all relevant documentation is available for the commissioning vendors to provide a detailed quote.
- Manage the required vendor project deliverables ensuring on time delivery for the CxE's review.
- Manage project resourcing ensuring all vendors comply with the Leads Qualification Process (LQP).
- Create and manage the approval of the Change Management requests for the commissioning activities of the assigned project

The AWS Data Center Commissioning Team (ACx) is a wholly independent business within the DCGS organization. This team of veteran professional Electrical Engineers, Mechanical Engineers, Controls Engineers, Architectural Engineers, Project Managers, Operators and seasoned Amazonians are uniquely positioned to provide deeply detailed engineering and operational review and testing of equipment designs, operational functionality and construction practices. We are focused on ensuring the rapid delivery of a quality product while maintaining full transparency, recording metrics of manufacturer/contractor/equipment issues pre-PFHO, and identifying opportunities for all our peers and customers.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, our mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company. To achieve this goal, we strive to exceed expectations by innovating and providing best-in-class customer support as we expand our logistics products and services including improving how we fulfill and deliver customer orders. We’re making history and the good news is that we’ve only just begun. At Amazon you get to Work with smart, passionate people who are building new products and services every day on behalf of our customers.

As a Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, you will help improve the customer experience by providing in station real-time, hands-on support to ensure our customers receive their packages on time, as promised. The role will also help connect customers with experts who can provide them the most accurate and up-to-date information about their packages. The work is beyond fulfilling and delivering customer orders; it’s making sure we put smiles on customer’s faces.


Key job responsibilities
As a Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, you will be responsible for:
- Communicating with customers directly in-person, in addition to communicating via phone and email
- Empathizing with and prioritizing customer needs
- Upholding company values and respecting every customer
- Resolving issues and setting appropriate expectations with customers
- Clearly understanding and responding appropriately to the issues that customers present
- Consistently composing grammatically correct, concise, and accurate written responses to customer issues
- Approaching problems logically and with good judgment to ensure the appropriate customer outcome
- Making quick and effective decisions on behalf of the customer
- Working a flexible Full-Time (40+ hours per week) schedule

Performing the following tasks, with or without reasonable accommodation:
- Carry, lift, push and pull up to 49 pounds
- Frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach
- Stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud (hearing protection will be provided)
- Work in an environment where the temperature may vary due to outside weather conditions and is not controlled

A day in the life
You’ll be based at one of our last-mile delivery warehouses, where Amazon’s leading logistics system operates. As orders are dispatched and delivered, you’ll be in contact with our warehouse, associates, delivery partners and customers when they need guidance. Where a customer needs to reschedule a delivery, you’ll be informing our delivery partners. Where you notice a delivery issue, you’ll get to work resolving it straight away, so that our customers get a great experience every time without having to contact Amazon.

Operating at the heart of Amazon’s logistics, you’ll develop logistical and customer expertise that sets Amazon apart. You’ll connect with our customers every day, using your in-depth understanding of our supply chain and local knowledge of delivery connections and warehouses.


About the team
Our mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, and few departments have as direct an impact on that mission as our Customer Service team. We're an inclusive team who empower and look after our people, so they have the time and energy to focus on our customers’ happiness. Our goal is to reduce customer effort every way we can, helping them get the best results quickly and efficiently. We support our self-service channels to offer expert insights into our customers’ most complex issues.

Within Customer Service, there are opportunities in process improvement, customer experience, data analysis and customer retention. The CS team is always looking for ways to make Amazon’s customer service even better, and we need excellent people to make that happen.

- High school or equivalent
- Experience in Customer Service
- Experience working with computers and Microsoft Office (including Outlook, Word, and Excel)

- Experience working with computer and web based tools

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in understanding performance metrics and developing them to measure progress against key performance indicators
- Experience with written and verbal communication and presentation
- Experience working on a merchandising/brand ambassador team for a nationally recognized consumer brand

title: Sr Software Development Engineer, Agent Platforms & Services
descriptionHtml:
Define how AI agents operate in one of the world's largest advertising ecosystems — owning the architecture for agent orchestration, reinforcement learning from expert feedback, trust and permission systems, and scalable inference infrastructure that powers intelligent advertising decisions across Amazon Ads. This is a greenfield opportunity to give every advertiser, regardless of size or sophistication, access to the caliber of strategic campaign management previously available only through dedicated agencies.

Our team is developing an agent platform that coordinates multiple specialized AI sub-agents to execute complex, multi-step advertising workflows. You'll own the architectural direction for these systems, partner with Applied Scientists on learning systems, drive technical strategy with product teams on advertiser experience, and build the identity and authorization frameworks that keep it all secure. This is a small, high-ownership team where you'll shape how AI transforms advertising from the ground floor — influencing technical direction beyond your own team and establishing the engineering practices that scale as the platform grows.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the architectural direction for orchestration systems that coordinate multiple specialized AI sub-agents to execute complex, multi-step advertising workflows
- Design and build identity, authorization, and permission frameworks that enforce scoped access for diverse caller types — making foundational technical decisions that shape the platform long-term
- Design feedback signal pipelines that capture expert judgment and route it into model improvement loops
- Partner with Applied Scientists to integrate reinforcement learning from human expert feedback into production agent systems, driving the technical strategy for how learning systems evolve
- Design and operate end-to-end evaluation systems that measure recommendation quality, detect regressions, and enforce quality gates
- Establish and drive technical partnerships with cross-functional teams (product, science, partner engineering) to define integration contracts and onboard new consumers to the platform, influencing their technical direction
- Own system reliability, observability, and performance for always-on agent infrastructure serving thousands of concurrent advertiser accounts
- Mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and drive adoption of engineering best practices across the team

A day in the life
You might start the morning reviewing eval results from a newly onboarded agent skill, diagnosing why routing accuracy dropped 2%. By mid-morning, you're pairing with an Applied Scientist to tune the feedback pipeline that captures expert signals. After lunch, you're designing the permission model for a new integration. You end the day shipping an observability improvement that surfaces latency bottlenecks across the orchestration chain. Every day is different, but the thread is the same: making AI agents smarter, safer, and more reliable at scale.

About the team
We're a small, high-ownership team within Amazon Ads building the platform that makes AI agents accessible across the advertising ecosystem. Our charter is greenfield: we're defining how agent intelligence gets exposed to other engineering teams. We work closely with Applied Scientists on learning systems, product teams on advertiser experience, and platform teams on shared infrastructure. The team values builders who ship fast, think in systems, and are comfortable operating in ambiguity. If you want to shape how AI transforms advertising from the ground floor, this is the team.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Regional Sr. HR Manager, NACF
descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The Regional Sr. HR Manager is a key strategic partner on the (NACF) PXT team, bringing expertise in leadership development, employee experience, culture, and change management.

As a member of the region's senior leadership team, you will drive large-scale initiatives and lead through complex challenges. You'll build world-class HR teams that leverage data, predictive analytics, and high judgment to deliver excellence throughout the employee lifecycle. The Regional Sr. HR Manager translates PXT priorities into clear, actionable strategy at the regional level, strengthening leadership capability and building scalable practices that support long-term growth.

They bring high judgment and operational depth to complex challenges—from investigations to talent decisions—leading with clarity, empathy, and accountability. Through strategic workforce planning, risk mitigation, and hands-on leadership, they prepare PXT and Operations teams to meet evolving business needs. Grounded in data, trusted by partners, and focused on results, they create the conditions where both people and the business can thrive.

You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility and regularly travel (approximately 50% to various locations), ensuring personal connection and hands-on leadership where needed.



Key job responsibilities
• Translate PXT priorities into clear, actionable strategies at the regional level. Drive operational excellence by strengthening leadership capability, improving the employee experience, and building scalable practices that support performance and long-term growth through data-driven insights and high judgment decision making.

• Partner strategically with senior leaders to plan and execute long-term talent goals and business priorities. Act as the primary HR business partner for business line Regional Directors, managing PXT as a business by achieving key operational, financial, and team goals while balancing short and long-term objectives.

• Lead, teach and develop high-performing PXT teams by setting vision, providing coaching, monitoring service levels, and holding teams accountable. Ensure effective succession planning, talent development, and performance management across the region.

• Drive organizational health and positive employee experience through regular site inspections, feedback mechanisms, and deep-dive analytics to identify emerging trends and potential risks. Implement data-driven action plans to improve attendance, enhance engagement, reduce attrition, and foster a thriving workplace culture while proactively addressing challenges across all sites

• Manage risk and compliance by anticipating trends, addressing employee relations issues, and ensuring adherence to policies and regulations. Partner with Legal and Employee Relations on sensitive cases and serve as an escalation point for complex issues.

• Lead change management and communications initiatives across the region, providing clear direction aligned with organizational vision. Act as the designated champion for organizational transformations and operational changes.

• Build and maintain strong partnerships with internal stakeholders (e.g., Centers of Excellence, shared services) and community partners. Serve as an external face for Amazon while fostering meaningful community relationships and initiatives.

A day in the life
Your day will be a dynamic blend of strategic leadership and hands-on problem-solving, balancing virtual management with on-site engagement across multiple locations. You'll drive strategic direction by leveraging advanced analytics and predictive insights to enhance organizational effectiveness and set long-term goals. A significant portion of your time will focus on coaching leadership teams and developing talent to ensure consistent delivery of excellence.

In your role, you'll maintain operational excellence by monitoring service levels, driving accountability, and managing critical escalations to maintain high performance standards. You'll partner with diverse stakeholders to create efficient, scalable solutions that achieve both people and business objectives while identifying and implementing innovative approaches to HR challenges, always with an eye on creating Earth's best place to work.

Crisis management and key decision validation will be crucial components as you address urgent issues impacting the workforce and business operations. Throughout your day, you'll seamlessly shift between immediate tactical needs and long-term strategic initiatives, using technology and data-driven insights to efficiently prioritize and manage your network's diverse requirements. Your role will demand both innovative thinking and operational rigor as you work to create meaningful impact across your region.



About the team
Amazon’s Fulfillment Centers (FCs) within North American Customer Fulfillment (NACF) are fast-paced environments that utilize robotics, scanning machines, and computer systems that track and allow the delivery of millions of items (and smiles) to households daily.

NACF PXT is a talent cultivator where Amazonians gain a depth of experience and expertise nurtured to grow, flourish and thrive in other business lines across Amazon. Our HR Leaders provide strategic and tactical leadership direction, executing our people initiatives, providing internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement in locations with up to 6,000 associates. NACF's PXT teams are flexible, thoughtful, socially responsible, and are always planning for the future.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- 10+ years of human resources leadership, or 10+ years of leadership in operations, customer service, retail, distribution, shipping/logistics, healthcare, hospitality, or manufacturing experience
- Experience supporting both hourly and salaried workforce

title: Sr. Marketing Measurement Manager , Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

We are seeking a Sr. Marketing Measurement Manager to own how Amazon Leo measures marketing. This role owns the measurement plan itself and holds it across global marketing, segment marketing, data science, data engineering, and our agency partners. You will own the measurement and reporting roadmap, the attribution and experimentation agenda, brand tracking, and the voice of customer program management, across consumer, business, and government segments.

This is a high-impact role requiring both strategic ownership and hands-on technical depth. Measurement capability at Amazon Leo is in development. You will decide what gets built and in what order, write the requirements that partner teams build to, and arbitrate between competing requests when capacity is the constraint.


Key job responsibilities
• Own the measurement and learning roadmap — what the business needs to know, in what priority, and by when — sequenced against launch and segment milestones, and run the mechanisms that keep marketing, data, and agency partners on one plan.
• Translate business questions into measurement requirements that partner teams build to, and arbitrate between competing requests when capacity is the constraint.
• Own the attribution and marketing mix modeling roadmaps. Partner with data science and data engineering on building the capability, and own how the results are interpreted, published, and adopted.
• Own the experimentation agenda — what the business needs to learn and the decision each test has to answer. Economics and data science own experimental design and statistical analysis.
• Own the brand tracking program and program manage the voice of customer program end to end, across consumer, business, and government segments, partnering with research on survey design.
• Own the reporting agenda — the metrics leadership sees in weekly and monthly business reviews, the executive scorecard, and the requirements behind every dashboard, working with intelligence engineering to build them.
• Drive alignment on metric definitions, taxonomy, and data governance across segments and regions, and own the data requirements measurement depends on — tagging, taxonomy conformance, clickstream coverage, and quality gates. Data engineering and marketing technology own the implementation.
• Own the measurement tooling roadmap and vendor evaluation, including the recommendation to keep, replace, or retire.


*** Export Control Requirement ***
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

About the team
The Amazon Leo Marketing team is responsible for building a world-class brand and driving global demand for a transformational connectivity service. The Marketing Technology & Operations team builds the systems, data flows, measurement, and insights that support a multi-segment global business. We operate with the agility of a startup inside Amazon, partnering closely with Engineering, Product, Science, and global marketing teams to ensure our decisions are grounded in high-quality data.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience with attribution methodology and marketing experimentation — enough depth to write requirements, judge a method's limits, and interpret results, without owning the modeling.
- Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements.
- Experience defining requirements for, and delivering through, data engineering and data science partner teams.
- Experience building, executing, and scaling cross-functional marketing programs.
- Experience communicating measurement results and recommendations to senior leadership.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience measuring marketing across more than one segment — consumer, business, or public sector — with a distinct approach for each.
- Experience standing up marketing measurement for a pre-launch or newly launched business, rather than operating measurement that already exists.
- Experience commissioning and interpreting marketing mix modeling and geo or market-level incrementality tests, including communicating the tradeoff between clean measurement and forgone revenue.
- Experience running a brand tracking program with an external research vendor.
- Experience managing a voice of customer or survey program across multiple owning teams.
- Experience with marketing and data platforms — web analytics, customer data platforms, marketing automation, campaign platforms, and a cloud data warehouse.
- Experience in technology, media, or telecommunications; satellite internet; or subscription services.
- Advanced degree in a quantitative field.

descriptionHtml:
Amazonは、何百万の商品をお客様へ提供し続けることによって、世界的に認知度が高く、グローバルリーディングカンパニ—としての地位を確立しています。また、“地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業”であり続けるため、日々改善と改革を行っており、それらの業務へ貢献できる経験豊富な人材を求めています。

JCFS(Japan Customer Fulfillment Solutions)とは、AmazonのFulfillment Solutionを追求するオペレーション技術統括本部です。アマゾンジャパンオペレーション業務の中核部門としてオペレーションの各部門を効率的に連携することに貢献します。
JCFSは、リライアビリティー＆メンテナンスエンジニアリングファシリティーズ部門(以下RME-F)において、Facility Managerを探しています。本ポジションは、アマゾンジャパンにおける、フルフィルメントセンター(以下FC)の設備の維持管理とそこで働く従業員の職場環境の日々改善を、Outsourcingを活用して実現していくポジションです。

Facility Managerは建屋の建築、電気、空調、衛生、消火、昇降設備の保守点検及び不具合対応や小規模な工事、そしてCafeteria運営や売店、シャトルバスの運行管理、各種資産の管理、FCの運営にとって重要なコストの管理も行います。施設管理では年間保全計画や中長期保全計画のプランと実施、Cafeteria運営では、全従業員が満足できる環境作りに積極的に取組、カスタマーエクスぺリエンスの向上を成し遂げます。 そして従業員の通勤手段であるシャトルバスのダイヤ改正や適切な運行管理とコスト管理でカスタマーに貢献します。
また、サステナビリティにも貢献します。 FC内で発生する消費電力を最適化するべく、省エネ活動を提案・実行します。次に廃棄物の低減を目的としたリサイクル率の向上やコンプライアンスを遵守した運営費用の最適化を協力会社と共に深堀し改善します。
そして、行政や建屋オーナー、各種委託先と折衝しながら良好な関係を築き、FCの安定稼働に繋げます。

以上の業務をOutsourcing先の協力会社と管理しながら、その管理体制も改善するべく提案・実行のリードを担ってもらいます。また、FCや自身の管轄だけでなく、全国のFCのRME-F設備管理を行っている各拠点の担当者とディスカッションを含むコミュニケーションを密に行い、情報・学び・成功体験を共有・標準化して展開する業務にも取り組んでいただきます。社内外ともに良好な関係性を築ける高いコミュニケーション能力を発揮し、自ら行動を起こし結果に繋げる、強いドライブ力をもった方からの応募をお待ちしています。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
- Effettuare chiamate in uscita ai clienti.
- Investigare e risolvere le problematiche nelle consegne, all’occorrenza in collaborazione con i partner Amazon nei settori logistica e consegne.
- Tenere traccia dello stato di avanzamento delle domande e richieste dei clienti su base quotidiana, settimanale e mensile.
- Seguire le procedure operative standard e assicurare la sicurezza dei dati dei clienti.
- Assistere con le comunicazioni interne, anche facendo presentazioni e contribuendo ai programmi di miglioramento continuo e coinvolgimento all’interno dell’azienda.

A day in the life

Man mano che gli ordini verranno spediti e consegnati, sarai in contatto con magazzini, associate, partner per le consegne e clienti ogni volta che avranno bisogno di assistenza o informazioni. Se un cliente dovrà riprogrammare una consegna, starà a te informare i nostri partner per le consegne. Se noterai problematiche con le consegne, opererai per risolverle, così da assicurare sempre ai nostri clienti un’esperienza impeccabile senza dover contattare Amazon.
Opererai nel cuore pulsante della logistica di Amazon e avrai modo di sviluppare esperienza in ambito logistico e nel servizio clienti: due degli ambiti in cui Amazon non ha rivali. Sarai in contatto con i clienti quotidianamente, facendo tesoro della tua profonda comprensione della nostra supply chain e conoscenza dei partner per le consegne e dei magazzini nel mercato locale.

- Experience in an administrative support role involving collaboration with internal or external teams
- Vasta esperienza nella gestione delle domande e richieste dei clienti, telefonicamente e tramite e-mail.
- Vasta esperienza nella risoluzione di problemi inerenti a domande e richieste dei clienti o problematiche con i processi interni.

title: Teamleiter Instandhaltung (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist der Kern von Amazons Engagement für Innovation. Amazon entwickelt sich weiter und dieses Team sorgt dafür, dass dies auch die von uns verwendeten Technologien und Tools tun. Als Senior RME Technician hilfst Du uns, der Entwicklung einen Schritt voraus zu bleiben. Du setzt die neuesten Technologien ein und identifizierst neue, effiziente Arbeitsmethoden. In dieser Rolle achtest Du genau auf unsere Prozesse und trägst dazu bei, dass wir unsere höchsten Sicherheitsstandards befolgen und weiter erhöhen.

Key job responsibilities
Best Practice und Unterstützen im Bedienen von Geräten und Anlagen mit den höchsten Sicherheitsstandards
Verfolgen der Geräteleistung durch visuelle Prüfungen, zustandsorientierte Überwachung und vorbeugende Wartungsmaßnahmen und Einplanen zusätzlicher Wartung je nach Bedarf
Verantwortung für das technische Team während seiner Schicht und dessen Unterstützung und Weiterentwicklung
Lösung von Problemen an Anlagen, um Betriebsausfallzeiten zu reduzieren und die schnellstmögliche Abfertigung von Paketen zu ermöglichen
Unterstützung bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Systemen und Standardisierung von Prozessen im ganzen EU-Netzwerk

A day in the life
Du betreust ein Instandhaltungsteam innerhalb einer Schicht und sorgst dafür, dass alle Mitarbeitenden die erforderlichen Werkzeuge zur Verfügung haben und diese einwandfrei funktionieren. Das beinhaltet die Überwachung von Prozessen, damit Vorschriften und Richtlinien befolgt werden, ebenso wie die Gewährleistung der Durchführung vorbeugender Wartungsmaßnahmen, um die Betriebszeit unserer Anlagen zu maximieren.
Durch Deine Beobachtungen während der Schichtarbeit machst Du Verbesserungsvorschläge, um unsere Systeme noch effizienter und produktiver zu gestalten, und setzt diese Verbesserungen EU-weit um. Außerdem nutzt Du Tools wie SCADA zur Überwachung von Prozessen, um deren Leistungsfähigkeit zu gewährleisten, und unterstützt administrative Aufgaben in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Deinen Führungskräften.
Du arbeitest vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren. Du arbeitest in Schichtmodellen, die Nächte und Wochenenden umfassen können. Mit den Kenntnissen und Erfahrungen, die Du sammelst, wirst Du Dich zu weiteren Führungspositionen weiterentwickeln.

About the team
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt.
Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen.
Alle unsere Aktivitäten sind darauf ausgerichtet, die Ausfallzeiten an Amazons wichtigsten Betriebsstandorten zu reduzieren, damit Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen rechtzeitig erhalten. Oft arbeiten wir früh morgens, spät abends oder in der Nachtschicht, um Wartungsarbeiten mit den geringstmöglichen Störungen vorzunehmen. Falls wir eine bessere Möglichkeit finden, eine bestimmte Aufgabe zu erledigen, verfügen wir über die Fertigkeiten und Gelegenheiten, vollständig neue Prozesse oder bahnbrechende Technologie wie Amazon Robotics oder unseren Complex Item Sorter einzuführen.

Basic qualifications

- Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung, anerkannt durch die Industrie- und Handelskammer (IHK) oder Handwerkskammer (HWK) oder Nachweis eines erfolgreich abgeschlossen Hochschulstudium im Ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Bereich (Maschinenbau / Elektrotechnik oder artverwandt) einer deutschen Hochschule oder anerkannte ausländische Hochschulabschlüsse (BA, B. Sc., MA, M. Sc., Dipl.-Ing.)
- Zusätzlich, eine abgeschlossene Qualifikation als Industriemeister, Handwerksmeister oder Staatlich Geprüfter/Anerkannter Techniker oder mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung
- Praktische Erfahrung im Führen von Teams
- Erfahrung in der Automatisierung und Instandhaltung von Förderanlagen
- Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie Grundsprachkenntnisse in Englisch

Preferred qualifications

- Erfahrung in der Betreuung von Fremdfirmen
- Verständnis von SPS-basierten Steuersystemen und gesetzlichen Compliance-Anforderungen

descriptionHtml:

A day in the life

Daily responsibilities include planning and coordinating preventive maintenance with schedulers, organizing and tracking all rack calibration activities, and maintaining accurate documentation and hardware configuration data in partnership with supporting engineering teams.

This role also oversees the readiness of spare test racks, ensuring they are maintained, functional, and available for rapid swap-in when needed. It includes coordinating any required repairs to return equipment to operational status. Additional responsibilities include cataloging test harness requirements, monitoring inventory and life-usage of harnesses, and ensuring adequate spare coverage.

The engineer is expected to respond quickly to escalations from technicians, providing troubleshooting support and resolving operational issues with the test racks to minimize production downtime.

title: Sr. Power Systems Engineer, Generation, AWS Global Energy
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about large power infrastructure systems? Do you love to innovate, discover, and apply your knowledge to advance world-class systems? Do you get excited about the idea of pushing the boundaries of power systems to handle the latest emerging technology? We are seeking a power systems engineer with experience in power systems and energy storage to support our growing requirements for novel solutions to delivering power to AWS data centers.

We are looking for a candidate with a track record of working on difficult power system problems and deep understanding of energy and power systems. As a Sr. Power Systems Engineer, Generation you will work within the Power Generation Solutions team to develop advanced electrical systems, model and evaluate power flow, define power generation requirements, and lead design integration to maximize the capacity out of our systems. You will own challenging problems that span multiple teams and drive technical decisions that impact AWS’ global infrastructure strategy. You will work on the technical strategy of different power and energy configurations, including developing optimization and control logic to ensure that we can exceed our customers’ expectations for delivering highly available power at the lowest costs for our data centers. You will work across multiple organizations, including utility-facing teams, data center and hardware engineering teams, compute and software teams, operations, finance, legal, and public policy teams to advance new concepts. Your technical expertise on power systems and power generation will guide cross-functional teams in making critical design decisions, evaluating trade-offs, and managing technical risks across complex power systems.

Amazon has a global presence, therefore, domestic and international travel may be necessary. Teamwork is absolutely necessary for us to accomplish our goals. You must be able to work within a team and collaborate with others to accomplish the required tasks. This includes working with internal groups as well as external suppliers and consultants, including utilities, manufacturers, vendors, and contractors.

At Amazon Web Services (AWS), our data centers are industry leading examples of innovation in the areas of data center critical infrastructure design, space utilization, energy efficiency, and cost effectiveness. We are known for our speed to market, reliability, and lowest total cost of ownership. Our Engineers are on the forefront of creating and delivering the most innovative products to our customers and are known for being a diverse and upbeat team that is continually improving the world of cloud computing. We continue to grow and are looking for individuals that can support our mission, enjoy a challenge, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning. AWS’s work environment is unique and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate. If you are a creative, smart, and driven individual that enjoys working with complex problems, we want YOU!

Key job responsibilities
As a Sr. Power Systems Engineer, Generation on the Power Generation Solutions team, you will be responsible for:

• Developing designs and analysis of different energy storage technologies, including, but not limited to; battery energy storage systems, long duration energy storage systems, and utility-scale energy storage
• Evaluating and supporting the development of power generation configurations for different applications, including primary, temporary, or backup power
• Support the integration of different power sources, such as electric utilities, diesel generators, reciprocating engines, gas turbines, fuel cells, microgrids, distributed energy resources, and renewable energy, to serve data center loads in grid connected or grid independent configurations
• Understanding current trends in data center power demands and grid integration of large loads
• Understanding the design and functionality of the global data center fleet, including existing, upcoming, and unique site designs
• Interpreting, evaluating, and developing Single Line Drawings (SLD), engineering drawings, equipment submittals, equipment specifications documentation, and performance data to advance concepts and solutions
• Providing input and direction to Data Center Engineering teams for design revisions for new data centers as well as to Field Engineering for operational data center upgrades to meet critical strategic requirements
• Working independently and have frequent reviews with Senior and Principal Engineers in the team and with partner teams
• Working on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions
• Being positive and offer creative, out of the box solutions
• Continuously learning curious about how things work, and willing to test and push new ideas
• Having fun and working hard!

About the team
The Power Generation Solutions team creates and delivers product and engineering solutions in for power and energy to help advance AWS’ mission to deliver world-leading cloud services. Our solutions are guided by four main principles; unlocking capacity growth, maintaining high infrastructure uptime, minimizing infrastructure costs, and advancing our net-zero carbon Climate Pledge. To deliver these solutions, our team provides technical input to realize a shared vision and strategy with partner teams and provides engineering support across the project or product lifecycle to deliver the solution. We provide grid analytics and manage and develop models for determining the total energy and water use within our fleet of data centers and work with partners on improving overall performance.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
- Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities
- 6+ years of experience with power systems or electrical design
- Experience with dynamic and transient power system modeling software, such as PSCAD, PSSE, or similar software.
- Extensive experience and knowledge of power generations equipment, systems, controls, including, but not limited to; diesel generators, distributed energy resources, or gas turbines.
- Design experience and operational knowledge of medium-voltage and high-voltage equipment, including substation configurations, protection requirements, and integration of energy storage systems
- Ability to interpret wiring diagrams, single and three-line diagrams, submittals, sequence of operations, and electrical drawing packages

Preferred qualifications

- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- 6+ years of direct experience with the design, construction, operation, or maintenance of mission critical data centers or power infrastructure
- Master’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering or related field
- Working knowledge of continuous operating redundant electrical systems and power infrastructure. title: E2E L&TD-Learning Exp Manager, Learning and Talent Development (E2E L&TD)
descriptionHtml:
➣ 職務概要
Amazonのミッションは、地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業になることです。E2E Learning and Talent Development (E2E L&TD) チームでは、Associate Trainingをリードする、Learning Experience Managerを募集しています。

➣ 求められる人物像
・オペレーションを深く理解している。
・自分だけで決定できる権限がなくても、業務をリードすることに抵抗がない。
・People Managerとして、遠隔地で勤務するチームメンバーの目標設定や支援ができる。
・口頭および文書でのコミュニケーションを効果的にまとめ上げ、それぞれにおいて適切な意見交換の場を設けることができる。
・複雑な情報を簡素化し、実行可能な計画を組み立てられる。
・個人とグループの能力開発におけるニーズを、評価することができる。
・複数業務の両立を図り、優先順位をつけることができる。
・カスタマーやステークホルダーに対し、積極的な態度と存在感を維持することができる。
・複数のチーム間で目標や目的を定め、伝達することができる。
・効果的にフィードバックを与えると同時に、受けることができ、円滑にコミュニケーションができる。
・ビジネスレベルの日本語力

➣ 役割について
Learning Experience Managerは、オペレーションをサポートし、日々の学習体制が問題なく運営されているかを監督します。ネットワーク標準学習プログラムが、確実に実施され、一貫して活用されるようにします。Learning Experience Managerは、定められたベンチマーク基準の達成、パフォーマンスを維持・向上させるための行動の監査・実施をリードします。このポジションは、最寄りの拠点をベースとし、必要に応じて各拠点に出張 (25-50%)して業務にあたります。
責任範囲の担当拠点は、着任後に決めますが、日本全国に部下となるメンバーが所属しているため、拠点間を巡回しながらサポートを提供します。

具体的な業務は、以下の通りです。
・アソシエイトのオンボーディング教育、トレーニング、指導のレベルを引き上げ、成功に導く。
・Amazon Flex デリバリーパートナーが配達に慣れるよう、オンボーディングプロセスを改良し、成功に導く。
・学習体験をより良くするために、データを追跡し、傾向を分析し、理解する。
・チームの重要な指標を担当地区で管理・推進する。
・日々の生産目標を理解し、学習体制を足掛かりとして活用して、安全・品質・生産性を向上させる標準作業を実施する。
・主要なステークホルダー（オペレーション）から意見を収集し、結果をまとめ、報告をする。
・担当地域のトレーニングプログラム（LogOn）が遂行されているか、管理する。
・チームが作成したトレーニングプログラムの実施に際して、現場でサポートする。
・必要に応じて、トレーニングセッションを調整・推進する。
・安全道場とトレーニング領域の監査、オンサイトでの立ち上げサポートのためのラーニング要件の確認・実行補助。
・E2E L&TD組織全体が強みと機会を特定できるよう、フィードバックを収集するための方法を管理する。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Basic qualifications

- ・ビジネスレベルの日本語
- ・3-5年以上のPeople Managementの経験
- ・定量データをベースに改善したことがある経験

Preferred qualifications

- ・ビジネスレベルの英語
- ・遠隔拠点で活躍する部下を育成した経験
- ・ステークホルダーマネジメントの経験

title: Data Center Engineering Operations Engineer
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Primary responsibilities and SME fields include, but are not limited to:

Operations and Maintenance:

· Ownership of all Data Center changes/events/incidents/problems from beginning to end as well as overseeing the completion of post-mortems, root cause analysis and follow-up resolution actions.
· Responsible for ensuring maintenance/ repairs of site-critical facility infrastructure or a Data Center are planned and executed to the best interest of the business.
· Responsible for Asset and Inventory management.
· Develop and maintain method statements, standard operating procedures, emergency response procedures, preventive maintenance programs, and all technical documentation.
· Ensure standardization and consistency with best-in-class operating practices. (Technical Writing Skills and Automation)
· Develop a complete, deep knowledge of the design intent, operational alternatives and contingency plans related to all Data Center systems.
· Manage the engineering aspects of the Data Centers related to financial and cost control, code and regulatory compliance, personnel management, staff training and development
· Health & Safety, local statutory requirements, environmental and energy management.
· Develop and deliver the regular engineering reports and ensure adherence to contracted deliverables including SLA’s and KPI’s.
· Communicate operating philosophies, technical information, objectives and expectations to Amazon personnel and to the vendor critical facilities management teams.
· Providing hands on facility support where required (e.g. installation of new equipment, decommissioning of equipment, replacement of faulty equipment, internal audits…etc.)
· Oversee technical compliance auditing and the effective and timely close out of corrective action plans. Perform annual operational reviews with a focus on compliance with the Amazon standards and all applicable regulatory requirements. (Audits).
· Manage the development and delivery of the portfolio of Energy/Environmental Management Programs. Keep abreast of Data Center industry innovation.

Incident and Emergency Response:
o Reviewing incident reports, documenting periodic trend summaries, and providing updates and recommended actions to management.
o Managing information flow during incidents while providing regular updates to management.
o Manage and coordinate with vendors to resolve any incidents during emergency situations. This may require to physically be dispatched on to site to investigate and resolve the issue.

title: HR Associate Partner, Fixed-term, PXT
descriptionHtml:
**Dies ist ein 2-Jahres-Vertrag.**

Im Streben danach, der beste Arbeitgeber der Welt zu sein, treiben unsere globalen Human-Resources-Teams – bekannt als People eXperience and Technology (PXT) – den Unternehmenserfolg voran, indem sie eine sichere, inklusive und innovative Unternehmenskultur fördern. Die Rolle des Associate Partners bietet einen Einstieg in den HR-Bereich bei Amazon und konzentriert sich auf grundlegende HR-Prozesse sowie die direkte Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden. Der Associate Partner sorgt für außergewöhnliche Mitarbeitererlebnisse, indem er sowohl menschliche Expertise als auch technologische Lösungen einsetzt. Er verwaltet wesentliche HR-Transaktionen und baut gleichzeitig bedeutungsvolle Verbindungen zu Mitarbeitenden in einem zunehmend digitalen Arbeitsumfeld auf. Diese Rolle ergänzt Amazons sich weiterentwickelnde PXT-Servicekanäle – von KI-gestützten Systemen bis hin zu persönlichen Supportoptionen – indem sie dort personalisierte Unterstützung und menschliche Nähe bietet, wo diese am wertvollsten sind. Durch die effektive Balance zwischen technologiegestützten Prozessen und bedeutungsvoller Interaktion tragen sie dazu bei, ein nahtloses PXT-Erlebnis zu schaffen, das Amazons Engagement, der beste Arbeitgeber der Welt zu sein, weiter stärkt.

Zu deinen Hauptaufgaben gehören die Bearbeitung von HR-Transaktionen, das Management von Zeit- und Anwesenheitsfragen sowie die grundlegende Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden – bei komplexeren Anliegen erfolgt die Weiterleitung an erfahrenere Kolleginnen und Kollegen. Je nach Bedarf bist du als Associate Partner für mehrere Standorte innerhalb deiner geografischen Region (Cluster) zuständig und fungierst als erste Anlaufstelle für grundlegende HR-Anfragen. Als Associate Partner im One PXT Team trägst du dazu bei, durch jede Interaktion ein herausragendes Mitarbeitererlebnis zu gestalten. Die Rolle erfordert eine einladende und zugängliche Präsenz sowie die präzise und zeitnahe Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden zu Themen wie Benefits, Unternehmensrichtlinien und Gehaltsabrechnung.

Du wirst vor Ort an einem Amazon-Standort arbeiten. Bedarfsorientiert unterstützt du temporär auch umliegende Standorte.


Key job responsibilities
• Reaktionsschnelle, freundliche und professionelle Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden über verschiedene Kanäle (persönlich, digital, per E-Mail, telefonisch) – mit genauen und zeitnahen Informationen zu Benefits, Richtlinien, Gehaltsabrechnung und weiteren HR-relevanten Themen.
• Sicherstellung der Genauigkeit, Integrität und Vertraulichkeit von Mitarbeiterdaten durch die sorgfältige und sichere Pflege und Verarbeitung von Unterlagen.
• Beitrag zu einer positiven und inklusiven Unternehmenskultur durch die Unterstützung und Umsetzung von Mitarbeiterengagement- und Anerkennungsinitiativen – einschließlich der Planung und Durchführung von Veranstaltungen, die den Zusammenhalt fördern und Leistungen würdigen.
• Unterstützung datenbasierter Entscheidungsfindung durch die Erhebung, Prüfung und Analyse wichtiger Personalkennzahlen, darunter Anwesenheit, Fluktuation und Engagement.
• Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften und Supportteams, um Mitarbeitende über KI-gestützte und klassische Self-Service-Tools sowie HR-Ressourcen zu informieren und zu schulen – mit dem Ziel, das Mitarbeitererlebnis und die betriebliche Effizienz zu verbessern. Nutzung von KI als primäres Hilfsmittel bei der Recherche und Problemlösung sowie proaktiver Einsatz verfügbarer Ressourcen und interner Netzwerke.
• Erstellung und Veröffentlichung klarer, professioneller interner Kommunikation für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte unter Einhaltung der organisatorischen Standards und des gewünschten Kommunikationsstils.
• Erkennung und Weiterleitung komplexer oder sensibler Anliegen an die zuständigen HR- und Führungsverantwortlichen – darunter Gehaltsabweichungen, Dienstplanungskonflikte, Anträge auf Anpassungen am Arbeitsplatz, Schwerbehindertenangelegenheiten, Abwesenheitsfragen, Vorwürfe von Fehlverhalten, Richtlinienverstöße, rechtliche oder betriebsrätliche Anliegen sowie weitere Mitarbeiterbeziehungsthemen.

title: Sr Product Manager, Payments, Amazon Payments - Installments
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to shape how millions of customers pay for what they love? Amazon's Payments team is looking for a Product Manager to own and evolve installments programs that directly improve affordability for customers and sellers. This is a high-visibility role at an exciting inflection point: the team is expanding its installments offerings and refining fee models to better reflect seller-specific dynamics, all while charting a clear path to financial sustainability. You will partner with business, technology, and finance teams to define product strategy, author vision documents, and deliver features that drive measurable results. If you thrive on turning insights into impactful product decisions, we'd love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
Define and own the installments product roadmap, making transparent trade-off decisions on sequencing, scope, and timelines in partnership with your dedicated technology team.
Author press-release/frequently-asked-questions (PR/FAQ) documents and business requirements, then collaborate with engineering to design, build, and launch features that improve customer affordability and seller participation.
Manage the installments program profit-and-loss statement, analyzing performance data and market trends to identify opportunities and refine fee structures.
Use generative artificial intelligence tools alongside proven product management methods to speed up insight generation and development cycles.
Lead and develop up to two direct reports, coaching them on product management practices while building an inclusive, high-performing team.

A day in the life
Your week is roadmap-driven. Mornings often start with a review of key metrics in the weekly business review, followed by syncs with your engineering partners to unblock development and refine upcoming releases. Afternoons mix heads-down analysis of seller and customer data with collaborative sessions alongside business teams. Because the Brazilian market has unique payment dynamics, much of your strategic thinking happens independently as you tailor approaches to local realities. You will also have regular exposure to senior leaders, presenting progress and advocating for your product priorities.

About the team
We sit within Amazon's Payments organization with a clear mission: provide the most customer-friendly payment options by expanding access and increasing affordability. Our team has a dedicated technology group, which means you have real creative space to conceive and ship new features. The team is actively investing in growing its installments programs and evolving its fee model, so you will join at a moment where your decisions directly shape the product's financial trajectory. If you want to build strong business acumen, turn seller insights into product improvements, and see your work impact millions of customers, this is the place to do it.
