title: Software Devevelopment Manager, AWS Tax Engine, AWS Invoicing
descriptionHtml:
Would you like to lead the team that determines the correct tax on transactions across AWS and beyond? AWS Tax Engine owns the services that compute tax worldwide — determining jurisdiction and tax treatment, calculating the correct amounts, and supporting the collection and remittance of tax across an expanding set of countries, jurisdictions, and tax regimes. These are business-critical, high-volume systems that sit directly in the billing path: they must be accurate, auditable, resilient, and continuously compliant.

The team's charter spans three dimensions. First, AWS-liable tax, where AWS is responsible for calculating, collecting, and remitting taxes — this is about AWS business expansion and compliance, the critical core that must stay correct as AWS enters new countries and regimes. Second, non-AWS-liable tax, where AWS is not the liable party but computes tax on behalf of others — for example, third-party sellers in a marketplace — this is about customer experience, reducing friction by handling tax complexity customers would otherwise bear themselves. Third, tax engine as a service, where non-AWS tenants consume the tax engine as an externalized service — this is about going beyond AWS. Leading this team means holding these together: the compliance rigor of the first, the customer-experience focus of the second, and the flexibility and multi-tenancy of the third.

We are seeking an experienced Software Development Manager to lead the AWS Tax Engine team. You will own the architecture, development, and operations of the team's software and services; establish its technical standards and engineering practices; and grow engineers across levels. You will balance a steady stream of regulatory-driven country launches against long-term platform investment, keep a demanding live-site operation healthy, and translate technical trade-offs into durable, scalable solutions with measurable business impact. You will partner widely — with product and program management, and with invoicing, marketplace, finance, tax planning, and compliance reporting stakeholders who rely on this team as a source of truth.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and grow the team. Manage, coach, and develop the AWS Tax Engine engineering team. Hire to raise the bar, develop engineers across levels (including growing senior engineers and emerging leads), and manage performance with direct, honest feedback.

- Own technical direction. Set the technical vision, strategy, and roadmap for the tax engine across determination, calculation, and collection/remittance support. Balance near-term regulatory commitments against the long-term health and maintainability of the platform.

- Own operational excellence. Keep business-critical, high-volume services in the billing path healthy — availability, scalability, correctness, auditability, and resilience. Reduce operational load and strengthen operational maturity through better runbooks, automation, and durable fixes.

- Deliver the roadmap. Plan and execute across competing demands: country and regime launches, compliance-driven changes, platform and scaling investment, and the team's AI-native initiatives. Make clear prioritization calls and communicate trade-offs to stakeholders and leadership.

- Serve multiple customer models. Evolve the engine to serve AWS-liable tax, non-AWS-liable scenarios that reduce customer friction by handling tax on behalf of others (e.g. third-party marketplace sellers), and external tenants consuming tax engine as a service — balancing compliance rigor with multi-tenancy and flexibility.

- Deepen domain ownership. Build and retain deep understanding of the team's tax determination and calculation domain, and invest in reducing single-points-of-knowledge across the team.

- Partner across the organization. Work closely with product and program management, partner engineering teams across AWS Invoicing, marketplace, finance, tax planning, and compliance reporting stakeholders to align on requirements, sequencing, and outcomes.

- Advance the AI-native direction. Drive agent-first operations and tooling that reduce operational toil and accelerate how the team builds, delivers, and operates.

About the team
AWS Tax Engine sits within AWS Invoicing, as part of the Global Tax and Compliance pillar. The team owns the tax calculation services in the billing path — a space that blends deep, constantly changing tax-domain complexity with large-scale distributed systems engineering, and spans AWS business expansion and compliance, customer experience, and taking the engine beyond AWS.

The team holds a high bar for operational excellence and works in an AI-native way, while putting real weight on how people work together. It is a collaborative environment that welcomes different perspectives and invests in each other's growth — people share ideas openly, learn from one another, and take ownership of their work, supported by mentorship and room to develop.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
- Experience in applying AI-native / agent-first approaches to operations and delivery
- Experience in a financial, billing, tax, invoicing, payments or other compliance-related domain is a plus

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. descriptionHtml:

The automation and process improvements you build for Brazil can be showcased and scaled to other international finance teams across the organization.

Key job responsibilities
Perform monthly accounting reconciliations between Amazon's records and the third-party importer, resolving discrepancies in logistics, pricing, and inventory data

title: Software Development Manager
descriptionHtml:
Ask any Customer Service Associate what slows them down and they'll show you: the field that doesn't autofill, the extra click on every third contact, the lookup that opens in another tab. None of these earns a spot on a roadmap by itself. Together they cost tens of thousands of associates minutes every day, and well over a thousand such requests reach us every year from the people on the front line.

Your team fixes them. Based in Hyderabad, it has a mandate no other team has: go into any codebase across the associate workspace, ship the fix through the owning team's pipelines and review process, and move to the next one. Each month a scored list of associate-raised problems arrives. Your team sizes them, embeds with the teams that own the code, and ships. Every fix credits the associate who raised it.

What sets this role apart is that you run a mechanism, not just a team. The monthly intake with product leaders, the capacity math, the working relationships with a dozen engineering managers whose code your engineers touch, and the quarterly story to senior leadership about what got better are all yours. You'll also be the one who can say, with evidence, where the workspace's architecture makes small fixes hard. That feeds directly into the 2027 effort to rebuild it as one AI-assisted experience.

You'll lead seven engineers directly and work as a peer with a senior program manager who runs intake and a senior engineer who sets the technical bar, with evenings that overlap partner teams in Seattle, Toronto, and Austin. If you like shipping every week and reading the thank-you notes, this is the job.

Key job responsibilities
Own the fix-it mechanism end to end: monthly intake with product and senior leadership, engineer-led estimation, sequencing against capacity, delivery, and a readiness check before each fix reaches associates.

Deliver through embedded execution. Your engineers join the team that owns the affected code as temporary members, follow its design and review norms, use its pipelines and tests, and leave the codebase better than they found it. You make that model work across teams in three cities.

Hire, grow, and retain a team of software engineers spanning early-career to senior. Set and hold the bar on design, code, testing, and documentation, and coach engineers through promotion.

Build and keep trust with every engineering manager whose codebase your team touches. Negotiate access, review bandwidth, and release windows; resolve design disputes through principal engineers rather than around them.

Measure what matters: fixes shipped, associate impact per fix, and mechanism health, reported quarterly to senior leadership.

Deliver through others: remove blockers, make scope calls, and keep stakeholders informed without surprises.

Make the team AI-native: use AI tooling to raise velocity and quality across unfamiliar codebases.

A day in the life
Your main job is keeping fixes flowing from associates' complaints to production. Mornings in Hyderabad start with the month's intake list alongside your program manager and a product leader: which problems made the cut and what each will take. Then a design review for a fix in another team's component, checking it follows their patterns, and a 1:1. Late afternoon you unblock an engineer waiting on a Seattle team's review; your evening overlaps North America for a call with that team's manager about release windows. Beyond the usual: quarterly, you tell senior leadership, with numbers, what got better for associates.

About the team

You unblock an engineer waiting on a Seattle team's review, and when North America comes online you take a call with that team's manager about release windows. Beyond the usual: quarterly, you tell senior leadership, with numbers, what got better for associates.

title: Hardware Security Lab Engineer, Devices and Services Security
descriptionHtml:
Are you a hands-on engineer who thrives at the bench with a soldering iron in one hand and a multimeter in the other? Amazon's Hardware Security team is looking for a Lab Engineer to support security testing operations across our consumer electronics portfolio. This is a tactical role that combines two areas of work: physical device operations (teardowns, sample handling, and data gathering) and lab operations coordination (sample logistics, program tracking, and coordination support).

You will work alongside security engineers, using tools such as X-ray systems, microscopes, 3D printers, and other electronics lab equipment to evaluate hardware security across devices that ship to millions of households worldwide. Your findings will directly inform whether a product's security design meets the bar before it reaches customers. If you are comfortable performing device teardowns and rework at the bench, and equally at ease coordinating sample logistics and maintaining program records, this role offers a real opportunity to grow your career in hardware security.

Key job responsibilities
- Perform device teardowns and security assessments on prototype and production hardware using X-ray systems, microscopes, soldering irons, and other lab equipment, then capture, log, and organize teardown data and photographs for security engineering review.
- Manage end-to-end hardware sample logistics — request samples from program teams, coordinate shipment and receipt, maintain chain-of-custody records, and keep the device tracker accurate and up to date.
- Maintain a safe, clean, and organized lab environment, including developing and following Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), supporting environmental health and safety compliance, and identifying opportunities to improve lab efficiency.
- Collaborate with security engineers, Technical Program Managers (TPMs), and cross-functional partners in software, manufacturing, supply chain, and quality to ensure the hardware security team is engaged throughout the product development process.
- Support program coordination by tracking active security work, maintaining task tickets, and organizing documentation packages for security reviews.

A day in the life
Your morning might begin with preparing a batch of device samples for teardown and data acquisition - setting up the X-ray machine or microscope, verifying sample chain of custody, and working with security engineers to plan for the day. After a focused stretch at the bench capturing component-level data and photographs, you shift gears to update the device tracker and coordinate with a TPM on incoming samples for an upcoming milestone. You'll regularly participate in team stand-ups where you share status on open tasks and flag any blockers.

About the team
The Hardware Security team within Amazon Security partners with hardware development teams across the company to evaluate and strengthen the security of Amazon's consumer devices. The team is primarily composed of security engineers and works cross-functionally with software, hardware, manufacturing, supply chain, logistics, and quality organizations. Our assessments feed directly into product launch decisions, giving the work a clear link to what ships to customers.

We are investing in building a permanent, dedicated lab engineering capability to support our growing scope. Joining now means you will help shape how the lab operates for the long term while gaining broad exposure to the security challenges behind Amazon's consumer hardware lineup.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of mechanical or electrical systems design
- Experience in hardware lab equipment such as digital scopes, logic analyzers, and soldering tools
- Experience reviewing and understanding engineering design documents for electronic, mechanical and electro-mechanical parts and assembly drawings of products
- 2+ years of computer hardware troubleshooting and repair experience, or experience in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Networking Engineering)
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience with automation and any version control tools
- Associate's degree or equivalent in Electronics, Mechanics, Product Design, Manufacturing Technologies, Computer Science, or other STEM discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, material science, physics or equivalent, or experience working in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)
- Experience coordinating cross-functional inputs, meeting deadlines, and effectively managing competing priorities
- Experience managing and coordinating multiple projects simultaneously
- Experience with hardware security testing or prototype device handling.
- Experience managing hardware sample logistics and chain of custody.
- Familiarity with Amazon's Product Development Process (PDP) and hardware validation stages (HVT/EVT/DVT/PVT).
- Experience with program tracking tools (Taskei or similar) and status reporting.

title: Sr Program Manager,  Benefits , DSP, Value Added Services
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to lead design of one of Amazon's last mile business programs? Do you thrive while working backwards from a customer problem statement and designing entirely new programs from the ground up? Are you looking for a role where you can have a highly visible international impact on the business? The Worldwide Delivery Service Partner (DSP) Product and Strategy organization is seeking a Senior Program Manager to define and execute our global benefits strategy, supporting Amazon's rapidly expanding Last Mile delivery capabilities.

At Amazon, we're working to be the most Customer-centric company on earth. The Worldwide DSP Product and Strategy team is constantly re-inventing the customer experience. We're doing so by building a world class last mile operation that raises the bar on customer expectations through a rapidly expanding global network of entrepreneur owned and operated small businesses (the DSP program). To enable the program to scale in a sustainable way, we're seeking an exceptional Senior Program Manager who will define the vision and strategy for our benefits product line — spanning 401(k) retirement plans, healthcare coverage, and benefits compliance — supporting a network of 3500+ individual entrepreneurs across 22 countries.

In this role, you will be responsible for building our global benefits strategy, ensuring we deliver high-quality, regionally-appropriate benefits programs that meet the diverse needs of our DSP partners and the DAs they employ. You'll develop innovative solutions for three critical areas: designing benefits offerings (401(k), healthcare, and related programs) that adapt to our expanding delivery modes and geographic presence, creating a centralized enrollment, eligibility, and plan-administration system, and establishing a cost-effective, efficient vendor-delivery model that can rapidly roll out new benefits programs and plan changes across our global network. This is a new and fast-growing space with unique challenges in scaling a tested model across highly variable regulatory environments. You will work with cross-functional teams to leverage best practices from various last mile channels, using diverse technology to ideate, design, and launch solutions that serve our DSP partners' evolving needs – from traditional vehicle delivery to innovative new transportation modes. The optimal fit for this role will be a candidate wanting to roll-up their sleeves, dive into complex benefits and compliance challenges, develop a path forward by working with multiple stakeholders, and convince senior management that their solution is the best one.

This will be a high visibility global role, meaning that the optimal candidate will be comfortable driving critical business decisions in fast paced, high pressure, and often ambiguous environments, and elevating critical one-way door decisions to senior leadership. A successful candidate will be customer focused, highly analytical, resourceful, a big thinker, a strong writer, and able to operate at all levels of the organization. Any background in employee benefits, 401(k)/retirement administration, healthcare plan management, benefits compliance, insurance, and/or experience in risk management and program management will be considered a plus. Our organization is based in the US, but we support global operations across Americas, EMEA, and APAC. Domestic and international travel will be required 10-20% of the time.

Lead & deliver an innovative program strategy to drive step changes in DSP profitability and operating efficiency and eliminate DSP pain points within the DSP Benefits program

Monitor the effectiveness of existing programs and vendors' services (401(k) administrators, healthcare carriers, and compliance partners), using utilization data, real-time vendor data and feedback from the global stakeholders
Build and monitor benefits forecasting including creating enrollment, eligibility, and cost projections as well as quarterly funding and contribution needs
Build & manage governance for WW vendor management and provide metrics on performance and effectiveness
Partner with finance to develop financial models, run financial reviews and manage the governance, approval process & reporting for budgeting and funding the product
Build and manage a global benefits compliance program (covering 401(k)/retirement regulations, healthcare mandates, and regional statutory requirements) and drive benefits adoption
Define and maintain global business and technical requirements for your program. Communicate both program and project plans through clear, precise and regular communication with all stakeholders.
Retrieve and analyze data and insights both locally and globally to solve business problems
Manage Vendor Relationships
Monitor project execution and ensure that the project delivery is appropriate for the level of quality and in line with its target date.

title: Mechatronic Apprentice I
descriptionHtml:
Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!
About the Role:

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Apprentice (MRA), you will learn to combine electronic, mechanical, computer and automation engineering skills at the workplace. During on-the-job learning (OJL) you will work with complex high-performance manufacturing systems and will learn to analyze, troubleshoot, and repair systems to maintain process efficiency. The focus of your role will be to learn the skills and abilities to ensure safety regulations and policies are adhered to, assist in the installation, maintenance, and repair of the automated packaging and distribution equipment, ensure preventative maintenance is conducted on time to a high standard, and provide high levels of equipment availability through continuous improvement.

You will be paired with journey workers to carry out their work at various facilities, including high automation and robotics facilities in connection with service operations. You will be expected to complete work based on technical documents and instructions and carry out your work in compliance with the relevant provisions and safety regulations.

You should be an effective communicator, work well in a team, and be self-motivated. You must have the ability to work collaboratively and coordinate your activities with upstream and downstream operations partners. In addition to developing your skills, you will be mentored by senior technicians to grow in your role.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
• You will perform preventative/predictive maintenance of conveyance equipment using the appropriate job plans, procedures, and manuals.

• You will conduct maintenance and basic troubleshooting of robotics and robotic work cells.

• You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all material handling equipment components.

• You will maintain and troubleshoot motors, photo eyes, relays, proximity sensors, solenoids, motor starters, tachs, etc.
• You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Program Requirements:
• Flexible to relocate after completion of the program

• Able to enroll in and attend a 9-week training at one of four designated training providers

• Meet the minimum qualifying score on a Mechanical Aptitude Test

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

- Experience conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures
- Experience implementing safety standards
- Experience measurement reading and interpretation
- Experience reading blueprints and electrical schematics
- Experience troubleshooting and diagnosing material handling equipment (MHE)
- Experience troubleshooting and repairing operational items

title: Technicien/ne Sécurité au Travail
descriptionHtml:
Ce poste est proposé dans le cadre d'un contrat à durée déterminée (CDD) d'une durée de 12 mois à compter de la date de prise de fonction.

Assurer la sécurité et le bien-être de nos collaborateurs au travail est une priorité absolue chez Amazon. Nos Techniciens de Sécurité jouent un rôle essentiel dans ce domaine. Ce poste est l'occasion de débuter votre carrière dans la sécurité au travail et de vous développer au sein d'une entreprise internationale. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec nos experts pour surveiller votre site, ce qui vous permettra de constater chaque jour l'impact de votre travail sur le bien-être de chacun.

Key job responsibilities
- Effectuer des évaluations de risques et des audits.
- Surveiller le site pour s'assurer que les processus sont conformes aux procédures de sécurité d'Amazon.
- Créer et mettre à jour des rapports sur les indicateurs de sécurité pour vos collègues.
- Collaborer avec les équipes opérationnelles et d'autres services sur des tâches liées à la sécurité et offrir des conseils sur les processus.
- Soutenir la mise en place de nouvelles mesures de sécurité.

A day in the life
Vous travaillerez sur l'un de nos sites. Cela signifie que vous pourrez suivre de près ce qui se passe et que les collaborateurs pourront facilement vous poser des questions pendant leurs postes. Ce rôle consiste avant tout à repérer les problèmes potentiels avant qu'ils ne surviennent. Vous passerez beaucoup de temps à vérifier le site et à comprendre comment les collaborateurs utilisent les équipements. En comprenant le fonctionnement de chaque tâche et de chaque machine, vous serez en mesure de trouver la meilleure façon de garantir la sécurité des processus. Vous serez également l'une des personnes chargées de mettre en œuvre les changements en matière de sécurité, ce qui signifie que vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec de nombreuses personnes. En plus de vos tâches quotidiennes et hebdomadaires, vous apporterez votre soutien à notre équipe Operations sur des missions ponctuelles liées à la sécurité. La sécurité est primordiale chez Amazon, et vous nous aiderez à recueillir les données essentielles qui nous permettent de maîtriser nos processus et d'anticiper tout problème. Vous partagerez également ces données avec les équipes de l'entreprise et collaborerez avec d'autres services pour vous assurer que la sécurité reste la priorité.

About the team
L'équipe Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) joue un rôle essentiel pour garantir le bien-être mental et physique de nos collaborateurs au travail. Notre équipe travaille avec les responsables, les associés et les administrations locales sur l'ensemble de nos sites, en assurant le respect des politiques d'Amazon et des réglementations légales, et en garantissant la sécurité de nos environnements de travail. L'équipe offre une variété d'opportunités, des Techniciens de Sécurité aux Responsables de Programmes. Quel que soit votre poste, vous contribuerez au développement et à la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de sécurité sur l'ensemble du réseau.

Basic qualifications

- DUT HSE (Hygiène, Sécurité, Environnement) ou BUT (Licence) en HSE.
- Expérience pertinente dans l'utilisation de l'analyse de données pour générer et expliquer des indicateurs.
- Connaissance de la législation française en matière de santé et sécurité au travail.
- Maîtrise du français et connaissances de base en anglais (A2), à l'écrit et à l'oral.

Preferred qualifications

- Les qualifications préférées ne sont pas requises pour postuler chez Amazon. Si vous possédez toutes les qualifications de base ci-dessus, nous serions ravis de recevoir votre candidature.
- Expérience avec les méthodologies Lean, 5S ou Kaizen.
- Expérience dans la planification ou la gestion d'initiatives écoresponsables.
- Capacité à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. title: Principal Software Engineer, AWS CloudWatch
descriptionHtml:
Come build the next generation of cloud observability with us. Amazon CloudWatch gives every AWS customer a single platform to send, store, and query metrics from over 70 AWS services alongside their own application telemetry, using OpenTelemetry (OTLP) and PromQL — and the same platform powers observability for Amazon's internal teams and the new CloudWatch Omni experiences. As the Principal Engineer for the CloudWatch metrics platform, you will own its technical vision and architecture end to end — the distributed query engine, the tiered storage and long-term retention systems, and the ingestion and compaction pipeline — and drive its evolution for the OpenTelemetry era. We will look to you to make high-judgment architectural trade-offs across latency, cost, durability, and scale, to set the multi-year technical strategy, and to raise the technical bar across our Dublin engineering team and the wider CloudWatch organization.

Key job responsibilities
Set the multi-year technical vision and architecture for the CloudWatch metrics platform — query execution, tiered and long-term storage, and ingestion — and drive it across multiple teams.

Own the hardest design decisions on correctness, availability, performance, and cost for a globally available 24x7 service that customers rely on to monitor, alert on, and analyze their systems in real time.

Lead the evolution toward intelligent, adaptive ingestion and make the platform the default OpenTelemetry metrics foundation across Amazon.

Work backwards from customers — AWS customers, Amazon internal teams, and the Omni experiences — to influence the roadmap and shape how millions of developers and SREs monitor their systems.

Raise the engineering bar through design and code reviews, operational excellence, and deep dives into the most complex production issues, applying durable fixes.

Mentor and grow senior engineers, and represent CloudWatch metrics in AWS-wide architecture forums and the broader OpenTelemetry/Prometheus community.

A day in the life
On a typical day you might set direction on a hard architectural trade-off in the query engine or storage tiers, deep-dive a customer-impacting performance issue to its root cause, review a senior engineer's design for a storage or compaction challenge no one has solved before, or work with product and leadership to drive this years goals and or iterate on our multi-year roadmap. You translate customer needs into architecture, break ambitious goals into incremental deliverables teams can ship, and are the engineer other principal and senior engineers come to for direct feedback on the hardest problems.

Basic qualifications

10+ years of non-internship professional software development experience.

10+ years designing and architecting new and existing large-scale distributed systems, including design patterns, reliability, and scaling.

Relevant experience in high-performance storage, time-series/metrics systems, query engines, or database internals.

Experience setting technical direction across multiple teams and delivering step-function improvements to systems at scale.

Preferred qualifications

Deep familiarity with time-series data, metrics systems, and the Prometheus and OpenTelemetry ecosystems.

Experience with S3-based storage, stream processing (e.g., Kinesis, Kafka), and columnar formats such as Parquet.

Experience with PromQL or other time-series query languages, query planning, storage compaction, and performance optimization at scale.

Systems programming experience in Rust, Java, C++, or similar.

Experience influencing architecture across organizations and mentoring senior engineers.

title: DCEO Chief Engineer , DCEO
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are looking for a detail-oriented individual to join our Data Center Engineering Operations Team. This committed group works to maintain the critical physical infrastructure that supports Amazon Web Services. Specifically, this team works to ensure that the data center's MEP operates at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups within the data centers.


Key job responsibilities
As the Data Center Chief Engineer (CE), you will be responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. You will serves as an expert technical resource reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager and interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third party vendors. Being the singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center, you will support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.

As the Chief Engineer you will manage small-to-medium impacting projects from conception to completion. These projects involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. Creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

One of the best parts to this role is that you will direct, train and support Engineering Operation Technicians in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems.

• Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in a data center.
• Operate independently with limited direct management
• Act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within the data center, escalating to the Data Center Facility Manager as needed
• Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures
• Troubleshoot and report of facility and data sever-level events within internal SLA
• Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams
• Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians
• Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff
• Utilize internal CMMS to manage building workflows
• Communicate complex technical information to a non-technical audience

This role is carried out in an operational site environment and may involve working at height, moving around uneven surfaces, and handling tools or materials in line with HSA manual handling guidelines. Duties may include manual handling and working in confined spaces and areas with elevated noise levels. Reasonable accommodations will be considered in line with health, safety, and equality legislation.


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Experience in vendor management
- Knowledge of mission critical systems (data centers, hospitals, power plants, military facilities, etc.)
- Experience with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in construction or project management
- Experience in operations and on-call support for data center facilities, mission critical plants, or production facilities

- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. The Power & Cooling (PAC) team is seeking a results-oriented individual with deep inventory and logistics expertise to own the storage and inventory governance that makes on-time commissioning possible for Data Center Power & Cooling equipment. Our Inventory & Logistics Leaders are high-energy self-starters who bring a specialized skill set — inventory control, warehouse governance, and logistics execution — that raises the bar for how AWS manages a large, fast-growing long-lead-equipment inventory.
As a member of the Power and Cooling Post-Delivery organization, this is an individual-contributor role that owns the upstream governance of storage and inventory for Long Lead Equipment (LLE) — not the physical warehousing itself, but everything that makes it work. You will hold third-party storage locations accountable for receiving standards and equipment condition, drive accurate inventory tracking and reconciliation, and maintain full visibility into what is on hand and where, across roughly 15 storage vendors and more than 30 locations. You own the capability that lets the organization trust what it holds — the foundation every commissioning enabler depends on. You report to the Leader of Post-Delivery & Commissioning.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own projects through completion.


Key job responsibilities
• The Inventory & Logistics Leader is an individual contributor who owns storage and inventory governance for long-lead equipment (LLE), making certain the organization knows — with confidence — what it holds, in what condition, and where.
• Storage Governance — Hold third-party storage locations accountable for receiving-inspection standards and for equipment condition while in storage; establish the receiving, condition, and reconciliation standards that do not exist today, so crates are no longer received without clear instructions or left unopened and unverified.
• Inventory Accuracy and Visibility — Drive active and accurate inventory tracking, including cycle counts, and maintain full on-hand visibility on demand. Resolve the conditions behind unvalued and unreconciled inventory — past-due material still carried in storage and item-part-number-to-purchase-order mismatches — so the portfolio can be fully valued and trusted.
• Logistics Execution — Own coordination with Amazon Cloud Logistics (ACL) for the movement of equipment into, between, and out of storage, and issue advance shipping notices to storage locations ahead of each site’s Need By Date (NBD). Make this a governed responsibility with one accountable owner rather than a side task spread across many people.
• Capacity Forecasting — Forecast storage capacity with the third party against where the build is heading, sizing the storage footprint for both growth and decline rather than being surprised by either.
• Enabling Redundancy and Spare Parts — Provide the inventory confidence that makes equipment redundancy real — swapping equipment between sites to cover a shortfall — and absorb the steady-state tracking and availability of the Critical Spare Parts program once it moves from stand-up into operation.
• Success in this role is measured by inventory accuracy, the share of the portfolio under governed and verified visibility, and the elimination of the storage surprises that today surface at commissioning — directly enabling on-time PFHO


A day in the life
• Communicate ideas concisely to a wide variety of stakeholders, for purposes ranging from informative to securing approvals from executives.
• Embody a true pioneering spirit, willing to “get your hands dirty” in a start-up environment while simultaneously developing processes, automation, and delivering results.
• Clearly define data requirements and metrics, working with teams to implement the entire data flow from capture to presentation and management.
• Apply high attention to detail and a proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously.
• Continuously improve inventory and logistics processes, building the standards and automation that make governance repeatable as the build scales.

title: Senior Tax Analyst in Indirect Tax and Impositions, Tax Engine Operations
descriptionHtml:
Ever wondered how tax gets calculated on hundreds of millions of transactions across dozens of countries, automatically, in real time? That's the Tax Engine. It's the system behind every tax calculation Amazon makes, and this role puts you right at the centre of it.

We're hiring a Tax Analyst for the Global Tax Engine Operations team in Bratislava, SK focused on regulatory fees and special impositions. Think eWaste levies, deposit return schemes, beverage container fees, and similar charges that vary wildly across jurisdictions. You won't just research these fees. You'll build the end-to-end calculation logic that makes them work at Amazon global scale.

This is not a traditional tax compliance role. You'll work with SQL, data analysis tools, and AI-powered classification models to turn complex legislation into automated, production-grade tax solutions. If you like the intersection of tax, data, and technology, this is it.


Key job responsibilities
- Own tax calculation end-to-end. From reading the legislation, through feasibility and accuracy analysis, to deploying automated calculations in the Tax Engine and monitoring them post-launch.
- Analyse transaction data, validate tax calculation accuracy, and identify gaps in fee coverage across jurisdictions.
- Use and help build AI solutions. You'll work with Amazon internal tools and generative AI tools. But you won't just be a user. You'll actively contribute to shaping how these tools are developed, tested, and improved for tax operations.
- Build and track success metrics. Define KPIs for deployed solutions and use data to drive continuous improvement.
- Identify new fee types and jurisdictions to expand coverage. Contribute directly to the team's product roadmap.
- Partner with Engineering, Legal, and Product teams to translate regulatory requirements into scalable technical solutions.
- Drive process improvements. Automate repetitive workflows and propose better ways of working.


A day in the life
No two days look the same. You might start the morning reviewing a new state-level fee proposal, then pivot to use SQL to validate calculation accuracy on live transaction data. After lunch, you're testing a new AI-assisted product classification model with the engineering team. By end of day, you're presenting accuracy metrics to stakeholders and proposing next steps. The scope grows with you. The more you bring, the more you'll own.

About the team
Tax Engine Operations sits at the crossroads of tax, engineering, and data science. People who do well here tend to grow into roles that didn't exist when they started. You could move deeper into tax automation and AI strategy, lead a programme across multiple jurisdictions, or shift into product or technical programme management within Amazon's Tax Engine org. The space is evolving fast, and we need people who want to evolve with it. If you're someone who wants to shape how AI is applied to tax at scale, not just use it, this is a strong place to start.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
- Knowledge of general AI tools

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in international indirect tax planning and strong understanding of or practical experience with tax laws in other countries
- Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business or related field
- Knowledge of at least one data-focused technology tool, such as Python, SQL, Alteryx, Amazon QuickSight, or similar
- Knowledge of strong understanding of tax compliance principles, regulations, and reporting requirements across jurisdictions

title: Sr Software Development Manager, Managed Agents, AWS
descriptionHtml:
Running AI agents in the cloud is an exciting, quickly-evolving area, and successfully deploying them at scale can be difficult. An agent runs for minutes or hours, calls tools, writes and runs code, and keeps state across many turns. It has to do all of that inside a customer's security boundary, with the same trust, reliability, isolation, and auditability that customers expect from any other AWS service. Our team builds the managed services that makes this possible. Customers define their agent definitions, and we run them as a fully managed AWS service: provisioning, sandboxed execution, session state, identity, observability, and scaling.

The service covers the whole agent lifecycle. It creates and configures agents, runs long-lived sessions with durable state, executes tools and code in isolated environments, connects to customer data and systems with appropriate identity, and gives customers the logs, metrics, and controls they need to run agents in production. We work closely with leading model providers to bring their agent experiences to AWS customers. That means our engineers solve problems at the boundary between AWS customers, frontier labs, and AWS cloud infrastructure.

As Sr. SDM for Managed Agents, you will lead a team of senior engineers building one of the newest and fastest-growing areas of AWS. You will own the technical strategy and roadmap for the service, partner with model providers and AWS service teams, and be responsible for all aspects of its end-to-end engineering, operations, and growth. This is an early-stage service. You will set the engineering bar, hire and grow the team, and make architectural decisions that influence how enterprises run AI agents for years to come.

title: CFD/Thermal Simulation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a CFD/Thermal Simulation Engineer to develop thermal and CFD models to predict, optimize and validate the thermal performance of the 5–10 MW SST.

As a CFD/Thermal Simulation Engineer you will build 3D CFD (Icepak / Fluent / COMSOL / Simcenter) and thermal-resistance models predicting SST thermal performance on a defined project. You will handle conjugate heat transfer, mesh/fidelity trade-offs, hotspot prediction and junction-margin analysis under variable load and correlate to measurement and feed optimized designs to thermal/mechanical and PE teams.



Key job responsibilities
CFD modeling:
- Build 3D thermal simulations using Icepak, ANSYS Fluent, COMSOL, Simcenter or equivalent tools.
- Model heat transfer through power electronics, cooling interfaces and system assemblies.
- Evaluate thermal distribution, hotspots and cooling-system performance.
Thermal modeling:
- Develop thermal-resistance models and junction-to-coolant analyses.
- Support semiconductor and component thermal-margin definition.
- Analyze thermal behavior under variable load profiles.
Correlation & optimization:
- Correlate simulation results with experimental measurements.
- Use test results to refine models and identify design improvements.
- Support thermal design optimization with Mechanical and Power Electronics teams.
SST System Alignment:
- Model system environmental conditions and thermal derating, including -30°C to 40°C ambient and above-40°C derating requirements.
- Correlate thermal models with efficiency, load-profile and qualification data across the SST operating envelope.


A day in the life
As a CFD/Thermal Simulation Engineer, you'll focus on building sophisticated 3D thermal simulations that predict how heat flows through power electronics and cooling systems. Your day might include developing conjugate heat transfer models using tools like Icepak, ANSYS Fluent, COMSOL, or Simcenter, then correlating your simulation results with real laboratory measurements to refine designs. You'll collaborate with mechanical and power electronics teams to identify hotspots, analyze thermal behavior under different operating conditions, and translate your findings into actionable design improvements. You'll also work across variable environmental conditions—from extreme cold to high ambient temperatures—ensuring systems perform reliably throughout their operating envelope.

About the team
We are AWS Infrastructure Services, the team that keeps the cloud running. We design, plan, deliver, and operate all AWS global infrastructure—the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that enable our customers' success. Our team tackles some of the most complex thermal and infrastructure challenges in the industry, where thousands of variables impact performance and reliability. We're building a collaborative environment where you'll partner with talented engineers across disciplines, contribute to full product ownership from concept to deployment, and help shape the future of how we cool and power the world's cloud infrastructure. You'll be part of a group that values continuous learning, embraces diverse perspectives, and supports your growth as you solve problems that matter at scale.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to celebrate our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and diversity conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We have a career path for you no matter what stage you’re in when you start here. We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering.
- Demonstrated understanding of power-electronics thermal behavior.
- Experience and ability to correlate models with laboratory measurements.
- Experience documenting design decisions, assumptions, trade-offs, risks and technical specifications.
- Experience using engineering analysis and measured evidence to drive decisions.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering.
- 2+ years experience in CFD/thermal simulation for electronics cooling with measured correlation.
- Experience with Icepak, ANSYS Fluent, COMSOL or Simcenter.
- Demonstrated working effectively with adjacent engineering disciplines and contribute to full A-to-Z product ownership.
- Demonstrated operating effectively in a greenfield environment where standards and reference designs may require interpretation and adaptation.

title: Senior Product Manager, Technical, Identity
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to define the future of how hundreds of millions of Amazon customers prove who they are? AI-powered attacks are making passwords and legacy multi-factor authentication increasingly vulnerable, and our Identity team is responding by building the next generation of authentication — passkeys, digital IDs, phishing-resistant phone-number verification, and more. As a Senior Product Manager, Technical on this team, you will own the end-to-end product lifecycle for these new authentication experiences, from problem discovery through launch and optimization, across surfaces including desktop, mobile, TV, and smart-home devices.

You will combine deep customer empathy with rigorous metrics analysis to understand how customers sign in, where friction exists, and what solutions will earn their trust. You will partner with engineering, design, legal, and cross-functional stakeholders to ship experiences that protect customers while keeping interactions simple and intuitive. If you are energized by solving complex security challenges at massive scale and want your work to be felt every time a customer interacts with Amazon, we would love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Define and evolve the authentication product strategy — assess customer needs, market trends, and emerging threats to set a clear vision for passwordless and phishing-resistant experiences across your area of ownership.
- Own the product roadmap from concept to launch, prioritizing initiatives based on customer impact and business value while managing cross-functional dependencies with engineering, design, and legal teams.
- Write detailed product requirements, user stories, and success criteria; partner with designers on prototypes and with engineers on architecture reviews to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and intuitive.
- Analyze adoption metrics, customer behavior data, and performance indicators to identify optimization opportunities, root-cause issues, and inform roadmap investments.
- Collaborate with senior leaders, partner teams, and stakeholders across the company to build alignment on new authentication initiatives and influence organization-wide priorities.

A day in the life
Your morning might start by reviewing authentication success-rate dashboards and digging into an anomaly you spotted in passkey enrollment metrics. After a design review for a new digital ID verification flow, you join your engineering team's sprint planning to refine acceptance criteria and discuss technical trade-offs. In the afternoon, you draft a product requirements document for a phishing-resistant verification feature, then meet with a partner team to align on an upcoming launch across multiple device surfaces. Between meetings, you connect with customers through usability studies and support-ticket analysis to keep your roadmap grounded in real needs.

About the team
Our Identity Services team owns one of the most highly trafficked experiences at Amazon — the moment a customer signs in. We support products like Retail, Alexa, Prime Video, and Amazon Pay across every device type, and our mission is to make authentication secure, simple, and invisible. We are dedicated to mentorship and career growth. Our team has a broad mix of experience levels, and we pair new members with one-on-one mentors and thoughtful document reviews so everyone develops into a well-rounded product manager ready to take on increasingly complex challenges.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience managing technical products or online services
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

title: ファシリティエンジニア - DCEO（データセンターエンジニアリング・オペレーションズ）
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services はすべての AWS グローバルインフラストラクチャの設計、計画、提供、運用を担当しています。私たちは、クラウドを稼働させ続ける人々です。すべての AWS データセンターとお客様がイノベーションに継続的にアクセスできるようにするすべてのサーバー、ストレージ、ネットワーク、電源、冷却設備をサポートしています。私たちはサプライチェーンに影響を与える数千もの要因を考慮しながら、最も困難な課題に取り組んでいます。そして私たちと共に支援したいと考える優秀な人材を探しています。

ソフトウェア、ハードウェア、ネットワークエンジニア、サプライチェーンスペシャリスト、セキュリティエキスパート、オペレーションマネージャー、その他の重要な役割を担う多様なチームに参加していただきます。AWS 全体の人々と協力して、お客様に最低コストで無限の容量を提供しながら、安全性とセキュリティの最高基準を提供できるよう支援していただきます。そして、大胆なアイデアを歓迎し、それを完成まで自分のものとして進める力を与える包括的な文化を体験していただけます。

Data Center Operationsチームは AWS のバックボーンであり、急速に成長する AWS ビジネスとお客様を 24 時間 365 日サポートしています。私たちは AWS の物理インフラストラクチャを維持し、安全性、セキュリティ、可用性、生産性、容量、効率性、コストの分野における運用パフォーマンスの基準を確保することに取り組んでいます。



Key job responsibilities
主な職務内容

Facility Engineer - Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) の役割は、大規模で高密度のデータセンターにおいて、施設（電気/機械システム、制御/消火システムなど）の展開、運用、保守、および関連プロジェクトの管理を担当します。
日常業務では、以下の業務に携わります:
• 建物システムの点検と監視、および施設の問題のトラブルシューティング
• 運用効率の改善とエネルギー削減
• ベンダーやパートナーとの定期メンテナンスと修理の計画と実施。これには、ブレーカー操作、機械/電気設備操作などの重要な施設運用が含まれます
• プロジェクトチームメンバーと協力してテストなどをサポート

勤務時間

12時間のシフト勤務 (うち2時間休憩)など、標準外の時間帯勤務が可能な方（4勤3休のシフトで働ける方。標準勤務時間は 8:00 ～ 20:00、20:00 ～ 8:00、または 9:00 ～ 21:00、21:00 ～ 9:00 です）



About the team
多様な経験

AWS は多様な経験を重視しています。職務内容に記載されているすべての資格やスキルを満たしていなくても、応募することをお勧めします。キャリアが始まったばかりの場合、従来の道を歩んでいない場合、または関連しない経験がある場合でも、応募をためらわないでください。

なぜ AWS なのか?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) は、世界で最も包括的で広く採用されているクラウドプラットフォームです。私たちはクラウドコンピューティングのパイオニアであり、イノベーションを止めることはありません。だからこそ、最も成功しているスタートアップから Global 500 企業まで、幅広いお客様が当社の堅牢な製品・サービスを信頼し、ビジネスを推進しています。

包括的なチーム文化

AWS では、学び、好奇心を持つことが私たちの本質です。従業員主導のアフィニティグループは、私たちが自分たちの違いを誇りに思える包括的な文化を育んでいます。Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) や AmazeCon (ジェンダーダイバーシティ) カンファレンスを含む継続的なイベントや学習体験は、私たちが独自性を受け入れることを決して止めないよう刺激を与えてくれます。

メンターシップとキャリア成長

私たちは、地球上で最高の雇用主になるために、継続的にパフォーマンスバーを引き上げています。だからこそ、ここには、より多角的な専門家に成長するのに役立つ、無限の知識共有、メンターシップ、その他のキャリア向上リソースがあります。

ワークライフバランス

私たちはワークライフハーモニーを重視しています。仕事での成功は、家庭での犠牲を伴うべきではありません。だからこそ、柔軟な勤務時間と勤務体制が私たちの文化の一部となっています。職場と家庭でサポートされていると感じるとき、クラウドで達成できないことは何もありません。

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of relevant work experience
- Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration
- ミッションクリティカルな設備の運用と保守に関する 2 年以上の関連実務経験（例: 24 時間稼働の工場、変電所、病院など）
- メンテナンス、変更管理、インシデント管理、ベンダー管理の経験または基本的な理解、およびポリシー、プロセス、手順を遵守して作業する方法
- 12時間のシフト勤務 (うち2時間休憩)など、標準外の時間帯勤務が可能な方（4勤3休のシフトで働ける方。標準勤務時間は 8:00 ～ 20:00、20:00 ～ 8:00、または 9:00 ～ 21:00、21:00 ～ 9:00 です）
- 補助機器を使用して18 kg程度の機器を安全に持ち上げて移動できること

Preferred qualifications

- データセンターに関連する資格（CDCP、CDCS、CDCE、ASHRAE など）、またはデータセンター管理のための資格（第二種または第三種電気主任技術者、エネルギー管理士、第 4 類危険物取扱者、冷凍機械責任者、第二種電気工事士）

- 機械システムに関する高度な理解力（CRAC/CRAH、AHU、チラー、冷却塔、貯蔵タンク、熱交換器、配管システム、ポンプ、バルブ、ダクトシステム、ファン、ダンパー、火災検知・消火システム、排水システム、ビル監視システム、自動制御システム）

title: Senior Export Compliance Manager, AWS Global Trade and Product Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Do you see compliance as a business enabler? Do you have a passion for emerging technologies and complex problem solving? Do you enjoy building innovative compliance solutions? Are you passionate about creating the future of export compliance?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) continues to expand its global presence and customer facing services and we are looking for a highly motivated Export Compliance Manager to drive export controls implementations.

The successful candidate is an innovative compliance professional experienced in integrating compliance requirements within the business, building export control compliance programs, have strong written and verbal communication skills, and have the persistence to solve complex compliance problems. The role will drive and scale ITAR, EAR, and nuclear export compliance controls through innovative process development, working with cross-functional teams, and a broad range of stakeholders including development teams and senior leadership. The candidate will have strong program/project management skills, must have a passion for new challenges, be creative, self-directed, and a team player. In this role, you will drive continuous process improvement, and collaborate effectively to solve problems and develop requirements for new compliance solutions.

You will need to be the kind of leader who can build, communicate clearly, and have a consistent track record of delivery. You will need manage multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment, and create simple solutions to meet your program goals.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and implement compliance processes and solutions to comply with U.S. (ITAR, EAR, nuclear) and global export regulations.
- Provide strategic guidance on U.S. and global export regulations and advise internal business teams on compliance program requirements.
- Assess applicability of export requirements (ITAR, EAR, nuclear, global) in the cloud.
- Monitor regulatory changes, perform impact assessment, and providing compliance recommendations
- Create metrics for management reporting
- Drive process improvement and compliance implementation projects
- Own leadership communications to stakeholder teams and executive leadership
- Innovate control mechanisms to best meet business goals and compliance requirements

A day in the life
You will act as a compliance leader who simplifies complex problems, communicates clearly, and have a consistent track record of delivery. You can handle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. You will be able to help create simple solutions to meet your program goals. You can make strategic decisions to quickly handle emerging issues while working towards long term solutions.

The candidate must possess strong analytical skills and be comfortable working autonomously in a highly demanding and often ambiguous environment. The position requires an individual with strong attention to detail, exceptional organizational skills, and effective prioritization.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. title: Content Security Engineer, GME Content Security
descriptionHtml:
The Content Security team protects pre-release content across Amazon Global Media and Entertainment. This Content Security Engineer role combines hands-on production security advisory with technical execution: securing content creation workflows, researching and developing next-generation protection measures, and maintaining the cloud infrastructure and tooling that power our security mechanisms. You will work directly with studio and production teams across the content creation lifecycle (pre-production, production, post-production, and delivery) while also driving forward-looking initiatives to address emerging threats, including those introduced by generative AI. You will also review the tools and services internal teams build to handle pre-release content, making sure content security measures are built in from the start. This requires a deep understanding of each tool's use cases and workflow context so that controls are right-sized to the actual risk. You will use AI and automation to scale and mechanize content security operations.

Key job responsibilities
Serve as the primary content security advisor to film and series production teams, providing tailored guidance on secure workflow design: editorial environment setup, Aspera file transfer configurations, cloud storage architecture, on-set networking, and remote collaboration tools
Assess internal and external content processing architectures (large enterprise to boutique post houses) to securely deploy and maintain content networks and equipment
Manage security assessments of 3rd party services and tools supporting Amazon Studios, including intake of production team requests and end-to-end vendor security coordination
Research, evaluate, and pilot next-generation content security measures such as forensic watermarking, audio/video fingerprinting, and content tracking technologies
Contribute to the team's strategy for securing pre-release content against generative AI threats, including AI-driven extraction, reconstruction, deepfake misuse, and model training on unreleased assets; translate emerging risks into actionable controls and standards
Maintain and enhance AWS infrastructure and applications supporting Content Security operations, and build internal security tooling to automate workflows such as access governance, audit reporting, and compliance monitoring
Write and maintain lightweight automation (Python/scripting) to support security tooling, audit workflows, and operational reporting
Develop and iterate security standard operating procedures tailored to each studio and production team
Mentor junior team members and contribute to the team's hiring process
Provide regular written updates on program status, risk posture, and incident findings

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of programming in Python, Ruby, Go, Swift, Java, .Net, C++ or similar object oriented language experience
- 2+ years of scripting, programming, and security code review in a common programming language (non-internship) experience
- 2+ years of troubleshooting systems issues, analyzing logs, or automating basic tasks using command line tools (non-internship) experience
- Knowledge of networking protocols such as HTTP, DNS and TCP/IP
- Experience in scripting, programming, and security code reviewing in a common programming language (non-internship)
- Experience in troubleshooting systems issues, analyzing logs, or automating basic tasks using command line tools (non-internship experience)

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of any combination of the following: threat modeling experience, secure coding, identity management and authentication, software development, cryptography, system administration and network security experience
- 2+ years of scripting, programming, or security code review in a common language, such as Python, Java or C++ experience
- Knowledge of command line tools to troubleshoot protocols, analyze log outputs, or automate basic tasks
- Experience with AWS products and services
- Experience performing security activities across one or more phases of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), such as security design review, threat modeling, secure code review, and security testing
