title: Principal Tech Ops Engineer, AWS Rack Manufacturing
locations: Salt Lake City, UT, United States
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are seeking a Principal Tech Operations Engineer to lead and scale regional manufacturing operations across a complex, multi vendor hardware production ecosystem. This role owns the end to end orchestration of external manufacturing partners, driving supplier onboarding, site enablement, technical roadmap development, and sustained performance management across Supply Chain, Quality, Technical Operations, and Procurement functions. You will shape operational planning inputs that determine how the region builds and delivers enterprise hardware at scale.

You will serve as the single threaded owner for manufacturing operations outcomes, aligning diverse stakeholders, setting strategic direction, and delivering results that meet business scaling targets. You will build consensus and drive decisions at velocity across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Hardware Engineering, Risk Management, Public Policy, Finance, and Customer facing organizations while maintaining full accountability for production performance and customer delivery.

This is a senior role which requires 10+ years of technical program management experience. The role demands deep, tenured expertise in high mix, high complexity hardware manufacturing. You will have personally led organizations through product transitions, capacity ramps, supplier onboarding cycles, and operational transformations. You thrive in dynamic environments where shifting product mix, evolving customer demand, and technology transitions require rapid, high judgment decision making that balances quality, cost, throughput, and delivery reliability.

You will own complex integration programs from conception through design, validation, implementation, and scaling across manufacturing sites. The scope includes orchestrating a multi vendor ecosystem of manufacturing partners, managing the largest and most complex supplier engagements in the region, and delivering next generation technology programs. This includes enabling the region's first liquid cooled rack production, supporting the industry transition from air cooled to liquid cooled infrastructure. In 2027, the role expands to lead the site setup, vendor selection, and operational ramp of a purpose built Manufacturing Center of Excellence, a greenfield facility that will double regional manufacturing capacity and set operational standards for global replication.

You will bring strong technical depth across server, storage, and network hardware architectures combined with expertise in program management, supply chain operations, capacity modeling, new product introduction, and manufacturing engineering. You will drive systemic root cause resolution using structured methodologies (5 Whys, 8D, Six Sigma) and own all site capacity planning across the region. You will maintain accountability for critical financial levers including direct and indirect labor optimization, cost per unit, and overall cost competitiveness.

You will champion the highest standards of safety, security, and operational excellence across every engagement. You will communicate with clarity through structured business reviews, establish the metrics that define success, and influence across engineering, supply chain, quality, and executive leadership to deliver customer commitments at a global scale.



Key job responsibilities
Strategic Planning and Transformation

1. Define and own the 3 to 5 year manufacturing operations strategy, anticipating future capacity needs, identifying critical capability gaps, and prioritizing technology investments that position the region for sustained growth
2. Lead transformational programs that fundamentally reshape manufacturing capability, including advanced automation deployment, robotics integration, and lights out manufacturing initiatives
3. Drive manufacturing agility through flexible line configurations, rapid changeover capabilities, and multi product qualification strategies that enable the network to respond to evolving customer demand and technology transitions
4. Own capital expenditure planning for manufacturing operations, developing rigorous business cases that quantify returns on equipment investments, facility expansions, and technology upgrades
5. Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks across the manufacturing network, including single points of failure, capacity constraints, systemic quality issues, and workforce availability challenges before they impact delivery
6. Develop high quality strategic documents and investment proposals that influence manufacturing priorities at the executive level, articulating trade offs, quantifying risks, and presenting clear recommendations that drive action


Final Assembly and System Integration Excellence

1. Architect and continuously evolve production line design, material flow strategies, and workstation configurations across the manufacturing network to deliver step function improvements in throughput, cycle time, and ergonomic safety
2. Define the manufacturing execution system strategy for the region, establishing real time visibility into work in progress, station level yields, and production constraints that enable data driven decision making at every level
3. Lead a culture of relentless continuous improvement through lean manufacturing principles, kaizen programs, and value stream mapping, systematically eliminating waste and unlocking operational efficiency gains that set the benchmark for global operations

Data, Metrics, and Operational Excellence

1. Architect and own the manufacturing operations performance framework, defining the metrics that matter (overall equipment effectiveness, throughput, cycle time, first pass yield, on time delivery, cost per unit) and holding the organization accountable to world class targets
2. Build executive grade dashboards and reporting systems that provide real time visibility into production health, quality trends, and delivery performance, enabling leaders to make informed decisions at speed across all sites
3. Champion Industry 4.0 adoption including IoT enabled production monitoring, predictive maintenance, and AI driven quality inspection, positioning the manufacturing network at the forefront of smart factory innovation
4. Design scalable mechanisms and intelligent automation that eliminate manual effort in production reporting, defect tracking, and capacity planning, creating operational leverage as the network grows
5. Translate complex operational data into compelling strategic narratives for executive leadership, shaping investment priorities and manufacturing direction through clear, insight driven recommendations
6. Lead digital transformation across manufacturing operations, driving manufacturing execution system modernization, automated test equipment upgrades, and smart factory capabilities that deliver measurable competitive advantage


A day in the life
As the Principal Tech Ops Engineer, no two days look the same but the mission is constant: scale enterprise hardware manufacturing globally. You spend your time defining multi year capacity strategies, onboarding new manufacturing partners, and driving technology transitions such as enabling the region's first liquid cooled rack production. You lead manufacturing readiness reviews for new product introductions, build business cases for facility expansions, and architect digital transformation programs across the supplier ecosystem. You own the operational excellence framework, establishing metrics and scalable mechanisms that replicate across sites worldwide. You partner with hardware engineering, supply chain, and executive leadership to shape investment priorities, mitigate operational risks, and deliver next generation manufacturing capabilities. You develop future leaders, influence long term vendor strategies, and drive automation and Industry 4.0 adoption that positions the manufacturing network for sustained growth at scale.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.


Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.


Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or other STEM field
- 5+ years of relevant hands-on systems engineering and administrative work in networking, storage systems, operating systems experience
- Experience with Six Sigma, lean manufacturing, or experience in material handling equipment (MHE) or automation environments
- Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis, or experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects
- Experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau), or experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results
- 5+ years of working with external suppliers experience

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or above in engineering, management, or technology, or Master's degree or above in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or Business Administration
- Experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware, or experience in computer architecture
- Experience coordinating complex products with stringent technical requirements, development cycles and schedules

descriptionHtml:

The WHS Central Programs team is on a mission to engineer risk out of Amazon's operations. We are a ~160-person global team united by a single goal: delivering the highest-impact safety improvements in the network through smart capital investment and disciplined program execution.
We operate at the intersection of Operations, Engineering, and WHS, which means our work is technically complex, organizationally demanding, and deeply meaningful. title: Loss Prevention Specialist, WWOS
descriptionHtml:
Our operations network, known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service, delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. To keep our operations network secure and assure operational continuity, we are looking for hands-on and detail-oriented professionals who want to join our team as Loss Prevention Specialists.

In this key role, you will deliver security as a service to our operational sites across the end-to-end supply chain to protect our people and prevent loss.

Key job responsibilities
• Support resilience of our business operations by contributing to emergency and crisis planning for sites within your area of responsibility
• Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (e.g., loss, associate experience, process improvement) and define appropriate mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards
• Serve as point of contact for and coordinate measures to manage risk with local management and external parties (e.g., law enforcement agencies and industry associations) on all security-related matters
• Ensure compliance of your assigned sites with Amazon global security standards

A day in the life
As a Loss Prevention Specialist, you will join a team of Security and Loss Prevention professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. You perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analysing data reports, and conducting interviews.

Your findings help to identify vulnerabilities in our processes, for which you contribute to the development of mitigating measures. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems and, jointly with subject matter experts and external suppliers, maintain their functionality.

You interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. You also act as point of contact for multiple internal and external departments (e.g., legal, HR, security service providers, local law enforcement) and subject matter expert in Security and Loss Prevention-related matters.

Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams and liaise with various stakeholders on policy and procedure across all management levels.

About the team
Sitting within the World Wide Security Operations organisation, Security and Loss Prevention supports the accomplishment of Amazon´s business targets and the strengthening of our brand by effectively protecting against relevant threats and by managing security and loss prevention risks that could:


• Put our associates and customers under jeopardy
• Disrupt the continuity of our business operations
• Inflict damage to our assets
• Have adverse impact on our brand reputation

Working in partnership with our stakeholders, we secure the Amazon supply chain end-to-end and promote security during business conversations. We do this by preventing security and loss prevention-related risks and vulnerabilities as early as possible, intervening in unfolding incidents to minimize any negative impact as well as thoroughly investigating security-related incidents to identify and remove root causes, preventing reoccurrence.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in security and loss prevention
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience with MS Office Professional Suite, including Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience with physical security best practices which includes the application of physical security systems, investigation techniques and management of contract security guards
- Experience within a distribution center, logistics, or manufacturing environment
- Experience working with data and leveraging analytics to make decisions
- Valid driver's license

descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:
What do we do here? Amazon Web Services runs one of the largest networks in the world. Our organization designed a new routing protocol built for the demands of modern workloads, and our team built the control plane that implements it — governing how traffic moves across the fabrics of the Amazon data center network, reacting to both static topology and real-time state at a scale few systems operate at.

Why now? Our control plane is expanding to cover more of AWS's network, and we're growing the team to match. We're looking for a software engineer who wants to go deep on large-scale distributed systems, hyperscale data center networks, SDN, and global software deployment.

What you'll do?
- Design and build the stateful control-plane software that applies intended network state across thousands of devices and guarantees they converge correctly and safely — including failure handling and rollback.
- Own features end-to-end: requirements, design, implementation, code review, worldwide deployment, and operations.
- Work with partner teams and customers to bring new algorithms and capabilities into production at scale.

Basic Qualifications
- 3+ years of professional software development experience
- Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Rust, C++, Java, Go)
- Experience building and operating distributed systems or backend services
- Solid grasp of CS fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, concurrency

Preferred Qualifications

title: Senior Regulatory Assurance Specialist, Security & Privacy Regulatory Enablement (SPRe)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Security & Privacy Regulatory Enablement (SPRe) team is the regulatory enablement engine for Amazon's security, privacy, and AI compliance assurance needs. We take any new regulatory requirement from initial publication to demonstrated compliance across three domains — Security, Privacy, and AI — using a repeatable, scalable operating model (Anticipate → Enable → Assure).

We are seeking an experienced, self-motivated Senior Regulatory Assurance Specialist with a strong background spanning both Information Security and Privacy compliance. This individual will deliver external audits and regulatory examinations across security and privacy domains, working across multiple jurisdictions and regulatory frameworks. The role demands someone who can operate with equal confidence in a payments audit environment as in a DMA or GDPR compliance assessment — applying domain-agnostic assurance methodology across both disciplines.

Your work directly impacts Customer Trust in Amazon by ensuring that regulated services demonstrate compliance to external regulators, auditors, and supervisory authorities across all domains.

Key job responsibilities
- Deliver external audit lifecycle activities across security and privacy domains — from planning and scoping through evidence coordination, auditor management, and report issuance

- Represent Amazon's security and privacy posture in external regulatory audits and examinations across multiple jurisdictions

- Coordinate evidence collection, collation, and presentation to external auditors and regulatory examiners across both security and privacy frameworks

- Develop and maintain Risk Control Matrices (RCMs) that map regulatory requirements to specific controls, evidence requirements, and testing procedures

- Manage audit findings, remediation tracking, and formal closure — including preparation of management responses and corrective action plans

- Drive detailed analysis of regulatory requirements in collaboration with legal teams, performing scoping and applicability assessments to determine which services, entities, and systems fall within scope

- Dive deep into the control environment across security and privacy — understanding the effectiveness of control design and operations, and identifying cross-domain synergies (e.g., overlapping controls such as access management, encryption, logging)

- Contribute to emerging regulations and technology standards, partnering with internal security, privacy, legal, and public policy teams to ensure Amazon's voice is represented in relevant forums

- Influence automation efforts for evidence collection and control testing to achieve compliance at scale

- Communicate clearly and effectively to senior stakeholders on audit status, programme health, and critical issues — escalating appropriately and driving issues to closure

- Break complex regulatory requirements into manageable programmes, ruthlessly prioritising, and delivering results across a global, multi-jurisdictional environment

About the team
SPRe operates through three interconnected gears forming a continuous flywheel: **Anticipate** (regulatory engagement and horizon scanning), **Enable** (programme design and regulatory compliance monitoring), and **Assure** (external audit delivery and regulatory examination management). This role leads the Assure function — the execution engine that demonstrates Amazon's compliance to the outside world.

Team members include security compliance specialists, privacy assurance specialists, and cross-domain flex resources operating across India, Europe, and the US.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training and Career growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Chief of Staff & Business Operations Lead, Global Network Delivery
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Chief of Staff & Business Operations Lead to join the Global Network Delivery (GND) organization. This role is the strategic partner to the GND Director and the connective tissue between GND leadership and the mechanisms that drive decisions: operating plans, goals, business reviews, workforce plans, and the broader rhythm of business.

You will shape what GND works on, not just track it. You will act as an extension of the leader: representing them in forums, deciding what needs their attention, owning the narrative in executive documents, and telling leaders what they need to hear, not what they want to hear. You will also own the business operations engine that keeps a fast-growing global organization running with high standards.

Key job responsibilities
- Serve as a thought partner on org strategy, priorities, and tradeoffs. Provide candid feedback and surface blind spots.
- Represent the leader in leadership forums and cross-org meetings; make decisions within agreed guardrails; triage what needs the leader's time, what gets delegated, and what gets handled directly.
- Write and own executive documents as required; prepare the leader for upward reviews and key meetings.
- Lead ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives that do not belong to a single team, from problem definition through delivery, without direct authority.
- Identify gaps in how the org makes decisions and design mechanisms to close them. Maintain the decision log and serve as institutional memory for commitments and rationale.
- Build relationships across the business (Finance, HR, Talent Acquisition, and peer BizOps teams) to unblock dependencies and keep the organization's mechanisms aligned.
- Own org-wide communications, all-hands, and leadership offsite strategy and agendas so messaging is consistent and tied to priorities.
- Own the organization's operating plan process and document end to end, from inputs and stakeholder alignment to the final narrative. Partner with Finance so headcount, productivity assumptions, and cost models are aligned and defensible.
- Own the annual goal-setting process. Ensure goals cascade from AIS priorities to org and team commitments, are measurable, and are written to a high bar. Track progress, flag risks early, and drive mid-year recalibration.
- Own business review mechanisms. Push content beyond status updates to the strategic questions that need leadership attention. Drive pre-reads and track actions to closure.
- Ensure insights from business reviews feed back into goals, OP planning, and metrics so mechanisms reinforce each other rather than run in isolation.
- Design and maintain the overall cadence of planning, review, and decision-making for GND, and continuously raise the bar on governance and operational excellence.
- Partner with leadership and HRBP on headcount strategy, org structure, and hiring targets. Track progress against workforce plans and recommend course corrections.
- Partner with Talent Acquisition on hiring performance; act as single-threaded owner for recruiting programs.
- Analyze employee experience signals (engagement, attrition, promotion) and drive actions that raise the bar on builder sentiment and retention. Identify leadership development opportunities.
- Own reporting, analysis, and recommendations on employee productivity and T&E spend, including any related governance.

About the team
Our team is committed to delivering programs that improve the experience for millions of customers worldwide. If you are looking for a role where your work has visible, meaningful impact across Amazon, this is the place for you.

- Experience partnering with executive-level leaders to identifying and solving business issues
- Experience influencing multiple stakeholders and leading cross functional teams across geographies and business units

- Knowledge of general AI tools

title: Program Specialist, NCC, Network Control Center, Amazon Customer Service
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Network Control Center (NCC) owns real-time observability, situational awareness, and coordinated intervention across the network to rapidly detect and eliminate issues before the customer journey is degraded.

The Real-Time Remedies Execution (RTRE) function within NCC acts as the centralized communications liaison between Amazon's Recovery teams, Business teams, and Amazon's customers. The mission is to help prevent contacts to Amazon by executing bulk actions on accounts and communications to customers impacted by large-scale issues. RTRE team is responsible for communicating to millions of D2customers each year across more than 20+ languages and owns all bulk actions such as large-scale physical and digital order refunds, cancellations, and more.

Do you want to join a team focused on critical communication and incident recovery, and play a role in the decision-making processes that restore/retain customer trust? Are you a passionate learner willing to relentlessly Deep Dive into data sets and partner with business analysts, advocates across leadership, and business teams? Do you thrive in a culture where Customer Obsession and the Bias For Action are highly valued?

As a Program Specialist, you will play a key role on the team by managing stakeholders on large-scale customer-impacting issues, owning relationships with partner teams, validating data, investigating customer issues, and driving the communications process from creation to execution. You will also contribute to NCC's broader mission of detecting and resolving incidents before customers are impacted, collaborating across multiple teams within the network. You will be detail oriented and results driven to ensure flawless communication execution as well as ensure the needs of both the customers and the business are addressed. Outside of these day-to-day duties, Program Specialists will own and have to work on process improvements.

Key job responsibilities
- Own and drive bulk recovery action for D2 customers, including data validation, stakeholder coordination, and flawless execution.
- Publish customer-facing mass communications, independently assessing situations and advocating for the most customer-centric path forward.
- Manage high-severity incidents by collaborating cross-functionally to mitigate risks to business, customer experience, and associate experience.
- Serve as the liaison between business analyst teams, product teams, and recovery stakeholders on complex issues requiring data assistance or tooling alignment.
- Execute high-impact mitigation actions using various tools while performing quality checks to ensure ideal customer outcomes.
- Plan, prioritize, and deliver team-related projects, balancing day-to-day operations with longer-term improvement initiatives.

descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 13, 2026

Do you want to help the U.S. Army and broader Department of War adopt innovative cloud computing solutions that make a real difference? As a Senior Solutions Architect within the World Wide Public Sector practice at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will work directly with U.S. Army customers and a broad ecosystem of system integrators and solution providers to design and deliver cloud architectures that address complex data, security, and mission requirements. Our team is growing to keep pace with rising demand as defense customers modernize their technology platforms — and this is your chance to be part of that momentum. You will own implementation architectures and shape strategies for projects involving large-scale data workloads and a broad range of AWS services, such as Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS), Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3), Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2), and Amazon Bedrock. You will also advise customers on how generative AI capabilities can accelerate their missions. If you are a pragmatic, curious builder who thrives on variety and excels at briefing customers, we want to hear from you. This position requires willingness to travel within the U.S. and overseas up to 35%.

The candidate selected must be a U.S. citizen and able to either hold, or obtain and hold, a Top Secret security clearance.

Key job responsibilities
- Design end-to-end cloud architectures for Army customers, evaluating trade-offs across security, reliability, performance, cost, and operational readiness to meet mission-critical requirements.
- Serve as a trusted technical advisor to senior government stakeholders, building relationships, and guiding their long-term technology strategy while ensuring near-term decisions support broader business outcomes.
- Own technical engagements from initial scoping through implementation, defining solution architectures for large-scale data workloads and working with system integrators and solution providers to deliver results.

After lunch, you could brief a senior government leader on a proof of concept showing how Amazon Bedrock addresses an emerging GenAI requirement. Later, you work with your sales and business development counterparts to prepare an RFP response or build out a reference architecture or Proof of Concept (POC) that other Solutions Architects on the team can reuse.

Our team is a group of 16 Solutions Architects within the AWS World Wide Public Sector practice, dedicated to supporting the U.S. Army and the broader Department of War. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Customer Terminal Aviation Quality
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon LEO will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

We're seeking an exceptional Software Quality Engineering Manager who will drive innovation and excellence in aviation terminal software development. In this pivotal role, you'll be the strategic architect of software quality management, solving complex technical challenges and ensuring software development rigor that meets the highest aviation standards, including compliance with AS9115 (Quality Management Systems – Requirements for Aviation, Space and Defense Organizations – Deliverable Software). You will be directly responsible for establishing and maintaining the software quality assurance framework governing the design, development, verification, and deployment of deliverable software for the aircraft unit, phased array based antenna system that closes the link to carry aircraft data to and from a LEO satellite. This includes overseeing software development lifecycle processes, configuration management, formal verification and validation (V&V), and ensuring traceability from requirements through testing in accordance with AS9115 and its parent standard AS9100.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
• Establish and maintain a software quality management system (QMS) compliant with AS9115 and D0-178 for aviation terminal deliverable software development, ensuring adherence to AS9100 parent standard requirements
• Lead software quality risk assessment with software engineering teams across the full development lifecycle, including requirements management, and design reviews
• Develop and implement software quality control methodologies, including static/dynamic analysis, and defect trend analysis to ensure software integrity and airworthiness
• Drive continuous improvement through software process measurement, root cause investigations, and corrective action implementations
• Manage software configuration management, change control, and baseline software configuration
• Support FAA/EASA certification activities, including management of software documentation packages required for Supplemental Type Certificate (STC) compliance
• Oversee supplier software quality assessments and ensure flow-down of AS9115 QMS requirements to subcontracted software development partners
• Lead internal audits, peer reviews, and milestone readiness assessments to ensure software release quality and continued airworthiness compliance

A day in the life
Your day will blend software quality oversight, cross-functional collaboration, and strategic process improvement. You'll work across software development, systems engineering, and certification teams, translating airworthiness requirements into robust processes governed by AS9115. Expect to review verification artifacts, manage configuration baselines, drive corrective actions, and ensure deliverable software meets aviation regulatory standards. You'll transform compliance challenges into opportunities for continuous improvement.

About the team
Our Leo Customer Terminal Engineering team is committed to pushing the boundaries of aviation manufacturing excellence. We're a collaborative group of innovative engineers and technical program manager professionals dedicated to delivering exceptional technical solutions. By joining us, you'll contribute to advanced projects that directly impact aviation infrastructure and technological advancement. We value transparent communication, empathetic collaboration, and the ability to balance complex trade-offs between quality, cost, and schedule.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. Amazon Web Services is hiring a Product Design Electrical Engineer for our Electrical Products and Services (EPS) team. EPS is a global engineering team within AWS Data Center Engineering, responsible for the design, development, and continuous improvement of electrical power distribution products used across our rapidly expanding data center footprint. Our product portfolio spans the full electrical distribution chain, including medium voltage switchgear, medium voltage transformers, low voltage switchgear, generators, busduct, transfer switches, power distribution cabinets, and other critical electrical infrastructure.

The EPS team works to design and develop resilient, cost-effective electrical distribution products and systems. As an engineer at Amazon, they are responsible for achieving world class uptime for our customers. They drive continuous advancements and improvements with our designs and communicate technical direction to senior leadership. They seek new ways to improve the reliability, scalability, and cost effectiveness of our engineering designs. As an engineer at Amazon, they have the opportunity to design, innovate, and improve the products our customers rely on.

Amazon offers a work environment where speed and quality matter. We continue to grow and are looking for individuals that can support our speed to market, enjoy a challenge, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning. Amazon's work environment is unique in every aspect and offers a great opportunity for the right candidate.

If you have led or worked with high performing teams of engineers and enjoy working on complex problems, we want to hear from you. At Amazon, the successful candidate will be responsible for working on product designs and supporting our wide variety of customers. Great ideas are encouraged and supported. Ingenuity is the main mechanism which supports our focus on quality, speed, and cost.

At Amazon, teamwork is necessary for us to accomplish our goals. The successful candidate must be able to work within a team and depend on others to accomplish the required work. As a product engineer at Amazon, they will work with other internal groups as well as external groups including engineering service providers, manufacturers, vendors, inspectors, third party testing labs, and contractors.

Amazon has a global presence. Travel will be necessary but should not be more than 30%. International support will be part of the job, and some international travel may be necessary. Their contribution could consist of leading international projects and could require developing engineering information packages. An understanding of international electrical product design requirements is helpful but not necessary.

Key job responsibilities
- Work with internal partner teams to solicit customer input and define design requirements for product design.
- Lead new product design, development and qualification of critical electrical power distribution equipment for AWS data centers, including medium voltage switchgear, medium voltage transformers, low voltage switchgear, generators, busduct, transfer switches, power distribution cabinets, and other electrical infrastructure.
- Develop Capex and Opex spending budgets taking into account development costs with vendors, prototyping needs, testing and specialized tooling requirements.
- Work with global suppliers and manufacturers to specify appropriate electrical equipment and components, ensuring tier 2-3 supply chain resiliency.
- Ensure compliance with UL, CSA, IEC and federal, state and municipal requirements and building codes across different countries through appropriate levels of testing.
- Validate design through prototype, pre-production and first-of-kind builds, conducting DFx and value engineering analysis through each step and updating design and documentation.

title: Elektromekanisk Tekniker, DCEO
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services ansvarar för design, planering, leverans och drift av AWS globala infrastruktur. Vi ser till att molnet fungerar – dygnet runt, världen över.
Vi ansvarar för infrastrukturen i AWS datacenter, inklusive servrar, lagringslösningar, nätverksutrustning samt kraft- och kylsystem. Det är denna infrastruktur som säkerställer att våra kunder har tillförlitlig och kontinuerlig tillgång till de molntjänster och den innovation de förlitar sig på.
Vi tar oss an komplexa utmaningar där tusentals faktorer påverkar allt från leveranskedjor till den dagliga driften. Nu söker vi engagerade och kompetenta medarbetare som vill vara med och utveckla, driva och säkra den infrastruktur som får AWS att fungera.
Du kommer att ingå i ett mångsidigt team av mjukvaru-, hårdvaru- och nätverksingenjörer, specialister inom leveranskedjan, säkerhetsexperter, driftchefer och andra viktiga roller. Du kommer att samarbeta med personer inom hela AWS för att hjälpa oss leverera de högsta standarderna för säkerhet och trygghet, samtidigt som vi tillhandahåller till synes oändlig kapacitet till lägsta möjliga kostnad för våra kunder. Du kommer att uppleva en inkluderande kultur som välkomnar djärva idéer och ger dig möjlighet att driva dem till slutförande.
Du blir en del av ett mångsidigt team med mjukvaru-, hårdvaru- och nätverksingenjörer, specialister inom leveranskedjan, säkerhetsexperter, driftchefer och andra nyckelkompetenser. Tillsammans med kollegor inom hela AWS bidrar du till att upprätthålla högsta standard inom säkerhet och driftsäkerhet, samtidigt som vi levererar skalbar kapacitet till våra kunder på ett så kostnadseffektivt sätt som möjligt.
Hos oss möter du en inkluderande kultur där nya idéer uppmuntras och du får möjlighet att omsätta dem i praktiken.
Vi söker nu en tekniker inom datacenterdrift (Data Center Engineering Operations Technician) som vill bidra till en säker, stabil och effektiv drift av våra verksamhetskritiska datacenter.
I rollen är du en viktig teknisk resurs med ansvar för att upprätthålla anläggningarnas tillgänglighet och driftsäkerhet, med målet att uppfylla eller överträffa fastställda SLA servicenivåer.
I takt med att AWS växer och vår datacenterverksamhet expanderar snabbt i Sverige söker vi fler kompetenta medarbetare som vill vara med och driva och underhålla våra anläggningar.
Du får en viktig roll i det dagliga arbetet med att säkerställa att anläggningarnas tekniska system fungerar tillförlitligt, samtidigt som du bidrar till kontinuerliga förbättringar och ökad effektivitet. Ditt arbete hjälper oss att leverera hög kvalitet och långsiktigt värde till AWS kunder.
En dag i rollen
I rollen övervakar du larm och system för datacentrets kraftförsörjning, kylning och brandskydd för att säkerställa en säker och stabil drift. Du planerar och samordnar leverantörsarbeten på plats och ser till att utrustningen underhålls enligt plan samt att drifttillgängligheten upprätthålls.
Du stöttar även andra anläggningar och team vid incidenter och planerade underhållsarbeten. Arbetet omfattar installation av rack, uppgifter kopplade till strömförsörjning samt uppföljning och samordning vid driftsättning av ny utrustning. Du bidrar också till teamets kompetensutveckling genom att dela med dig av kunskap, stötta nyanställda och hjälpa kollegor att utvecklas i sina roller.
Vid driftstörningar deltar du i incidenthanteringen och medverkar i beredskapsövningar för att stärka teamets förmåga att agera snabbt och effektivt när det behövs.


Key job responsibilities
Du kommer även att vara involverad i:

- Assistera vid drift och underhåll av all elektrisk, mekanisk, brand-/livssäkerhetsutrustning och HVAC-utrustning inom datacentret/anläggningen. Denna utrustning stödjer verksamhetskritiska servrar och måste upprätthålla en drifttid på över 99,999 %.
- Assistera vid underhåll och övervakning av alla datacentersystem, inklusive incidenter/händelser, problem, ändringar, övervakning, problemeskalering/avisering/lösning och alla andra aspekter av datacentersupport.
- Övervaka och felsöka alla mekaniska, elektriska och HVAC-system, röst-/datakommunikation, kylsystem, brand-/livssäkerhetsutrustning och generatorer.
- Ge stöd till entreprenörer eller datacenteringenjörer för att säkerställa korrekt drift och underhåll av all anläggningsutrustning.
- Ge stöd till entreprenörer eller datacenteringenjörer vid installation av ny utrustning, såsom att bygga rack, dra kablar och andra uppgifter vid behov.
- Utföra rundvandringar på anläggningen för att verifiera korrekt funktion av anläggningsutrustning och övervakningssystem.
Utöver att agera som anläggningens första insatsperson vid kritiska händelser, kommer du att vara en del av teamet som stödjer både nya och befintliga datacenteranläggningar!

A day in the life
Dagliga aktiviteter för denna roll inkluderar:
- Övervakning av alla larm och system som är involverade i driften av kraft-, kyl- och brandbekämpningssystem i datacentret.
- Planering och samordning av leverantörsarbeten på plats för att säkerställa att utrustningen underhålls och drifttiden upprätthålls.
- Stöd till andra anläggningar och team vid händelser och planerade arbeten.
- Utförande av rackinstallation och strömförsörjningsuppgifter.
- Övervakning och underlättande av överlämning av ny utrustning.
- Stöd till nyanställda och teammedlemmar genom kunskapsdelning och utveckling.
- Händelserespons och deltagande i övningar

About the team
Olika erfarenheter är en styrka
På AWS värdesätter vi olika erfarenheter, perspektiv och kompetenser. Även om du inte uppfyller alla kvalifikationer som anges i annonsen uppmuntrar vi dig att söka tjänsten. Oavsett om du är i början av din karriär, har en annan yrkesbakgrund än den traditionella eller har skaffat dig erfarenhet på alternativa vägar vill vi att du ska känna dig välkommen att söka.
Varför AWS? - Amazon Web Services (AWS) är världens mest omfattande och mest använda molnplattform. Vi var pionjärer inom molnteknik och fortsätter att utveckla nya lösningar som driver den digitala utvecklingen framåt. Från snabbväxande startups till några av världens största företag förlitar sig våra kunder på AWS breda utbud av produkter och tjänster för att utveckla och driva sina verksamheter.
En inkluderande arbetskultur - På AWS präglas vår kultur av nyfikenhet, lärande och en vilja att ständigt utvecklas. Våra medarbetarledda nätverk och intressegrupper bidrar till en inkluderande arbetsmiljö där olika perspektiv och erfarenheter värdesätts. Genom evenemang, kunskapsutbyte och initiativ som Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) och AmazeCon arbetar vi för att främja mångfald, delaktighet och en stark känsla av gemenskap.
Mentorskap och karriärutveckling - Vi strävar efter att vara en av världens bästa arbetsgivare och erbjuder goda möjligheter att utvecklas både professionellt och personligt. Genom kunskapsdelning, mentorskap, utbildningar och andra utvecklingsmöjligheter får du stöd att bygga nya kompetenser, bredda din erfarenhet och ta nästa steg i karriären.
Balans mellan arbete och privatliv - Vi värdesätter en hållbar balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Att lyckas i arbetet ska inte behöva ske på bekostnad av privatlivet. Därför strävar vi efter en arbetskultur som präglas av flexibilitet, stöd och respekt för individens olika behov. När våra medarbetare får förutsättningar att må bra och utvecklas, både på och utanför arbetet, skapar vi tillsammans bättre resultat.
Arbetsuppgifter och ansvarsområden
I rollen medverkar du i drift och underhåll av datacentrets elektriska och mekaniska system, HVAC-system (värme, ventilation och luftkonditionering) samt brand- och personsäkerhetssystem. Dessa system försörjer och skyddar verksamhetskritiska servrar, där kraven på tillgänglighet och driftsäkerhet är extremt höga, med en målsättning på över 99,999 procents drifttillgänglighet.
Du arbetar med övervakning och underhåll av datacentrets tekniska system och bidrar till hanteringen av incidenter, problem och förändringar. Arbetet omfattar även felsökning, eskalering och uppföljning av driftstörningar samt samordning av åtgärder för att säkerställa en stabil och tillförlitlig drift.
Du övervakar och felsöker mekaniska och elektriska system, HVAC- och kylsystem, kommunikationsinfrastruktur, brand- och personsäkerhetssystem samt reservkraftsanläggningar, inklusive generatorer. Du samarbetar med entreprenörer och datacenteringenjörer för att säkerställa att anläggningens utrustning fungerar korrekt och underhålls enligt gällande rutiner och krav.
Du medverkar också vid installation av ny utrustning, exempelvis rackinstallation, kabeldragning och andra installationsarbeten. Genom regelbundna inspektionsrundor kontrollerar du att anläggningens tekniska utrustning och övervakningssystem fungerar som de ska.
Vid kritiska händelser är du först på plats och bidrar till att snabbt bedöma situationen, påbörja nödvändiga åtgärder och begränsa påverkan på verksamheten. Du blir en viktig del av teamet som ansvarar för att driva, underhålla och vidareutveckla både nya och befintliga datacenteranläggningar.

Basic qualifications

- Starka muntliga och skriftliga kommunikationsfärdigheter i engelska.
- Utbildning inom el, mekanik eller instrumentering och/eller relevant erfarenhet.
- 2+ års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet.

Preferred qualifications

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Transform
descriptionHtml:
With roughly seven out of eight enterprise workloads still running on-premises or on mainframe, the opportunity to help the world's largest organizations move to the cloud is enormous. AWS Transform is building a platform that combines AI-driven automation with deep infrastructure and software engineering to analyze, plan, and execute large-scale application migrations. As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you will work across the full stack, from designing the distributed systems and services that power migration workflows to building the intelligent agents that reason about complex legacy environments.

You will own the design and delivery of features and components, from understanding customer needs through implementation, testing, and production operations. You will work with senior engineers on system design, write high-quality, well-tested code, and help operate the services you build. Your work will directly shape how enterprises move their most critical workloads to AWS. You will collaborate closely with senior engineers, product managers, and customer-facing teams to make sure what you build turns into real customer outcomes. If you are excited about solving hard, high-impact problems with strong engineering fundamentals and applied AI skills, we would love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
Design, build, and operate distributed services and AI-powered agents that analyze legacy codebases, plan migration strategies, and execute transformations end to end.
Drive the end-to-end design of the features you own, making trade-offs across scalability, performance, and security, and communicate across teams to influence architectural decisions on shared interfaces and infrastructure.
Write well-documented, production-quality code that sets an example for others, and make sure solutions are testable and easy for others to extend.
Play a key technical role on the team in aligning engineering work with customer needs, turning requirements into product features and delivering them incrementally.
Mentor teammates through design and code reviews, foster engineering best practices, and take part in interviewing and recruiting.

A day in the life
Your morning might start with a design review where you present your approach for a new service component that automates a migration step previously done by hand. After working through the details with a senior engineer, you shift to writing and reviewing code, working on infrastructure plumbing one hour and refining an agent's decision logic the next. In the afternoon you meet with your product manager and a customer-facing teammate to go over feedback from an enterprise customer pilot and turn it into improvements for your feature. descriptionHtml:

This role will work alongside a team of Construction Category Managers and partner closely with Pre-Construction, Design & Construction, Real Estate, and World Wide Design to develop and execute category sourcing strategies, maximize managed spend, deliver measurable net cost savings, and drive competition into historically under-competed markets.

You will collaborate cross-business with AWS to leverage Amazon's combined construction scale and avoid market fragmentation.

 This is a high-growth, fast-moving team undergoing significant global expansion. The right candidate is a self-starter with dedication to seeing projects through to the end, able to work independently in a collaborative, creative, and ambiguous environment. You bring an eye for detail, determination to standardize processes, and the ability to deliver high-quality work. This position involves direct engagement with internal and external stakeholders at every level - from project teams to senior leadership - and requires the credibility to inform decision-making and earn trust across the business.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end commercial delivery of multi-million-dollar GC construction projects; sourcing, competitive bid, award, contract execution, and handover.
- Develop and execute sourcing strategies that drive competition, maximize managed spend, and deliver measurable net cost savings.
- Partner cross-functionally with Real Estate, Design & Construction, and Engineering Services to align vendor capacity with program milestones including Prime week and Peak readiness.
- Run the full supplier lifecycle: performance management, should-cost analysis, concentration risk monitoring, and sustainability delivery aligned with Amazon's Climate Pledge.
- Earn trust with senior stakeholders by providing data-driven market intelligence; GC capacity, regional pricing trends, and strategic opportunities — to inform roadmap decisions.

A day in the life
You negotiate with GCs and subcontractors in the morning, build a should-cost model over lunch, and present a sourcing recommendation to leadership by end of day, no two days look the same.

title: Principal Applied Scientist, Fauna
descriptionHtml:
Fauna Robotics is building capable, safe, and delightful robots for everyday life, and understanding where it is, and what's around it, is fundamental to everything a robot does. A robot that lives alongside people must build and maintain a map of its environment, plan paths through cluttered and changing spaces, and do so reliably whether it's navigating a hallway for the hundredth time or entering a room it has never seen. We are hiring a Principal Applied Scientist to serve as a technical authority on how our robots understand and move through the world.

You will design, prototype, and ship the core algorithms that give the robot spatial intelligence - from real-time SLAM and scene understanding to motion planning and autonomous navigation. You will set the mapping and navigation architecture that other engineers build on, shape sensor and compute decisions across robot generations, mentor the engineers and scientists working on spatial perception, and be the person teams come to when the robot is lost.

Key job responsibilities
- Set the long-range science roadmap and technical architecture for the robot's mapping, localization, and navigation stack, and serve as Fauna's primary technical authority on spatial intelligence
- Design and implement real-time visual-inertial and/or lidar-based SLAM systems that build, update, and maintain persistent maps of home and indoor environments
- Develop robust localization algorithms that allow the robot to determine its precise pose in previously mapped spaces, handling environmental changes such as moved furniture, lighting variation, and dynamic occupants
- Build navigation and motion planning systems that produce safe, efficient, and natural-looking trajectories through cluttered, dynamic human spaces
- Architect semantic mapping capabilities that go beyond geometry — enabling the robot to understand rooms, objects, surfaces, and traversable space at a level that supports higher-level task planning
- Drive sensor selection and placement decisions for depth cameras, lidar, IMUs, and encoders in collaboration with mechanical, electrical, and industrial design teams, backed by your own benchmarking and analysis
- Design the robot-specific data collection, benchmarking, and evaluation methods to validate mapping accuracy, localization robustness, and navigation safety across diverse real-world environments
- Develop strategies for graceful degradation and recovery — ensuring the robot behaves safely when localization is uncertain, maps are incomplete, or sensors are occluded
- Present mapping and navigation science and its tradeoffs to senior leadership and partner teams
- Mentor scientists and engineers, raising the scientific bar for spatial perception across the organization through design reviews, code reviews, and hiring

About the team
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.

We believe that future won't arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We're changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.

Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We're building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.

At Fauna, you'll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, navigate, and interact with people in natural environments. It's an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.

If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we're interested in hearing from you.

Basic qualifications

- Experience influencing multiple stakeholders and leading cross functional teams across geographies and business units
- PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Vision, or a related field and 7+ years of relevant research experience after degree, or a Master's degree and 12+ years of equivalent experience
- Deep, hands-on expertise in simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), including visual, lidar, or visual-inertial approaches
- Track record of designing and shipping mapping or navigation systems on a physical robot or autonomous platform operating in real-world environments
- Experience with motion planning and path planning algorithms for mobile robots in dynamic, unstructured spaces
- Strong publication record or demonstrated technical impact in SLAM, spatial perception, or autonomous navigation

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building persistent, updatable maps for long-lived robots operating in changing environments
- Experience with semantic mapping or scene understanding that integrates geometric and semantic representations
- Experience with sensor fusion combining depth cameras, lidar, IMUs, wheel odometry, or other proprioceptive sensors for robust state estimation
- Experience optimizing SLAM or navigation algorithms for real-time execution on embedded or edge compute platforms
- Experience with learned approaches to navigation, mapping, or place recognition (e.g., neural SLAM, learned visual odometry, foundation models for spatial reasoning)
- Experience with multi-floor or large-scale indoor mapping and localization
- Experience mentoring scientists and engineers
- Publications and/or patents in SLAM, autonomous navigation, or spatial perception

title: Area Manager
descriptionHtml:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. As an Area Manager, you’ll make sure your site is running as smoothly as it should so that we can meet customer demand. You will be leading a team that helps keep our operations safe, efficient, and of a high quality and taking on a number of projects across our network to drive productivity.

Key job responsibilities
Create, oversee, and drive a culture of safety and wellbeing
Analyse and implement changes to keep quality and productivity at a consistently high level
Oversee projects to streamline processes, optimise productivity and increase quality of service for customers within your area of responsibility
Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
Work collaboratively with management-level colleagues to standardise shift practices

A day in the life
You’ll work on a shift pattern at one of our sites, making sure it is as productive as it can be. Your main focus will be to own and drive a culture of safety and uphold quality and shift performance standards. You’ll also oversee process improvements within your area and drive implementation. A typical day is varied, including everything from routine team management and daily operational responsibilities to process improvement and wide-scale operational contingency tasks. You’ll also be a role model and mentor to new managers.

About the team
Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we’re always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

The CF team are the first people in the chain that helps customers get products at the speed we’re known for. We’re based in Fulfilment Centres, which are at the heart of Amazon’s fast-paced Operations network. Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile’ because it’s where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock.

Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in business, operations, logistics, supply chain or engineering
- Experience in people management
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
- Are you willing and able to work night and weekend shifts? (Amazon operations run 24/7 we have multiple shifts that cover this time period. We require that you be open to all shifts within this range to move forward in our process.)
- If you have experience managing people, what is the largest team you have managed?

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working effectively across cross-functional teams and partnering well with people at all levels within an organization

title: Software Development Manager, Amazon Robotics
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Robotics Pack team builds the software and robotic systems that pack nearly every customer order Amazon ships. Our work is on the critical path: when a pack machine or station goes down, shipments stop. We run thousands of machines, stations and robotic workcells across hundreds of fulfillment centers on several continents. Each one has to perform reliably every shift, for both the associates who work alongside it and the customers waiting on their orders.

To do that at scale, we're building physical AI that runs at the edge: software that sees, reasons and acts on the machine itself, in real time. Computer vision and machine learning on edge compute verify items, select the right box and catch defects before a package leaves the station. The same systems watch the machines themselves. They track throughput, jam rates, sensor and actuator signals, and vision-model accuracy, so we know which machines are healthy, which are degrading and why.

When something goes wrong, our systems should spot it first, diagnose it and guide the fix. That means turning machine telemetry into clear, step-by-step guidance for associates and Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) technicians, so they can restore a machine in minutes instead of hours. Every failure feeds back into our models and designs, so a fault fixed once at one site helps prevent it at every site. The hard part is doing this across a large, mixed fleet, with low latency on the floor and consistent quality everywhere.

A day in the life
1) Lead, hire and grow a team of software engineers
2) Own the roadmap for software that runs pack machines, stations and robotic workcells
3) Integrate computer vision, sensors and robotics into reliable real-time systems
4) Turn every failure into fleet-wide improvements to models, designs and runbooks
5) Solve optimization problems in packaging selection, workload balancing and throughput
6) Drive operational excellence: safe deployments, fast mitigation, root-cause COEs
7) Launch new robotics and automation into live fulfillment sites
8) Work backwards from associates, RME, site leaders and end customers
Influence partner teams across hardware, science, operations and product

About the team
Our team knows fulfillment end to end. We understand how an order moves through Amazon's network around the world, from inbound to the moment a package leaves the building. That broad view lets us make good decisions quickly and see how a change at one pack station affects the rest of the network.

We have a strong bias for action, backed by mechanisms that keep us focused on delivering. We don't let obstacles stop us. When we hit a blocker, we treat it as something to learn from, work through it and keep moving. That's the attitude we bring every day: we get results, whatever the challenge.

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of engineering experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- 1+ years of providing technical leadership and project management for all aspects of the software development lifecycle experience
- 1+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using Java, C#, or C++ experience
- 1+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using service-oriented architecture experience
- 1+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using distributed programming experience
- 5+ years of Software Engineer, Software Developer, or related occupational experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Senior Financial Analyst, Rapid and Rural Logistics Finance
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to own how costs are attributed across Amazon's Sub-Same-Day (SSD) network, with an initial focus on perishables programs. As these programs scale rapidly on shared fulfillment infrastructure, you will build the dedicated cost attribution frameworks that give each program its own accurate, ASIN-level economics — replacing blended assumptions with automated, auditable logic embedded directly in Amazon's allocation engines.

This is not a traditional FP&A. You will translate business and financial intent into system-level requirements, working directly with allocation model owners and engineering teams to close methodology gaps and validate that outputs reflect economic reality. You'll need deep cost accounting intuition combined with the ability to navigate ambiguity in a matrixed organization where no established playbook exists.

What Makes This Role Exciting
- You'll define how every cost line in the P&L is measured for programs standing up dedicated financial infrastructure for the first time
- You'll work at the intersection of finance and engineering, translating allocation methodology into technical requirements that change how Amazon's systems process costs
- You'll enable entirely new capabilities — system native speed-tier cost differentiation, ASIN-level unit economics, and the precise cost foundation that drives confident investment and expansion decisions



Key job responsibilities
• Design the financial logic and rules that determine how costs should be attributed to programs — including decisions like whether storage costs should follow cube footprint or throughput intensity, how commingled delivery routes should split across programs, and how temperature-zone cost differentials should be reflected
• Translate financial methodology into system-level technical requirements that engineering and model-owner teams can implement — serving as the bridge between “how finance needs it to work” and “how the system is built to do it”
• Own the accuracy of upstream financial data that feeds every downstream system — including product hierarchy classification, GL-to-program mappings, cost center assignments — establishing monitoring and governance mechanisms so data quality doesn't silently degrade as programs scale
• Validate automated cost outputs against legacy processes and known benchmarks during transition, and establish ongoing accuracy monitoring to ensure cost attribution remains correct as volume mixes shift and fulfillment models evolve
• Lead cross-functional working sessions with model owners, Controllership, Transportation Finance, Accounting, and Engineering teams
• Develop repeatable frameworks and documentation that can be leveraged across different organizations


About the team
The Finance Foundation & Enablement (F2E) team is a program-building team within the Rapid and Rural Logistics Finance organization.

We build and evolve the financial systems foundation that enables these programs to measure, understand, and optimize their economics — from automated cost allocation at the ASIN level to enabling the reporting dimensions, analytical tools, and planning capabilities the organization needs to make faster, more reliable decisions.

Our vision is to be the blueprint for how any new Amazon program — regardless of geography or fulfillment model — stands up its financial infrastructure from day one. We design solutions that are scalable worldwide; our frameworks, methodologies, and playbooks make financial system integration a solved problem.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field
- 3+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- MBA, or CPA
- Knowledge of of financial reporting tools (Cognos, Redshift)
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
