title: Sr. Comms & Leadership Development Business Partner, Amazon Customer Service
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Customer Service (CS) is seeking a Communications & Leadership Development Business Partner to join our Strategic Enablement team. In this role, you'll serve as a trusted advisor to senior CS leaders, providing integrated support that combines strategic communications expertise with leadership development capabilities to drive organizational effectiveness and leader capability building.

As a Strategic Enablement Business Partner, you'll work at the intersection of communications and leadership development, partnering with dedicated senior leader stakeholders across our global Customer Service organization. You'll design and deliver strategic communications that connect employees to our mission, while simultaneously building leadership capabilities through coaching, facilitation, and tailored development programs. This dual-discipline approach allows you to see the full picture of organizational health and create holistic solutions that drive both engagement and capability.

Your work will directly impact how CS leaders communicate with their teams, develop their leadership skills, and navigate complex organizational challenges. You'll facilitate leadership offsites, craft strategic messaging for organizational changes, and design bespoke learning solutions—all while serving as a credible challenger who pushes leaders' thinking and surfaces opportunities they might not see on their own.

The most exciting aspect of this role is the breadth of impact. You'll work across multiple CS organizations, supporting leaders who oversee thousands of employees globally. Your integrated approach means you'll help leaders not just communicate change, but build the capabilities needed to lead through it. You'll be the single face of Strategic Enablement for your stakeholders, connecting them to our full suite of capabilities while directly executing high-impact work.

This role requires someone who can operate with significant autonomy in ambiguous situations, build trusted relationships with senior leaders, and seamlessly blend communications and leadership development expertise to deliver exceptional results.

The ideal candidate must be able to think critically, act tactically, write effectively, and display strong organizational and communication skills. They must quickly get up to speed on CS-specific tenets, goals, programs, policies, and businesses, becoming a subject matter expert on the CS business.

Key job responsibilities
- Serve as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to dedicated senior CS leaders, providing integrated communications and leadership development consultation and execution that drives ongoing organizational transformation and effectiveness
- Design and execute strategic communications including organizational announcements, change management messaging, town halls, and leadership communications that connect employees to CS vision and priorities
- Facilitate leadership offsites, team meetings, and strategic planning sessions that build alignment and drive decision-making
- Provide executive consultation to senior leaders, helping them develop their leadership capabilities and navigate complex organizational challenges
- Design and deliver bespoke leadership development solutions tailored to stakeholder needs, partnering with broader Organizational Enablement teams for program development
- Develop and maintain yearly integrated communications and leadership development support plans for assigned stakeholders, ensuring proactive and coordinated delivery across both disciplines
- Act as a credible challenger who pushes leaders' thinking, surfaces blind spots, and identifies opportunities for organizational improvement
- Connect stakeholders to the full range of communications and leadership development capabilities and subject matter experts, serving as the single point of contact for all interactions
- Conduct surveys and gather feedback to measure communication effectiveness, engagement, and leadership development impact
- Support ad hoc requests through the Strategic Enablement Shared Service model, providing consultation and execution support to CS leaders and program teams across the organization
- Collaborate with Organizational Enablement Creative & Marketing teams to develop compelling visual and video content that enhances communication effectiveness

Afternoons could involve designing a bespoke leadership development solution or coaching leaders through complex challenges. Throughout the day, you're monitoring Slack channels, responding to ad hoc requests, and proactively identifying opportunities for communications and leadership development support. You'll balance strategic planning—like refining yearly support plans—with real-time execution, such as crafting town hall talking points or posting content to org channels. You're the strategic partner helping leaders define the right plan, then bringing it to life.

About the team
The Strategic Enablement team, which sits within Organizational Enablement, provides dedicated support to our most senior stakeholders. Our mission is to ensure CS employees feel connected, informed, engaged, and valued while building the leadership capabilities needed to drive organizational excellence.

Our team operates through an integrated Business Partner (BP) model that unifies communications and leadership development expertise. We provide tailored support to CS’ senior leaders, with our Business Partners serving as the single face of Strategic Enablement for their dedicated leaders. Our BPs act as strategic advisors, credible challengers, and direct executors of high-impact work, connecting stakeholders to our full suite of capabilities including leadership development programs, strategic communications, change management, and organizational effectiveness consulting.

We're a collaborative, high-performing team that values innovation, customer obsession, and continuous learning. We believe in the power of integrated solutions, recognizing that the best outcomes happen when communications and leadership development work together seamlessly.

If you're passionate about developing leaders, crafting compelling communications, and driving organizational impact at scale, you'll thrive on our team.

※このポジションの勤務地は福岡県粕屋郡を予定しています。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をアマゾンのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、シフトアシスタントとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では他業種・職種も含めこれまでの経験、スキルを活かし、改善点を模索しながら、より便利でお客様に満足いただける高い品質のサービスを提供できるビジネスをつくる事、安全・快適・楽しい職場環境の構築を行う、将来の組織のリーダーを目指していただける事を期待しています。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実に配送されるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはアマゾンの新しいエキサイティングな配送拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商
品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！


■業務内容■
具体的にはマネージャーのサポートのもと、以下の業務に責任をもち遂行いただきます。

① 安全・品質・作業効率の向上
安全安心な作業環境の維持・向上のため、日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、標準作業手順書の作成や多岐にわたる問題解決・改善活動を行います。

② 日々のオペレーション対応
商品を入荷、在庫として管理し、注文があった商品を出荷するという一連の流れを各工程間で連携をとりながら、業務を円滑に進める事が求められます。お客様とお約束した期日までに商品を迅速かつ正確にお届けするため、時間ごとの計画に沿ってオペレーションを実施することに責任を持ちます。

③ 新規プロジェクトの導入・セール時など、オペレーション拡大時の準備
新しいサービスやシステムの導入に備え、現場での手順変更・導入方法を検討し円滑な導入に向けて準備を行います。また、新規入職者でもAmazonの標準作業に則った手順がスムーズに身につくためのトレーニング構築やマニュアルを作成します。

④ イレギュラーへの対応
作業で発生する様々な課題の原因を追求し問題解決を行います。また、再発防止策案の検討、実施を行います。
※上記業務はマネージャーやチームのサポートのもと実施していただきます
※配送ステーション内での配送を通じて、物流の仕組みやマネジメントについて学ぶことができます
※社内公募により、マネージャーへのキャリアアップや他部署への異動機会もあります
※勤務は交代制（夜勤あり）です
※1日の流れ：以下ページをご参照ください。
先輩社員インタビュー

■福利厚生■
下記ページをご確認ください。
福利厚生 | アマゾンジャパンキャリアサイト

■教育制度■
入社後、約1週間はAmazonのリーダーとして必要な会社のカルチャーや、配送拠点の基本的な業務を一通り学ぶことができる座学の機会を提供します。各部署へ配属後は、トレーナーのもと、OJTで工程知識やツールの使用方法など基礎知識を学んでいきます。トレーニング資料も完備しており、相互に進捗を確認しながら独り立ちまでしっかりとサポートしますので、未経験者も安心してスタートができる環境です。
最先端の物流システムを学ぶことはもちろん、年齢・性別・国籍問わず様々な仲間と日々の業務を通して、次のステップとなるピープルマネージメントやビジネススキルを学ぶことができます。

■キャリアパス■
シフトアシスタントからキャリアをスタートし、チームマネージャー、統括マネージャー、そして配送拠点の拠点長となった実績も多数あります。また、Amazonでは社内公募制度があり、国内外問わず他部署や異なる職種への異動にチャレンジし、社内で多様なキャリアを築くチャンスもあります。Amazonではご自身で学び成長することを推奨し、キャリア開発できるようサポートを行っています。
キャリアアップストーリー

■会社のカルチャー■
Amazonでは全員がリーダーです。個人の裁量に任される部分が多く、社員の個々の可能性を最大限に伸ばす事を重視しています。様々なバックグラウンドを持った社員が前職で培った多様な経験やスキルを活かして職位や役割に関わらず誰もがチャレンジできる環境です。
また年次有給休暇の取得を積極的に推進しており「働く」、「プライベート」も充実できる環境です。
失敗に寛容な文化：まずは試してみることにこだわります。好奇心を持って学びます。時にはリスクを取り、計画通りいかなかったとしても、よりよい成果に繋げられることが私たちの強みだと信じています。

最後に、募集しているポジションや組織、お仕事の詳細については以下のリンクよりご確認いただけます。

・配送拠点で働くリーダーのインタビュー：インタビューをご覧ください。

・職種：オペレーション

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.



Key job responsibilities
Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
Technical writing to support change management program
Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
Role may support more than one location/site.


Physical Requirements:

Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection


This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility


Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 4+ years of military experience

title: Business Affairs Executive Netherlands - EUX, Business Affairs EUX
descriptionHtml:
Come build the future of entertainment with us. Do you want to help define the next generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching? Prime Video is one of the leading global streaming services, offering customers an extensive selection of movies, TV shows, and Amazon Originals in more than 240 countries and territories.

We are currently seeking a Business Affairs Executive that will provide support across all of the scripted and unscripted content produced in the Netherlands and the wider EUX region.

Key job responsibilities
- Support complex deal structures for talent agreements, development deals, (co-)production deals and rights acquisitions
- Collaborate with Legal, Production, Finance, and Creative teams to ensure deal terms align with creative vision and business objectives
- Provide timely and practical advice to senior-level executives under time-sensitive conditions.
- Engage with external partners using clear judgment and risk analysis to support successful deal outcomes
- Support the implementation of deal plans in line with Amazon Studios' content direction
- Monitor industry trends and maintain relationships with agencies, law firms, and other industry stakeholders


A day in the life
You will assist with the commercial discussions with production companies, producers, IP incl. original scripts, book rights, format rights, ATL incl. writers, directors, on-screen talent, and other related deals.

You will interact with managers, agents, managing directors and outside attorneys and will efficiently communicate status and tradeoffs with other members of the Amazon MGM Studios and Prime Video team including Creative, Production, Marketing, Finance, Tax, Accounting, Legal and Distribution, as well as executives outside of Amazon.

You will apply a comprehensive working knowledge of international film and TV industry business models, development and production methodologies. The candidate will also demonstrate the ability to think abstractly, adapt quickly in ambiguous or unstructured environments, and effectively navigate new or unfamiliar situations and problems.

You will support a varied workload efficiently and smoothly, operate within corporate parameters, and remain cool and levelheaded in high-pressure situations. The candidate will work collaboratively with colleagues in this department and across Amazon, build strong internal client relationships, effectively advise senior-level executives under time-sensitive conditions, and generate client satisfaction through clear thinking and risk analysis.

About the team
This role is part of a growing business affairs team comprised of talented lawyers that support Amazon Studios original productions within the EUX territory, which includes Netherlands, Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Poland and Turkey.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with commercial agreements (underlying rights, work-for-hire productions, co-productions, licenses, distribution) and talent agreements (authors, writers, directors, actors, producers)
- Experience in the entertainment industry, including working with production companies, agents, broadcasters, or media law firms
- Strong understanding of legal principles, drafting, and negotiation
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English and Dutch

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing projects and working independently
- • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders

title: Senior Automation Engineer, RME
descriptionHtml:
Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role:
As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in maximizing equipment reliability and operational performance in our fulfillment centers by providing proactive controls automation and technical support. Your expertise will be essential in troubleshooting complex control systems, analyzing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You'll mentor junior engineers and lead cross-functional teams to optimize material handling equipment (MHE) systems, implement innovative projects, and develop system design improvements to enhance site throughput. You'll work with state-of-the-art technology, including conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, and SCADA devices and programs. Through your technical leadership and design optimization efforts, you'll directly contribute to ensuring our customers receive their orders with Amazon's signature speed and accuracy while building team capabilities and driving operational excellence.

What Do We Offer?
Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there’s more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Key job responsibilities
-You will apply Subject Matter Expertise (SME) on troubleshooting and dive deeps for engineering issues, supporting automation engineers to investigate the root cause and planning actions to eliminate/mitigate the downtime of critical assets
-You will collaborate with building Operations, Operations Engineering teams, FC Start-up Team, AFT Software teams, ACES team, and Safety to support MHE systems optimization and project implementation
-You will understand, maintain and troubleshoot material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers and industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems
-You will monitor MHE metrics and partner with maintenance/operations to address system performance issues and provide analysis across all operations
-You will provide escalation support to automation engineers, during and after business hours, troubleshooting locally and remotely, to ensure that all hardware or controls software within the building is repaired on time
-You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 4+ years of PLC programming or automation engineering experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- 4+ years of process or production environment related PLC-controlled automation and issue diagnosis experience
- 4+ years of robotics work cells and control systems experience
- 4+ years of Siemens, Allen-Bradley or Codesys Ladder Logic and structure programming experience
- 4+ years of electrical theory, robotics, controls components, and automated equipment experience

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent
- Master's degree, or Six Sigma Black Belt certification
- Experience leading controls in manufacturing or complex industrial environments
- Experience identifying, maintaining, troubleshooting, and modifying Motor Controls including motor starters, Variable Frequency Drives, DC drives, and standard electrical components
- Experience interpreting and modifying mechanical and electrical drawings

title: Senior Technical Program Manager – AI/ML, AWS Support Analytics Insights Research Engineering and Science (AiRES)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Agentic AI drives innovation at the forefront of artificial intelligence, enabling customers to transform their businesses through AI solutions. We build and deliver the foundational AI/ML models that power the future of cloud computing, helping organizations harness the potential of AI to solve their most complex challenges. Join our dynamic team of AI/ML practitioners, applied scientists, software engineers, and solution architects who work backwards from customer needs to create technologies. If you're passionate about shaping the future of AI while making a meaningful impact for customers worldwide, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
• Manage Strategic Initiatives : Lead cross-functional technical initiatives from start to finish, ensuring alignment with priorities and on-time delivery.
• Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain relationships across the organization, acting as a bridge between technical teams and leadership to ensure clear communication and effective collaboration.
• Operational Excellence: Improve business and tech processes to increase organizational efficiency.
• Operational Rhythm & Coordination: Participate in weekly leadership meetings to align priorities, coordinate business reviews (WBRs, MBRs, QBRs), and facilitate strategic planning using Amazon mechanisms (2-pagers, PR/FAQs, OP1/OP2 planning).
• Technical Program Leadership: Monitor large-scale technical programs, identify and resolve risks/blockers, and drive timely decisions to keep critical work moving forward.
• Innovation & Opportunity Development: Transform innovative ideas into executable plans by conducting analysis, gathering requirements, and creating frameworks to capitalize on emerging opportunities.
• Technical Escalation & Problem Resolution: Address critical technical issues, assess impact, coordinate resolution across teams, and maintain stakeholder engagement throughout.

About the team
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

About AWS:

Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of software development experience
- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

title: Manager - Site Deployment , OneMHS
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking an experienced Senior Field Operations Leader to drive the successful launch of our 2026 Automated Robotics (AR) or Sub Same day (SSD) facilities. This role will lead field teams responsible for installation, integration, and commissioning of mission-critical projects. title: Senior Financial Analyst, Amazon Leo Finance, LEO Infrastructure Finance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is building the world's most advanced low Earth orbit satellite network, delivering fast, affordable broadband to enterprise and consumer customers globally. This is one of the most ambitious infrastructure programs in Amazon's history — combining satellite manufacturing, silicon development, global supply chain, terrestrial infrastructure, and enterprise technology at unprecedented scale. Leo Infrastructure Finance is at the center of it all.

It’s Day 1 for Amazon’s next billion dollar business and we are looking for an entrepreneurial minded Senior Financial Analyst to support the Payload Antenna Development organization — the team responsible for designing, building, and sustaining the satellite's most complex subsystem: the Phased Array Antenna (PAA). The team concurrently manages three full-lifecycle programs — Gen1 production and constellation operations, Gen2 PAA development, and Direct-to-Device (D2D), a new phased array architecture enabling satellite-to-handset connectivity. This role may also support a broader consolidation scope spanning ground infrastructure and payload antenna systems across these programs.

The successful candidate will partner with engineering and finance leaders across hardware development, RF & antenna technology, systems engineering, and test infrastructure to develop operating plans, track multi-program budgets spanning OPEX and CAPEX, and deliver financial insights that enable leadership to make resource allocation decisions across competing program priorities. You will need to be strategic, analytical, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where multiple programs compete for shared resources, lab venues, and funding.

Key job responsibilities
- Partner with Payload engineering leadership and cross-functional teams to manage competing priorities and provide financial guidance across Gen1 PAA production, Gen2 PAA development and D2D phased array development.

- Own multi-program P&L and cost models spanning hardware development builds, antenna test infrastructure, and lab facility investments, and develop accurate Operating Plans, Guidance, headcount plans, and incremental funding requests with clear trade-off and risk narratives.

- Build financial models that quantify cost, schedule, and risk trade-offs — such as antenna test venue contention, dedicated facility investment, and resource allocation across concurrent PAA and ground gateway programs — to drive data-driven decision making.

- Present financial summaries, variance analysis, and business insights to Senior Management (Business and Finance), connecting financial data to hardware program milestones and launch readiness.

- Identify opportunities to improve, automate, or simplify financial processes and reporting tools to scale controllership as program complexity grows.

- Participate in Finance initiatives including month-end close, ad hoc analyses, and periodic reporting activities.

About the team
This role sits within Leo Infrastructure Finance, the team responsible for financial planning and analysis across Amazon Leo's infrastructure cost pillars. Our team specifically covers customer terminals, ground infrastructure, and antenna development (payload + CT), partnering with engineering and operations leaders across these organizations. Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field
- 3+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience

- Can meet export control requirements by being a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum

descriptionHtml:
Do you get excited about using the latest tools and technologies to deliver high-quality software? Are you eager to learn and adapt as the DevOps landscape evolves? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join Amazon as a DevOps Apprentice, where you'll help shape how we build and deliver software.

As a DevOps Apprentice, you'll bridge the gap between software development and IT operations - automating processes and helping ensure the seamless delivery of software to users around the world. The work you do will help shape experiences for millions of customers.

Throughout your apprenticeship you'll grow the technical skills and problem-solving mindset to build and maintain reliable systems, learning to automate, test, and improve the way software is delivered. You'll develop these skills working alongside experienced engineers across development and operations. We move fast, fail fast, and fix faster, so you'll be encouraged to bring your ideas, test them, and learn as you go.

A day in the life can involve:

- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure
- Developing and implementing CI/CD pipelines for rapid and safe software deployment
- Scripting and coding in multiple languages to orchestrate infrastructure and ensure robust testing
- Implementing security best practices throughout the software development lifecycle
- Monitoring and optimising system performance
- Contributing to a culture of continuous improvement

We welcome individuals from all backgrounds who are eager to learn new technologies and comfortable in a fast-paced environment. You'll bring an analytical mindset to solve complex problems, identify root causes, and develop innovative solutions, along with the strategic thinking to anticipate challenges before they arise. Strong collaboration and communication skills matter too, as you'll be working closely with developers, IT operations, and stakeholders to convey complex information clearly.

Here at Amazon, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Within this apprenticeship you'll put newfound knowledge into practice every day, supported by first-class coaching, tailored development, and rewarding work that will empower you to reach new heights and build the future you envision.

You'll gain a vast range of experiences and skills while working towards the Level 4 DevOps Engineer Apprenticeship standard. As a working student, your focus is to complete your studies in your 20% off-the-job time, developing the skills, knowledge, and behaviours to work towards successful graduation. You'll be set objectives and goals by your training provider and manager to support your studies.

You'll build your skills over a 24-month period, starting in September. Your apprenticeship will combine classroom/virtual-based training to cover knowledge, on-the-job training at your Amazon base location, and mentoring from our experienced team members.

title: Sr. Capacity Planner OTR, OTR Planning
descriptionHtml:
About the Team
Trans Execution BR is a team that explores new approaches and ways of working at Amazon Logistics, offering scalable solutions to operate increasingly complex and growing last mile delivery networks. Trans Execution BR is responsible for critical processes such as Capacity Planning, Scheduling, Forecasting, and On Road Management, with the vision of continuously transforming these processes in a scalable manner.
In Brazil, we are building the OTR Capacity Planning team and are looking for a Sr Capacity Planning – OTR to raise the bar in this expansion.
About the Role
We are seeking a Program Manager for the Trans Execution BR team to drive strategic programs and optimize OTR Capacity Planning across Brazil. Thriving in an environment of high ambiguity, you will Think Big and Invent and Simplify processes to boost productivity at AMZL delivery stations. By analyzing OTR Capacity and channel flexibility to cover gaps based on volume fluctuations, you will make high-impact, data-driven decisions. Cultivating strong relationships with cross-functional peers across Hub, DSP, Flex, AMXL and EDSP Program team, Finance and ACES will be essential to align our network in the optimal cost and service level.
The impact of this position is tremendous, making decisions that will affect the entire country’s network of one of the largest companies in the world. A proven track record of sound judgement is a must. At Amazon, you will be encouraged to use this judgement as you grow and nurture your career.


Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will partner cross-functionally with Last Mile Channels, Supply Chain, Finance, Operations, and BI to transform several inputs that influence OTR (on-the-road) into precise, cost-optimal route and channel mix optimal plans on a daily cadence. You will lead the localization of OTR Capacity optimization in Brazil, managing multiple complex projects while seamlessly bridging gaps between systems, processes, and teams.
• Predictive Modeling & Gap Resolution: Design, build, and refine quantitative models to accurately predict On-the-Road (OTR) capacity gaps. Develop scalable, data-driven solutions and utilize channel flexibility to proactively close these gaps during volume fluctuations.
• Strategic Program Management: Lead and execute strategic programs for the Trans Execution BR team, taking ownership of optimizing end-to-end OTR Capacity Planning across the Brazilian AMZL network.
• Cross-Functional Leadership & Alignment: Cultivate strong, collaborative relationships with key stakeholders across Hub, DSP, Amazon Flex, AMXL, the EDSP Program team, Finance, and ACES. Drive alignment across these teams to execute capacity plans that achieve optimal cost structures while maintaining high service levels.
• Data-Driven Decision Making: Conduct deep-dive analyses on OTR capacity metrics and channel performance. Leverage this data to make high-impact, strategic decisions that balance network productivity with delivery execution.
• Process Innovation & Simplification: Navigate an environment of high ambiguity by applying Amazon’s "Think Big" and "Invent and Simplify" leadership principles. Identify operational bottlenecks and re-engineer capacity planning processes to significantly boost productivity at delivery stations.
• Performance Monitoring & Reporting: Continuously monitor network capacity health, track the effectiveness of implemented gap-solving strategies, and present actionable insights and progress reports to senior leadership.

Basic Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, Operations Research, statistics, IT or equivalent
• Speak, write, and read fluently in English and Portuguese
• Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
• 3+ years of professional experience in demand planning, statistical forecasting, supply chain analytics, or inventory modeling.
• Strong foundational knowledge of statistical forecasting methods (e.g., moving average, exponential smoothing, ARIMA) and historical data analysis.
• Experience with data analysis
• Proven ability to translate complex statistical concepts into actionable business insights for non-technical stakeholders in Sales, Marketing, and Operations.
• Proven experience in program or project management


Preferred Qualifications
• Master’s degree in Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Supply Chain Management, or an MBA with a quantitative focus.
• Proficiency in Python or R specifically for building, tuning, and deploying custom predictive forecasting models and time-series analysis.
• Strong SQL skills for querying and manipulating relational databases, combined with experience building dashboards in modern BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker).
• Demonstrated experience applying Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques to supply chain variables, such as promotional modeling, cannibalization analysis, or new product launch forecasting.
• Active industry credentials such as APICS (CPIM, CSCP) or IBF Certified Professional in Forecasting (CPF).
• Experience owning or heavily influencing the S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning) cycle and a track record of driving measurable improvements in forecast accuracy metrics (e.g., MAPE, WMAPE, Bias)
• Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization;

title: Future Operations Leader - Degree Apprenticeship Yorkshire & Humber (37-month fixed term contract)
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to step into a leadership role in one of the world's most fast-paced, customer-obsessed operations? This is your opportunity to earn a fully funded degree from a Russell Group university while leading in the heart of Amazon's operations - from day one.

Amazon is looking for ambitious, driven individuals to join our Future Operations Leader Degree Apprenticeship. You'll earn a fully funded BSc (Hons) in Leadership and Project Management while working on the ground in one of our fulfilment centres or operational sites, solving real business challenges alongside experienced leaders. This is a hands-on role, not a desk job - our sites are vast (some the size of several football pitches), and you'll be out across the floor where the action happens, covering real distance as you lead teams, drive change, and make a tangible impact.

At its core, this is a people role. Yes, you'll work with data, processes, and technology - but the heart of operations leadership is people. You'll learn how to motivate a team at 3am, how to have difficult conversations with empathy, how to recognise when someone's struggling, and how to create an environment where people want to do their best work. If you're energised by working with others and want to build your career around leading teams, this programme will give you the foundation to do exactly that.

This role involves shift work, including days, nights, and weekends, because our operations run around the clock and great leaders need to understand every part of that rhythm. You'll rotate through different shift patterns, which means early starts, late finishes, and yes, night shifts. It's a demanding, fast-paced environment with a lot to juggle – you'll need to prioritise quickly, stay composed under pressure, and keep the most important things moving. It's a real step up, and we're looking for people who expect that challenge and are ready to run with it. It's a physical, on-your-feet role - you'll be out on the floor, not behind a desk. It's not for everyone, but if you thrive where no two days feel the same and you want to understand operations from the ground up, it's one of the most valuable parts of the experience.

A day in the life can involve:

- Starting with a team stand-up or shift handover, reviewing priorities, performance metrics, and issues from the previous shift

- Shadowing or supporting a team leader or manager on the floor, getting stuck into real-time problem solving - clearing a bottleneck, supporting a team member, or managing workflow across the site

- Working on a project linked to your degree - building a business case for a process improvement, mapping stakeholders for a site change, or analysing quality and risk data to present back to leadership

- On university weeks, attending masterclasses or webinars and completing coursework, then bringing what you've learned straight back onto the floor

As you progress, you'll build relationships across the site, develop your own leadership style, and take on increasing responsibility.

This could be for you if you're the person who captained a sports team, coached younger students, led a group project, completed your Duke of Edinburgh, volunteered in your community, organised something no one asked you to, or put your hand up to be a prefect. Or maybe you've spent a few years in the workplace and found yourself naturally stepping up - training new starters, leading a team, improving a process, or taking ownership of something bigger than your job description. Leadership isn't about a job title; it's about what you do when no one's told you to. If that sounds like you, this programme is your next step.

Over 37 months, you'll develop the knowledge and skills to lead in a complex operational environment, including:

- Business strategy and how organisations operate

- Project planning, scheduling, budgeting, and delivery within time, cost, and quality constraints

- Leading and managing diverse teams, building trust, and driving performance

- Financial controls, business case development, and performance reporting

- Stakeholder engagement, communication, and influencing at all levels

- Organisational change management - preparing teams and operations for change

- Risk identification, quality assurance, and continuous improvement

- Commercial awareness, procurement, and contract management

- Digital innovation, data-driven technologies, and AI in a business context

What you'll achieve:

- BSc (Hons) Leadership and Project Management

- Level 6 Project Manager Degree Apprenticeship

- CMI Level 5 Certificate in Project Management (dual accredited)

- International Project Management Association (IPMA) Level D qualification

Four qualifications. Fully funded. All earned while working.

This is a blended learning programme. Each module follows a 14-week cycle combining pre-reading and preparation, in-person masterclasses at the university, online learning and webinars, and individual study and assignment writing. You'll be supported throughout by a dedicated Academic Mentor, with progress reviews every 12 weeks involving your Line Manager, plus full access to university resources including library services, wellbeing support, and student societies.

title: Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:

We are looking for an exceptional data engineer to help us develop new ways to build trust and loyalty with sellers, a crucial component of our flywheel

Sellers’ trust in Amazon is our top priority and in this role, you will be tasked with building that trust over time by building and maintaining the data sources that power all of our decision making. The successful candidate will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity and be able to create and maintain efficient & automated processes. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. title: Planning Manager, Device Operations Planning and Execution
descriptionHtml:

Since then, we have produced various devices like Fire tablets, Fire TV, and Amazon Echo. What will you help us create?

The Supply Planning Manager is responsible for all internal and external activities related to supply planning from production forecasts to finished good delivery. To succeed in this role, you need to be data driven, business oriented, cost conscious, and customer-centric.

This role may require some travel.

Key job responsibilities
Create and maintain a production schedule using the capacity plan, material constraints, and demand as inputs.
Analyze demand changes to ensure supply aligns with demand requirements.

A day in the life

You will anticipate stocking levels based on demand strategies, create and implement risk mitigation strategies to eliminate supply chain disruptions and drive decisions based on costs using data and inputs from cross-functional teams.

Your weekly planning deliverables will drive capacity decisions and component purchases upstream to suppliers and set the production strategy with Amazon's electronic manufacturing suppliers.

title: Senior Category Manager, MEATR External Fulfillment
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Global Procurement Organization (GPO) is looking for a Senior Category Manager to own strategic and tactical sourcing programs within the External Fulfillment category, with a focus on third-party (3PL) contract logistics services and 3PL transportation. A key priority for this role is helping launch 3PL capacity in Egypt to supplement Amazon's first-party (1P) fulfillment capabilities. You will bring procurement experience in complex, international, or technical environments, along with strong communication skills and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholder groups at all levels of the organization. This is a role where you take initiative, manage competing priorities, and form strong partnerships with business leaders to drive meaningful results.

Key job responsibilities

title: Software Development Engineer II, Robotics Navigation
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking exceptional talent to help develop the next generation of advanced robotics systems that will transform automation at Amazon's scale. We're building robotic systems that combine cutting-edge AI, sophisticated control systems, and advanced mechanical design to create adaptable automation solutions capable of working safely alongside humans in dynamic environments. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of robotics and automation at an unprecedented scale, working with world-class teams pushing the boundaries of what's possible in robotic dexterous manipulation, locomotion, and human-robot interaction. This role presents an opportunity to shape the future of robotics through innovative applications of the latest software and AI tools for robots.

At Amazon we leverage advanced robotics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to solve complex operational challenges at an unprecedented scale. Our fleet of robots operates across hundreds of facilities worldwide, working in sophisticated coordination to fulfill our mission of customer excellence.

We are building the brains of our next-generation robots - a stack that:
- Enables deployment of robots at Amazon scale
- Enables unprecedented generalization across diverse tasks
- Seamlessly integrates with large models and optimal control techniques
- Integrates with human-safe safety solutions

As a Software Development Engineer on our on-robot software team, you will help our robots know where they are and get where they need to go. You will partner with applied scientists working on localization and mapping (SLAM), spatial memory, and navigation to turn their algorithms into fast, reliable on-robot components. You will integrate them with perception, task planning, and safety, and measure how well they work on real robot data. Our robots work in large, busy, and changing spaces, where a robot that loses track of where it is can't do its job.

Join us in building the next generation of intelligent robotics systems that will transform the future of automation and human-robot collaboration.


Key job responsibilities
- Partner with scientists and engineers to turn SLAM, mapping, and navigation algorithms into production on-robot components
- Build the localization and mapping pipeline, and keep the robot localized over long distances in large spaces that change throughout the day
- Build the spatial memory that records what the robot has seen and where
- Make navigation reliable alongside perception and safety, including recovering when the robot gets stuck
- Measure how well localization and navigation work on real robot data, and use that to improve them
- Make it all run in real time on the robot's embedded compute, and debug failures on real robots
- Write design docs and experiment reports that are clear about tradeoffs and limitations

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- Experience programming with C++ and/or Python
- Experience developing or integrating perception, SLAM, localization, or navigation software for robots, autonomous vehicles, or other real-world systems

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with a focus on state estimation, computer vision, or robotics
- Experience with SLAM and state estimation, such as visual, visual-inertial, or lidar odometry, loop closure, pose-graph optimization (e.g., GTSAM, Ceres, g2o), and localization in prebuilt maps
- Experience with navigation stacks (e.g., ROS 2, Nav2, costmaps, global and local planners, behavior trees)
- Experience with 3D data and point clouds (e.g., PCL, Open3D) and occupancy or voxel mapping
- Experience building semantic maps, scene graphs, or spatial memory for robots, including with vision-language models
- Experience with multi-sensor pipelines, time synchronization, and coordinate-frame management (e.g., cameras, lidar, IMU, tf2)

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Do you have the passion to work in the AWS Water industry with a focus on water stewardship and sustainability efforts? Do you have the industry background, technical depth, and business development skills needed to help further establish AWS as the leader in the water industry?
AWS is looking for a results-oriented individual to join the AWS water infrastructure team. In this role, you will execute projects related to water based cooling system infrastructure with assistance from internal teams including construction, operations, engineering, environmental, and project commissioning teams.

You will work with outside engineering consultants and general contractors, water treatment and sampling vendors and local water and wastewater utilities on feasibility and design work that ensures our infrastructure projects meet regulatory standards and a high bar for operational efficiency, reliability, and safety at the lowest possible cost. You will deliver water sustainability projects for AWS Infrastructure in US East regions, as you execute on the delivery of multiple water infrastructure development projects, monitor operational efficiency metrics, and build in system resiliency after project hand-off to regional operations teams.

You will also be the central point of contact for all issues pertaining to water and wastewater treatment and disinfection systems and for managing healthy relationships with our utility partners. If you have strong mechanical or chemistry background and an understanding of water-cooled infrastructure in building operations, are interested in innovation and sustainability in the water sector, and understand the feasibility of construction under various designs, you are a probably a good fit! Key job responsibilities The Water Infrastructure Engineer will be responsible for the following: Engineer, implement and monitor water treatment/operations projects and identify optimal design criteria for scaling projects to full-scale deployment across different regions in North America.

Work with internal teams to troubleshoot problems and conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective Action (CA) for design and fleet deployed water systems. Up to 20% travel as needed for project execution where authorized.

title: Principal TPM, AI Engineering, AI Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Software engineering is where AI is changing work fastest. Developers everywhere now use AI coding tools, but the organizational gains have not followed, and most enterprises have faster individual developers alongside the same delivery outcomes. AWS AI Engineering exists to close that gap. We help customers systematically build better software with AI across the whole software development lifecycle. AI-native development is now moving from early adopters into the enterprise, and the hard part is no longer proving that it works. It is making it scale.
We are looking for a Principal TPM to help shape how that happens. You will work alongside our engineering teams to bring direction together from two streams of signal: what we learn inside customers' engineering organizations, and where the industry is heading. Customer signal tells you what hurts today. Industry signal tells you what will be table stakes in six months. Connecting the two into a point of view the team can act on, and keeping it current as both move, is the center of this role.
Our current work includes an open-source, AI-native development lifecycle we created and continue to evolve with customers, along with offerings that give AI agents a deep understanding of large codebases and move customers toward autonomous software delivery. Those offerings will keep changing as the technology does, and the charter behind them will not.


Key job responsibilities
Bring the direction together
Work with our engineering teams to connect customer signal and industry signal into a clear direction for how AWS helps customers become AI-native across the software development lifecycle. Find where teams are solving the same problem in parallel and bring that work together, so the organization makes one piece of real progress rather than three partial ones. Help sequence work against customer readiness and keep the portfolio coherent as individual offerings come and go.
Define the methodology, then make it adoptable
Drive the definition, standardization, and adoption of our AI-native development lifecycle as something customers can run themselves. Build consensus on the practices and standards that make it real, and replace fragmented experimentation with a credible default path that fits each customer's risk tolerance.
Own adoption, and scale it
Treat adoption as the deliverable rather than the follow-up, through enablement, documentation, reference implementations, assessments, and self-service paths that carry customers from first experiment to production-scale practice. Design the mechanisms that convert individual developer adoption into enterprise standardization and that let the wider AWS field carry this work without you in the room. Account for organizations whose constraints differ from the ones you designed for, and for the long tail where adoption usually stalls.
Define how success is measured, and hold us to it
Define and track outcome-based KPIs for the charter, including adoption and depth of use inside customer organizations, persistence of changed behavior long after the engagement, and improvements in delivery speed, quality, and the economics of building software. Insist on rigorous evaluation of the offerings we build, the agents inside them, and our own claims about what works. Build measurement frameworks customers can run on themselves, and recommend stopping work that is not paying off.
Build leverage out of engagements
Turn lessons from individual customer engagements into repeatable patterns and scalable assets. Productize what was built for one customer when it has broader value, and resist treating every new request as bespoke. Represent the voice of the customer internally, translating patterns and adoption blockers into actionable input for AWS service teams so that what we learn in the field shapes the products customers build on.
Lead across the organization and with customers
Influence without relying on authority, aligning engineering, field, and regional teams worldwide on shared direction and sequencing. Act as a trusted advisor to customer executives and practitioners, solving the business problem rather than only the technical one and investing in the long-term relationship over the one-off win. Build the playbook and enablement that lets the wider AWS field carry this work, and represent it externally through open source, conference talks, and technical writing.


A day in the life
You split your time between setting direction and staying close to the work. On one day you might sit with a customer's engineering team to understand why they abandoned part of the lifecycle after week three, then meet a CTO to agree what success looks like for a 15,000 developer organization. On another you might review adoption data across regions to decide where the next investment goes, work out what a stalled rollout actually needs, or turn a pattern that worked for one customer into something the whole field can run. You make calls with incomplete information, hold direction under pressure, and change course when the evidence warrants.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 5+ years of software development experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred qualifications

- 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

AI Acceleration

Your analysis will directly inform how the business allocates resources, identifies efficiency opportunities, and responds to a complex and fast-moving market.

- Build and maintain financial controls, approval mechanisms, and reporting processes to manage day-to-day business profitability.
- Develop financial plans for short and long-term planning cycles, aligning inputs with senior stakeholders across the region and globally.
- Design and automate management reporting tools, working with business intelligence teams to simplify and standardise processes.
- Analyse financial and operational data to identify growth and efficiency opportunities, presenting findings to senior leadership to drive decisions.
- Partner cross-functionally with business teams to provide financial guidance, lead analytical projects, and support strategic planning.


A day in the life
On a typical day, you might start by reviewing financial performance metrics to identify where the business is tracking ahead or behind plan, then spend time deep-diving into the data to understand the drivers. You'll build or refine a financial model to support an upcoming planning cycle, before joining a cross-functional meeting to present your findings and challenge assumptions with senior business partners. Later, you might review a team member's analysis, giving guidance on a complex or ambiguous area before wrapping up by progressing one of several analytical projects you're running in parallel. About the team
The MENA Finance team sits at the centre of one of Amazon's most dynamic and fast-growing regions. Level: L4 | Team: MEATR Amazon Now | Location: Dubai, UAE (DXB30) | Markets: AE, SA, EG Draft Date: November 2026
1.1 About the Role
Amazon Now is one of Amazon's fastest-growing businesses in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), and demand-led growth is its primary lever. The Growth Insights & Programs Manager owns the analytical engine of the MENA A-Now Growth charter - identifying, sizing, and activating the opportunities that maximize total orders and build sustainable customer demand across the United Arab Emirates (UAE), Saudi Arabia (SA), and Egypt (EG) markets.
This role sits at the intersection of Growth, Category, Central Programs, and Product. The mandate is to answer, "where are the highest-impact growth opportunities?" and then drive execution of the programs that unlock them. The ideal candidate combines the rigor of a data analyst with the judgment of a business owner: they translate customer, market, and store-level signals into interventions that move the order curve.

• Own the analytical foundation of the MENA Growth charter. Use Structured Query Language (SQL), Python, Amazon QuickSight, Tableau, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools - including large language model (LLM)-powered analytics assistants and AI-generated insight platforms - to analyze customer cohorts, store-level demand patterns, and market signals across UAE, SA, and EG.
• Build and maintain a structured view of the drivers and inhibitors of order growth across the Amazon Now network - updated on a cadence agreed with leadership.
• Conduct root cause analyses on order volume gaps, customer retention drop-offs, and acquisition funnel leakages. Present findings with a clear "so what" and a recommended intervention, not just a diagnosis.
• Size growth opportunities end-to-end: quantify the addressable order uplift, identify the customer segment or geography, and enable automated tracking of progress on initiatives identified to unlock.

title: Senior RME Technician
descriptionHtml:
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team is central to Amazon's commitment to innovation. As Amazon evolves and adapts, this team makes sure that the tools and technologies we use do as well. As a Senior RME Technician, you'll help us stay one step ahead, adopting the latest technologies and identifying new and efficient ways of working. In this role, you’ll pay close attention to our processes to help maintain our high standards, and you’ll put in place upgrades to take that standard even higher.



Key job responsibilities
- Demonstrate best practice on using equipment safely and monitor teams to ensure everyone follows the correct processes
- Keep track of equipment performance through visual checks, condition-based monitoring, and preventative maintenance tasks and schedule additional servicing when required
- Supervise technicians on shift to support their development and act as the first point of contact for Reliability Maintenance Engineers
- Solve issues in equipment to reduce downtime for operations so they can process packages as quickly as possible
- Support in finding ways to continually improve systems and standardise processes across the EU network

A day in the life




In every shift, you’ll be leading a team to make sure everyone has the equipment they need and that it’s running properly. That involves monitoring processes so that regulations and policies are followed and ensuring that preventative maintenance is carried out to increase equipment uptime.

With everything you observe on your shifts, you’ll suggest improvements to make our systems more efficient and productive and then implement those improvements across an EU-wide function. You’ll also be monitoring processes with tools like Scada to guarantee their performance, as well as working closely with your line manager to assist with admin tasks.

This role is located at one of our operational sites. You’ll work shift patterns, which may include some weekends and nights. As you develop your experience within this exciting part of Amazon, you’ll be well-placed to progress into more senior roles.

About the team
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering or RME team keep our equipment performing at its best. We're a technically minded team, made up of excellent team players and guided by experienced leaders. We work together to maintain, troubleshoot and repair equipment across our global network of fulfilment centres. Some of our people are leaders, who oversee the team as they work on exciting technology – some of which only exists at Amazon.

From installing automated packaging systems to overseeing the general maintenance of a site to repairing key distribution equipment, our team handles most aspects of Amazon’s technical side. This includes keeping buildings legally compliant, so everyone is safe, and our sites are operating at maximum efficiency. There are lots of opportunities for progression, both within the RME team and more widely across Amazon.

Everything we do focuses on reducing downtime in Amazon’s crucial operations sites, so customers get their orders on time. We often work during early or late hours to carry out maintenance with minimal disruption, including night shifts. If we spot a better way to do something, we have the skills and the opportunity to develop and introduce completely new processes or cutting-edge tech like Amazon Robotics and our Complex Item Sorter.

Basic qualifications

- NVQ Level 3 in Mechanical, Electrical or Mechatronics, or completed a 4-year UK certified apprenticeship
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Relevant experience in a technical leadership role
- Relevant experience working in both electrical and mechanical disciplines
- Relevant experience in automation or material handling equipment environments
- Advanced proficiency in verbal and written English

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in a multi-contractor and multi-site working environment
- Understanding of PLC based controls systems and statutory compliance requirements
- Experience using computerised maintenance management systems to plan proactive maintenance and record reactive tasks
- A degree preferably in a technical discipline or operations

title: Account Manager, US AVS, Paid Selling Partner Services
descriptionHtml:

Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience – Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from website to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.

About the Role

Account Manager - Amazon Vendor Services, North America

As an Account Manager you would be a part of Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) Team of Retail Business Services. You will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy for managing Amazon AVS vendors.

AVS team is looking for bright, customer centric, driven, and creative candidates to join our team. You will utilize a wide range of skills and work across major functional areas such as, selection, catalogue quality, buying, inventory management, finance, operations, to drive the performance of vendor partners at Amazon. In this role you will be focused on driving numerous aspects of managing the customer relationships with vendors.

You will conceive, create and analyze a wide range of deal activities to grow the vendor’s traffic, brand awareness, customer conversion, and revenue on Amazon. Also, you will look into operational aspects of vendor’s business with Amazon, root cause analysis of issues and opportunities impacting business.

•Establish long term partnerships with key vendor partners for the group of vendors handled.

• Build and execute on a joint business plan that delivers on key business opportunities and relevant KPIs for the vendors and Amazon.

• Conduct deep dive analysis on vendor issues and publish recommendations and action plans based on data, to improve vendor experience.

• Conduct regular business reviews with the vendors, highlight business metric performance and build action plans.

title: Sr. Solutions Architect, AWS Industries - Media & Entertainment, Games and Sports (AWSI-MEGS)
descriptionHtml:
Are you a hands-on technologist who loves solving complex customer problems? Do you enjoy working with engineering teams and technical leaders to design solutions that deliver real business results? If so, we want to hear from you.
As a Senior Solutions Architect at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you'll partner with media and entertainment customers to design and deliver cloud solutions that are scalable, secure, cost-optimized and high-performing. You'll be the trusted technical advisor for your accounts, turning business requirements into practical architectures and guiding customers from early ideas through to production. Your technical depth, customer focus and clear communication will help organizations adopt AWS and succeed with it. Your customer insights will also help shape the AWS services that customers build on.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the technical relationship for a set of strategic customer accounts. Work backward from customer business goals to design end-to-end solutions that are extensible, secure, reliable and cost-optimized.
• Build trust with customer architects, engineering leaders and technical decision-makers. Understand their challenges and guide architecture decisions that support both near-term delivery and long-term goals.
• Lead deep technical discussions on design choices, best practices and the trade-offs between implementation options. Spot and reduce risks early, and steer customers away from approaches that are needlessly complex.
• Create and deliver technical content such as presentations, workshops, reference architectures and sample code that help customers apply AWS best practices.
• Work with account managers, professional services, partners, support and service teams to speed up adoption. Contribute reusable patterns and assets to the wider Solutions Architecture community.
• Build deep expertise in one or more media domains (streaming, media supply chain, ad tech) and in generative AI, and keep your knowledge current as the industry changes.
• Build and present hands-on prototypes, demos and proofs of concept that prove technical feasibility and speed up the path to production.
• Work with ISVs and industry partners to design and validate joint solutions across live streaming, media asset management, and ad delivery and personalization.
• Pass customer feedback and feature requests to AWS service teams so the product roadmap reflects what customers actually need.
• Share what you know through blogs, conference talks and community events, and mentor other SAs to grow technical depth across the team.

A day in the life
You might start your morning getting ready for an architecture review with a streaming customer's engineering leads. You'd look over their current video delivery setup and find places where AWS services could improve scale, resilience or cost. Mid-morning, you could be at the whiteboard with their developers, designing a live-event workflow and weighing the trade-offs between reliability, latency and cost. After lunch, you might be hands-on building a generative AI proof of concept that automates metadata tagging for a media asset library. Later, you'd meet with your account manager to plan next steps for the customer. You might finish the day by writing up a feature request for an AWS service team based on what you heard from customers, or by reviewing a reference architecture with a fellow SA you're mentoring.

About the team
We're the AWS Media, Entertainment, Games and Sports (MEGS) Solutions Architecture team, and our vision is simple: we meet our customers where they are, design what's next, prove what's possible, and scale what matters for every fan, every story, every screen, and every experience. #InventForFans

We come with a point of view, staying on the frontier of technology and pushing it where it matters most to our customers. We're builders who roll up our sleeves to create demos, proofs of concept, and prototypes, because a working idea beats a slide every time. We collaborate across account teams, specialists, and service teams, acting as the connective tissue that shapes what gets built next. And we scale our thinking, turning what we learn in the field into patterns and reference architectures that the whole industry can use. Every activity backs an outcome for our customers, and we're intentional about the work that matters.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in a professional field or military
- Experience in IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries
- Experience within specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics).
- Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with end user or developer communities
- Experience in data science, business analytics, business intelligence, or similar experience in big data environments
- Experience solving problems with technology in the Media & Entertainment Industry
- Experience developing, deploying and managing AI products at scale
- Experience leveraging AI-powered tools or data analytics platforms to drive quality improvements, root cause analysis, or process optimization
- Experience in B2B, digital advertising, and ad-tech products/services
