title: Senior Product Manager, PV Commerce & Int'l Product
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Prime Video's vision is to be the world's favorite entertainment brand and the first-choice entertainment hub globally. Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows, movies and live sports, all in one place where it is easy to find what they love to watch. Members can also subscribe to add-on channels (third-party streaming services) and rent new-release movies on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is at the forefront of the entertainment industry and growing fast, now available in 240 countries and territories worldwide. We work in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do.

As a Senior Product Manager for Prime Video in India, you will own the product strategy and roadmap for one of our largest international markets. You will build a deep understanding of local customers, including how they discover content, choose plans and pay. You will turn those insights into products that grow and retain Prime Video customers. You will define what we build and why, write the documents that earn alignment, and partner with regional business teams and worldwide product and engineering teams to launch and scale features. We are looking for a customer-obsessed product manager with a strong track record of shipping products, using data to make decisions, and leading across teams without direct authority.

Key job responsibilities
Own the multi-year product vision and roadmap for India and other emerging priority countries, and prioritize investments by customer and business impact.

Write PRFAQs, product requirements and business cases that define the customer problem, the solution and the success metrics.

Partner with engineering, UX, science, and the worldwide Payments, Subscriptions, Personalization and App Experience teams to deliver local features on global platforms.

Design and read experiments (weblabs), and use the results to decide what to launch, iterate on or stop.

Build products that fit local needs, such as local payment methods, plans and pricing, partner bundles and local content discovery.

Report progress, risks and results to senior leadership through regular business reviews.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Master's degree or equivalent
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- Experience owning technology products
- Experience leading projects across multiple stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon Now (Tez)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Now (Quick Commerce) — is one of Amazon's largest and fastest-growing businesses, operating across 8+ marketplaces (India, MENA, North America, EU, UK, Japan) and powering adjacent businesses like India Fresh and Healthcare. The platform handles >0.7MM orders/day, scaling to 2MM by year-end.
As an SDE2 on the Tez CX PIXEL team, you would work at the heart of Amazon Now's quick commerce platform. IXEL owns the end-to-end in-store shopping experience, from homepage and browse surfaces through personalization, live cart, single cart and checkout, deals and value surfacing, AI-driven merchandising, and geospatial CX.
The systems are Tier 1, serving 2,000+ TPS as the canonical worldwide platforms for shopping, ordering, and savings. The role directly impacts conversion, basket size, and checkout completion — the metrics that turn platform growth into revenue. The defining product shift ahead is the adaptive, agentic store — moving from a fixed storefront to one that intelligently composes itself around each customer's habits, context, and intent, making this a compelling charter for an SDE2 looking to drive high-impact, customer-facing systems at scale.

Key job responsibilities
- You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices.
- You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant.
- You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). Your solutions are pragmatic.
- You consider the legacy of the code you produce and write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand.
- You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time (or at least minimize incidental complexity).
- You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies.
- You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc.)
- You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers

About the team
We are fast-paced and focussed team made of passionate and ambitious Amazonians who strive to build industry leading products while closely collaborating and having fun. The team is made of multiple Sr. SDEs and are working on first time in Amazon initiatives which will scale beyond India and grocery. The team follows a flexible and collaborative work culture with ample mentoring and guidance from PEs. The team values high ownership, bias for action and insist on highest standards and follows build fast and iterate fast methodology. The team is suitable for passionate engineers who are equally interested in contributing to business and product roadmap.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- 3+ years of contributing to new and current systems architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) experience
